<Let me stress it again. One bomb is enough to destroy the wormhole. You never know what will happen after it explodes. The whole ground around this area may be blown away, or, at worst, a miniature sun may appear here. Earth’s ecosystems will collapse.>
“Really? I don’t know much about that.”
<You must have another plan, right?>
“I have a message for you guys.”
“Us?”
“You are no different. You guys are slayers as well as invaders.”
<Why do you think so?>
“This is not just somebody’s fault, but that of the whole people in your world.”
<What kind of message are you trying to convey? Don’t do that. Instead, I will convey your message to our world in the most rational and peaceful way!>
But Sungwoo shook his head, then said, “No, you guys have to realize it personally.”
Then, he put down the crowbar.
Thump-
“You have to know that when you play with dangerous toys, serious accidents can happen.”
At that moment, a message appeared before his eyes.
– The system is under emergency recovery. (99%)
<Huh? The system has been restored faster than expected. Gosh, this can’t happen so quickly! We don’t have time. Destroy the main core and move as fast as you can!>
“Good for you.”
<Pardon?>
– The system has been restored.
“Actually, we have restored it.”
Sungwoo and his allies did not know much about computer functions. However, by intimidating Walter, they gained control of the local space for a while.
In other words, they have restored the system of this island alone.
“Everyone, step back!”
Shouting at them, Sungwoo used one skill.
– Caution! The Fellblade has begun in the area!
Black smoke burst out.
Rattle! Rattle!
And a white shadow came out of it. The safety glass was broken and the wall collapsed.
Whoooo-
The giant monster ‘Bone Dragon’ that broke out of the control room spread his wings. Sungwoo was aboard him.
<You are crazy!>
“Right, I’m crazy. You don’t know me. In the hellish world you’ve created, anyone who doesn’t go crazy is a real madman.”
Sungwoo then moved the Bone Dragon.
Thump- Thump-
His massive body stepped into the area near the vertical tunnel, while at the same time stretching out his front paws to grab three fission-powered ‘hydrogen bombs’.
“I will tell you guys how dangerous the toys you used to play with are.”
The Bone Dragon jumped into the vertical tunnel toward the wormhole
Following him were thousands of undead army.
They launched a massive counterattack.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - Best Ending (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 483: Best Ending (1)
Sungwoo finally passed through the wormhole. He passed through a passage of bizarre colors like yellow, pink, purple, and blue, which he could not identify clearly.
After he passed through it for a few seconds, white light burst out, and he saw the familiar sky. It was a space called ‘sky’, which was rare in the universe where sky blue and white were mixed.
‘It’s Earth.’
Yes, it was Earth. In other words, it was a cradle of evil from another world, or more precisely, the world called ‘Zero Earth.’
As the Bone Dragon descended, Sungwoo turned his head back.
‘Is that the gate?’
A huge ring-shaped facility was floating in orbit. It was the so-called ‘gate’. Sungwoo came out through the center of the gate.
“Go right down the gate.”
Zero Earth also had a wormhole at the bottom of the Bermuda Triangle.
Since it was difficult for him to pass smoothly if the passage was embedded underground, it was connected to the ‘gate’ on the orbit the moment he came out of the wormhole. Sungwoo got all this information from Walter.
‘I didn’t expect Walter would betray his hometown so quickly.’
The arrogant and indolent humans in Zero Earth had no such thing as something like a lofty cause or pursuit. They were armed with only the primal instinct and the stimulating pursuit of play. Therefore, it was not difficult for Sungwoo to persuade a human like Walter.
“It’s right there!”
Soon, a large city center came into Sungwoo’s view.
‘It’s so huge.’
A high and wide downtown stretched along the coast to the extent that it was difficult to find out where it ended when Sungwoo looked down on it from thousands of meters up in the sky.
“That’s the heartland of the enemy…”
It was Neo Alexandria, a new metropolis on the east coast of the United States.
Walter told him that it was the largest city in Zero Earth. In the 22nd century when the existing large cities collapsed due to overpopulation and lack of resources, they created this place rapidly by taking advantage of its proximity to a wormhole.
‘This is a city like a parasite that grew up by looting another world, so I must destroy it by all means!’
Full of determination to destroy it, Sungwoo aboard the Bone Dragon nosedived toward it. And thousands of undead were also falling vertically towards it.
At the same time, meteors made of thousands of bones rained down on the city center.
<Stop it now! That’s crazy!> The helper’s voice echoed from Sungwoo’s back. <Answer me! You can hear my voice!>
Was the nanorobot embedded in Sungwoo’s body conveying the helper’s message? But Sungwoo had already locked in a temporary device to stop anybody from controlling his body through Walter.
<Stop it right now!>
“It’s too late. The ending has already begun. And…”
Sungwoo stepped on the Bone Dragon’s head to stand up, then pulled out the Grim Reaper.
“This ending will be very instructive for you guys.”
The helper shouted in a stunned voice, <But it’s a city of 100 million people!>
“Really? Let me tell you this. Earth was a planet with 7.7 billion people!”
And most of them, the 100 million city dwellers in Neo Alexandria, took the lives of 7.7 billion people, or more people than them on Earth. And they enjoyed such a massive massacre.
“As they are so terrible, the 100 million people there deserve to die!” Sungwoo shouted.
But the helper didn’t respond. Did she give up?
‘No, she is going to try her best to disturb me to save her homeland!’
Sungwoo sped up his descent.
The enemy had overwhelming science and technology. If they noticed and responded to Sungwoo’s invasion, they would nullify his power at once.
At that moment something translucent began to spread over the city.
Ooooooooooooooh-
It stretched out from the outskirts of the city and began to cover the city in a hemispherical shape. It was like some kind of shield.
‘Holy shit! Is it a shield?’
As he expected, the undead that fell first were caught in the curtain before disappearing instantly. They used a technology that neutralized nanorobots.
But the speed at which the shield unfolded was not very fast, so most of the undead barely succeeded in entering the city.
<It’s just useless! I already contacted the headquarters there about your coming attack. Since you have a lot of nanorobots in your body, you will be killed if you get caught in that shield! Even if you squeeze into it, you won’t be able to get out. So go back now!>
‘But I know how to.’
The shield had not yet been completely closed when most of Sungwoo’s subordinate spirits entered it, so lots of ‘nanorobots’ connected to Sungwoo’s body came to be populated in the city.
Sungwoo picked up the three hydrogen bombs he had brought for this purpose. And he used ‘Shadow Movement’ to get into the shadow of the city.
– Oh 6%#@*%#$G [email protected]
It was an error message, which was very slow.
‘This is not a failure.’
He felt like he was being sucked somewhere because he had very few nanorobots that could make magical things a reality.
But soon he became convinced that he could make it.
‘Alright!’
Wooooooong-
Sungwoo was standing on a skyscraper that soared in the middle of the city.
It was a huge building whose rooftop was equivalent to the size of any baseball field.
<Ugh? Where did he go?>
Sungwoo placed three hydrogen bombs there and pressed the operation button right away.
– 00:02:59
‘They’re going to explode in three minutes.’
Sungwoo raised his head. The shield almost completely covered the city center.
But there was still a gap in it.
Sungwoo used ‘Twilight Assault’ to attack it.
– %#[email protected]%@@$WLDYear$!
At that moment, a square hologram appeared in the city sky. It was large enough to cover half of the city.
Some letters floated in a square frame.
– [LIVE] Breaking news! “UFO has appeared over Neo Alexandria!”
The authorities were currently confirming it.
‘News?’
It took a while, but the ‘Twilight Assault’ was applied when black smoke slowly rose from under Sungwoo’s feet.
Wooooooooooo-
Sungwoo’s body was engulfed in a black tornado, and it rose and shot towards the closing shield.
Sungwoo’s body barely squeezed through the closing gap in the shield.
As soon as he escaped from it, the city was completely sealed off.
‘It was a close call!’
Then, Sungwoo got on the Bone Dragon.
“Ugh?”
When he looked down at the city center, the Bone Dragon appeared on the huge hologram. The live scenes of Sungwoo taking action were being broadcast in real-time on an emergency breaking news channel.
All of a sudden, drones with cameras were flying like a swarm of bees towards Sungwoo.
‘They may be equipped with weapons!’
Suungwoo moved the group of Bone Wyverns and wiped away the approaching drones.
Then Bone Dragon’s head, seen on the hologram, was close up, then Sungwoo’s face appeared on the screen, along with a message.
– The unidentified person who appeared in the sky over Neo Alexandria is presumed to be ‘kor-157,’ the player from the 32nd Earth.
Sungwoo chuckled at that.
“Yeah, you guys feel something strange, right?”
<Yeah, you guys feel something strange, right?>
Sungwoo’s voice resounded throughout the city, or more precisely, Zero Earth.
They accurately captured Sungwoo’s voice, even though he was so far away from them.
“Alright. It’s you who is the ‘player’ of this game.”
<Alright. It’s you who is the ‘player’ of this game.>
A group of Wyverns, zombie Hippogriffs, zombie monsters, and ghosts gathered around Sungwoo. This must have excited those people in Zero Earth, while they were watching those on 32nd Earth being killed.
But they would have never imagined the winner of the so-called 32nd Earth, namely the Necromancer, floating over their heads right now as their arch enemy.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - Best Ending (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 484: Best Ending (2)
“Players from Zero Earth, listen to me carefully! I’ll give you a quest.”
<Players from Zero Earth, listen to me carefully! I’ll give you a quest.>
Sungwoo made a cynical smile while saying so.
“By all means…”
<By all means…”
Sungwoo was ready to convey his feelings about the sudden disaster to them.
“Try to survive!”
<Try to survive!>
After he said that, he got aboard the Bone Dragon and started increasing the altitude.
‘This is all I can do for them.’
He was thinking of going back to Earth. The reality was that Sungwoo alone could not conquer Zero Earth.
They were the ones who developed the system to which ‘nano technology’, the origin of Sungwoo’s power, was applied, so it was a matter of time that they would be overpowered.
‘Nonetheless, I received the gift well.’
After arriving at the gate, Sungwoo turned his head one last time.
’10 seconds.’
Time was almost up.
‘8 seconds.’
Sunwoo looked down at Zero Earth.
‘6 seconds.’
He was determined to watch the final scenes of the city center’s collapse with his own eyes.
‘2 seconds.’
Finally, he mentioned zero.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The hydrogen bombs exploded. Three simultaneous explosions and the ensuing wave of red flames began to quickly devour the city center. The buildings collapsed, and the ground was overturned and pushed away like the sea waves. Mushroom clouds rose from the city center and swelled double and triple, and ring-shaped clouds were created one after another around them.
It was annihilation. When he looked down from the sky, Sungwoo could notice vividly how destructive the bombs were.
Sungwoo stepped back before he knew it.
Kugugugugugugugugu-
The downtown in Zero Earth disappeared in an instant.
Then the lights of the nearby places near the city center disappeared because of electromagnetic pulses, EMP. That wasn’t all.
A large amount of radioactivity fell heavily in the area, creating an environment in which humans could not survive.
Sungwoo turned his head before he was caught up in the storm. He didn’t witness the last moment of the explosions, but it was certain that he dealt a devastating blow to them.
<You are a devil-like bastard!>
The helper shouted at Sungwoo at the top of her voice. <How could you take such a heinous action against us?>
“Well, I didn’t know I could do this.”
<You have no right to blame anyone!>
“What I want to do is not criticize somebody.”
<Then…>
“I wish I had wiped out everything there and left no one to blame or criticize from now on. And I have had some success a little while ago.”
<…>
“I hope I have a chance to wrap it up completely someday.”
Having said that, he went into the wormhole.
He heard that he could return to 32nd Earth simply by throwing himself into the wormhole because of the coordinates embedded in the nanorobots inside his body.
So he passed through the wormhole in an instant and came out of the vertical tunnel.
The Bone Dragon thrust his head towards the light and stretched his front paws to touch the ground.
“Sungwoo!”
His allies already gathered around the vertical tunnel when he got there.
“How did it go?”
Their expressions were full of worry, but as soon as Sungwoo appeared, they stopped worrying and began to feel reassured.
“Yes, it’s almost done.”
The Bone Dragon leaned over and lowered his head, and Sungwoo got off.
He was not done yet until he destroyed the wormhole completely.
“Do you have the bombs ready?”
It was time to sever the link with Zero Earth.
“Of course. You can use the bombs right away.”
Three hydrogen bombs were prepared on a wide cart in the direction Kyungsoo was pointing.
“Just in case, I prepared two more bombs, and everybody was evacuated to the outside.”
Sungwoo deactivated the Bone Dragon, nodding at Kyungsoo.
He also had to hide inside the firewall because he was not sure what would happen if he threw the hydrogen bombs into it.
“Put them in right now. They might counterattack!”
When Kyungsoo motioned at Sungwoo’s words, two men came running.
Then they operated the button to activate the hydrogen bombs.
The priming power started working.
Soon after the uranium bomb inside detonates, the tritium contained therein will trigger a nuclear fusion reaction, causing a huge explosion.
As already seen in Zero Earth, it would be enough to blow up the whole place here.
“Throw them!”
With only 10 seconds left, they pushed the bombs into the wormhole. And they quickly ran into the firewall.
Thud-
The firewall, which was dozens of centimeters thick, was closed.
“…”
Everyone held their breath, looking at the vertical tunnel.
At that moment the vertical tunnel started pouring out cipher energy. It was refreshing to watch as if to throw up everything contained in it.
The energy that poured out like that hit the ceiling, pierced everything it touched, and spewed out into the sky.
“The building may collapse! Prepare to evacuate!”
Fortunately, the building was stronger than expected. They prepared to use their skills in case of emergency while watching the wormhole collapse.
How long has it been going on?
The vertical passage, which was slowly turning, came to a halt at last.
“…”
The light disappeared, and no energy was felt in the empty hole.
That’s how the wormhole collapsed.
“…”
The game was all over finally.
Sungwoo told Walter what happened in Zero Earth when three hydrogen bombs simultaneously exploded in one place. Then he asked what would happen to Zero Earth in the future.
Walter said that a chain of fusion reactions could have destroyed the Earth by creating a small miniature sun.
“But the odds of that happening are slim,” Sungwoo replied.
According to Walter, Zero Earth was inevitably very slow in responding because it strongly regulated particle control using nanorobots, namely, manipulation of reality, but they would be trying to operate the wormhole after removing all the radioactive material around the Bermuda Triangle by dispatching nanorobots over the next several years.
“You mean they can recover it after all?” Sungwoo asked.
Then he stood up, so did Junghoon next to him.
“Perhaps they are most likely to do so.”
Since Walter was a prisoner of war, he reacted sensitively to Sungwoo’s words and deeds and flinched whenever he said something.
“Can you continue to maintain the system?”
“Well, we can do it.”
They could maintain the game system, but since the wormhole had collapsed, they could operate it independently without any outside interference.
“But the lifespan of a nanorobot is 7 to 8 years. Without replacement of the nanorobots, the system will eventually become useless.”
It meant that the power of the system, namely, nanorobots, could be used in the next six years or so.
“I think we can use it for system recovery, right?” Junghoon said.
Sungwoo nodded at that. Restoring a broken world might take decades or hundreds of years. But with a game system like this, the recovery process would be much smoother.
“Is it possible for you to manipulate the system to produce large quantities of items or raise skills?” Sungwoo asked.
Walter said, “I’m sorry, but that’s impossible. It’s out of our control. Just because we are GMs, we can’t modify the system at will. It can be done only by ‘Alpha Sentinel’ or our head office.”
What he meant was that they could not use the system itself, but they could still use its game features. That was fortunate for Sungwoo.
“Lock him back!”
“Come on, wait a minute…”
The guards standing in front of the door came up and dragged Walter out.
Walter was very cooperative, but he had no intention of forgiving him for that.
Sungwoo had a brief discussion with Junghoon about their ‘Earth Restoration Plan’.
‘It’s all over now.’
He was not sure if Zero Earth was destroyed or not, and those still living there might try to harm someone again.
But the game met the best ending.
‘And it starts again.’
The game is over, and reality has begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 485 - Best Ending (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 485: Best Ending (3)
The party that Sungwoo had planned originally was a bit late, but it was held as promised.
Sungwoo and his allies gathered together in Suwon and the World Tree camp, enjoying victory over a grand dinner and good wine.
Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop!
The useless firework items were now being used usefully.
They could get out of fatigue just by watching the lights of the firecrackers, so they could enjoy the party longer.
A team of 158 chefs led by Hanho’s mother, Eunhee, was more active than ever while preparing food. Most of the food they made tasted so delicious, at the same time they were buff items, upgrading the quality of the party even more.
“…”
Sungwoo was watching the scene while sitting, leaning against the trunk of the world tree.
– The world tree (maturity stage 3) is growing. (91%)
The world tree was still growing. If it grew up to another level, it would reach ‘Myth Quest.’
[Myth Quest]
– Name: Race origin (Dragon people)
– Type: unknown
– Goal: Find the ‘clue to evolution’
– Reward: Evolve into a new race
*You have obtained two ‘absolute seeds’. One of them is a race that’s growing powerful right now, and the other is a vessel of life that can hold transcendent power. If the two seeds are fused under fateful conditions, they will create a new myth.
* The ‘clue to evolution’ will be revealed when an unidentified egg ‘hatches’ and the world tree reaches the ‘completed’ stage. (If either of the two seeds is damaged, you will fail.)
After confirming the message, Sungwoo was worried.
‘Should I leave this alone?’
He just felt uncomfortable about changing humans into something else after he came to know more about the system. After thinking hard, he decided to leave it alone.
‘The game system will be maintained for only six years. After 6 years, it will be restored to its original state… And if this is completed, it will help restore Earth.’
While he was thinking about it, someone came to see him.
“Oh my God, how the hero of mankind and the savior of the earth hasn’t appeared in the party?” said the King of the Great Mountains. “And how come nobody has come to invite this gentleman stuck here alone like a shabby man to the party! Man, this is absolutely bad manners!”
He threw something he was holding in his hand toward Sungwoo.
When he checked it after receiving it, it was a boiled potato.
“What the heck is this?”
Sungwoo threw it behind his back.
“Even if I can’t join the party, I don’t eat stuff like this!”
But the King of the Great Mountains sneered at him while munching potatoes.
“Really? Get you!”
He sat at the roots of the world tree.
“By the way, my lifespan was only 6 years left, so I tried to try other foods, but as you know, I’ve been eating bland potatoes, so I can’t enjoy salty foods. Man, is this the way my body has been designed?”
The King of the Great Mountains was also once a player from another world. But after the ending, his mind was recycled, and he turned into a monster.
So, when the nanomachine expired, both his body and his mind would collapse.
In hindsight, Sungwoo and Jisu were also reconstructed into nanorobots after they died, but Walter explained that they could exist as they were because they were “restored” with the original particles.
‘On the other hand, there is no way to prevent their collapse right now.’
Sungwoo told Walter about it, but he wasn’t agitated much.
“What are you thinking about now?” the king asked.
Sungwoo just shrugged his shoulders.
The king seemed to be offended by his nonchalant reaction.
“Man, you don’t want to talk with me? Come to think of it, aren’t we comrades who fought in the same spirit from the beginning? And since I was born not a long time ago, you and I are like old playmates. Don’t you think so?”
“Well, I’m sorry, but as for those guys who instilled in us a common idea, I blew them up with hydrogen bombs.”
Sungwoo was talking about the helper.
But the King of the Great Mountains said something surprising.
“Well, I’ve heard that voice, but she hasn’t come very often.”
Sungwoo looked at him and asked, “What do you mean?”
The King of the Great Mountains took out a smoking pipe from his pocket, then lit it with his finger.
“Well, I don’t know it exactly. I heard two voices ringing in my head, and I had no idea who one of them was.”
“Two voices? You mean there was another voice besides the helper’s voice?”
“Um, that’s right. But I am not a spiritual being, so I have no way of finding out the identity of this indescribable voice. I wonder if that voice has saved me.”
Suddenly Sungwoo had a lot of thoughts in his head.
“So you mean someone other than the helper helped you awaken. In other words, that guy helped you resist the system, right?”
“Yeah, that’s right.”
It was something that Sungwoo never unexpected.
“Who is that guy?”
“I don’t know him, either.”
“…”
“But that guy was not part of the system as if he was…”
The King of the Great Mountains looked up at the sky. Then, fireworks exploded and colored the sky beautifully.
“Um…I wonder if he was like a god.”
Sungwoo giggled at that.
The king said, “It’s funny, isn’t it? But there are things that you can’t prove.”
Sungwoo stood up, saying, “I don’t believe in God.”
As it was often said, if there was God, He would not have tolerated things like Zero Earth.
But Sungwoo wondered if He existed.
‘Then it’s not God but the devil.’
Just like the people in Zero Earth, that devil must have watched the hellish situation on Earth and taken the human sacrifices as no more than enjoyment.
The King of the Great Mountains nodded, saying, “Right. I don’t think such a guy exists.”
Then the king raised his hand. Then another bundle of roots came up from the gap between the roots of the World Tree and started to make a long bridge leading to the party place.
some long bridges.
It was the bridge leading to the party venue.
“Today you, not God, have achieved something great, so hurry up and join them at the party. Enjoy! That’s your blessing as well as your duty.”
As the king said, Sungwoo soon headed to the party place and walked right into the middle of the festival.
Rattle! Rattle!
Sungwoo’s skeletons were carrying plates of food to the party participants. He mobilized as many undead members as he could, so they could fully enjoy the party.
While he was passing through the crowds, he heard some familiar voice from somewhere.
Rattle!
It was Orun.
Rattle! Rattle! Rattle!
When he discovered Sungwoo, he was grinding his teeth, but he looked shabby.
Half of his face was blue and the other half was red because he was surrounded by children who were pasting his face with colored pencils.
“No, get away from me!”
It looked as if he was asking their attention because of his grinding teeth.
“Necromancer, aren’t these children a bit mischievous?” Minsok said.
He took off his armor and wore a white shirt. Since he was a skeleton, he looked bizarre, wearing a shirt, but somehow he fit into the atmosphere.
“I told them not to, but Orun would not resist today…”
It seemed that Minsok felt uncomfortable about them making fun of his fellow fighter Orun, who was also one of Sungwoo’s trusted subordinate spirits.
“That’s fine. Don’t worry and take a break.”
Minsok would also disappear after 6 years because he was born in a completely different way than Sungwoo.
“It’s been a while since we enjoyed a party like this. And the children are proud of me as the hero who has saved the world rather than being afraid of me. What a relief!” Minsok said.
Was this a fortunate occasion? They looked so happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 486 - Best Ending (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 486: Best Ending (4)
Minsok said, “Call me anytime if you have any problems. I am very proud to be able to save my family and other people by fighting with you, Necromancer.”
“You’re welcome. I could always beat them thanks to your help, sir.”
Sungwoo briefly wondered if it was good that he had resurrected Minsok and had him fight as his ally.
‘Well, it might be the right thing to do, but that’s my best option back then.’
After greeting Minsok, he stepped inside the party hall.
“Necromancer! Thank you very much!”
“Today is really fun! Thanks!”
Those at the party, who already drunk a lot, welcomed Sungwoo a lot, but they didn’t approach him, for his gravitas was too big for them to come up to him thoughtlessly.
“Gosh, I’m serious!” This time Li Wei shouted. “It’s me who has saved you!”
She was sitting at the same table with Isabella and Heyon, engaged in a heated argument over something.
For some reason, Heyon was sick and tired of their argument, with herself sandwiched between the two nasty women.
“Gosh, how ungrateful you are! I’m just dumbfounded,” Li Wei said.
Having heard that, Isabella gulped down a whole glass of beer and sneered at her.
“What did you say? How come you little bitch has saved me?”
When she picked up a piece of chicken and put it into her mouth, her throat burned red.
Then she took out her Dragon Breath slightly to roast it, then swallowed instantly.
“…”
Li Wei watched that scene, stopped talking for a minute, then began to fume again.
“What the heck are you talking about? Why are you so conceited? You don’t remember it because you passed out then.”
“Hey, don’t start picking a fight!”
“What did you say? I was a bit tired at that moment. How could a dragon like me pass out? You are dumb!”
“Don’t fight!”
“Ugh? Oh, Necromancer? Hey! Can you explain to her?”
But Sungwoo avoided them and headed to another place.
Junghoon and Minhum were chatting at a large table in the center of the party hall.
Seated at the same table were American guests such as Chairman Love, Hearst, and Jonathan, and human beasts such as the White Wolf and the Black Lion.
“…”
They gestured toward Sungwoo with eye contact, but Sungwoo gently nodded, then passed by them.
He didn’t want to chat with them in a happy mood yet.
“Oh, Mom! I’m going to enjoy the party, too!”
Han-ho was arguing with his mother Eunhee in one corner of the hall.
“Gosh, why is it so hard for me to come to the kitchen and help me a bit? You’ve got as many as eight hands, but you don’t want to help me?”
As if he was frustrated, Hanho waved six of his arms back and forth.
“Mom, I am a hero, too! Do you think it makes sense for a hero to do chores?”
“Phew! Yeah, I appreciate that, so don’t make a big fuss over it!”
However, there was someone who was watching them with interest.
“Man, even brother Hanho gets a good scolding from his mother!”
It was Youngin who followed Hanho very well.
Discovering him, Hanho’s face blushed.
“Oops! Mom, I was kidding. I can do it as your son, Mom!”
When Sungwoo passed them, Jisu was sitting at a small table in a corner.
Mir was lying under her feet, chewing a bone.
“Jisu!”
“Oh, you are here!”
Grr- Grr-
Mir ran to Sungwoo, who picked him up and sat across from her.
“Where is your sister?”
“Oh, she went back to Jeju Island right away.”
It looked like she was more concerned with her family than enjoying the party.
“Then did she go to bring her family here?”
Jisu smiled bitterly, shaking her head.
“I don’t think so. My family members are so conservative and stubborn that they hate leaving their hometown and going to another place. I don’t think I’d be very happy to see them here.”
She poured some water into a cup and gave it to him.
“Well, it’s good for me!”
“For what?”
“Well, I met you on campus first and followed you, right? I made a good decision. I didn’t know things would develop so big like this.”
Sungwoo smiled at her, nodding.
“You bet. Nobody expected it!”
It all started when he picked up the cards that appeared out of nowhere and killed the goblins that came up suddenly. Nobody imagined even that would happen, so how could anybody have thought of this kind of ending at the end of the day?
“And I’m glad that I could help you without being a burden to you.”
She was constantly concerned about it from the beginning. Proving her worth and usefulness to him was tough, but she made a huge success, after all.
“But it’s not over yet. I think there are still lots of things you can help me with in the future.”
She silently nodded. She will be a stronger ally than anyone else for him in the future.
“Sungwoo! Sis Jisu! You are here!”
At that moment Hanho was approaching them, humming to himself.
“Look at this!”
He was holding a bunch of things with six hands. Each of them was a 500cc beer mug.
“Alright! Let’s have a drink among ourselves!”
Hanho made ice on the surface of beer using cold energy, one of Hyunmu’s powers.
“Don’t waste your mana.”
After Sungwoo learned hos mana, or all one’s abilities and items were created, he couldn’t use the skills freely. All of that was designed to reconstruct the resources on Earth through the nanorobot.
“Oh, man! Sungwoo, we all know you are the real hero of this fight, but don’t try to teach me a lesson!”
“What did you say?”
Instead of answering, Hanho quickly distributed the beer mug.
“Please, cheers!”
Sungwoo and Jisu reluctantly raised their mug.
“Come on, cheers!”
“…”
“…”
Clang!
Anyway, they enjoyed the party, too.
The party that lasted into the small wee hours was finally over.
The next day special drinks that helped them relieve their hangover, made by the cooks, were distributed to the frontline commanders.
And at 3 pm that afternoon they held an “emergency commander meeting.”
“What the heck is going on?”
They thought they could take a break at least for a few days, but because of the sudden emergency meeting, the commanders hurriedly dragged their tired bodies to the conference room.
“I have no idea. Oops, my head is starting to pound!”
Sungwoo was already seated after arriving early, and Inho was preparing the briefing.
“The meeting will start pretty soon, so please take a seat!”
Soon they were seated, and the meeting began.
“We’ve got three agendas today, recovery of Earth plan, defense of Earth plan, and…”
Then Inho looked at Sungwoo before resuming.
“The last one is to train ourselves against the alien attack.”
They opened their eyes wide at his words.
“What did you say?”
“Alien attack?”
They were embarrassed.
“Who are we attacking?”
Wasn’t the fight all over? Was there any more fight?
They cast their glances at Sungwoo.
So he said, “It has been confirmed that the wormhole has collapsed, disconnecting us from the alien world.”
Even though Sungwoo didn’t annihilate the enemy, he removed the passage to their world, so the war was virtually over.
“But we didn’t know until recently that there was a passage leading to the alien world. That means there might be something else going on in the place that we don’t know.”
Everyone nodded at that.
“So we need a plan to defend Earth against their attack!”
They understood his point.
“But the thing is just defending is not enough. As long as there are enemies, the crisis will continue. I’m still vague about this idea, but we need to study the system and come up with a way to fight it somehow.”
It was unthinkable for them to confront Zero Earth right now, but they could not afford to sit idle.
“If the door opens again…”
Everyone looked at Sungwoo. At that moment, his eyes seemed to glow dark green.
“We will have to slay all our enemies first in order not to go extinct…”
He was determined to get rid of anything standing in his way except for the corpses.
That was the essential role of the Necromancer.

chapters.title: Chapter 487 - Age After Ending (1)
chapters.content:
Chapter 487: Age After Ending (1)
The game was over.
More precisely, the game as a play that was driving this world into destruction was over with the ‘best ending’. It was the achievement that the Necromancer made by killing the GMs and destroying the passage to the alien world.
However, its ‘game trait,’ or ‘system’ was maintained, which opened a completely new age.
“Well, it is the age of ‘post ending.”
Someone’s voice was coming out from the studio where the ON AIR light was flickering.
“This is an era when the system is intact but there is no manager. This is an era when the system has become a natural phenomenon, and we have become the voluntary players or those who work tirelessly to conquer and develop such a natural phenomenon.”
Reporter Ahn, or, who was now called ‘Director Ahn’, was broadcasting in a spacious studio, as usual.
Judging by the professional equipment and dozens of staff filling the well-organized studio, it seemed that his studio was functioning as a proper broadcasting station.
“And finally we’ve come to this point today.”
After he announced with such a prelude, he moved toward another place, and the camera was filming him from behind.
As he said, today was a bit of a special day. A title was engraved in the upper left corner of the broadcast screen.
– Special Broadcast on the 1st Anniversary of Ending: The era of the Necromancer and the World Tree, and our age. What about the next age?
“Okay, how have you been in your life until now?”
Director Ahn stopped in front of the big screen and spoke very seriously.
“On the 1st anniversary of the ending, we want to take a moment to look back on what happened to us in the past year. Now, let’s go back to the past with me.”
The screen has changed.
Director Ahn disappeared from the screen, and the towering world tree filled the screen. His voice echoed through the scene while he was narrating the scenes.
“It all started well because the Necromancer’s rule was successful, to be honest.”
Then some video started playing all of a sudden.
Woooooooooo-
The screen showed the scenes of the World Tree fleet passing through the ‘Hyperspace’ and entering the shadow of the World Tree. It was exactly showing them returning from the Bermuda Triangle a year ago.
Then the screen closed up the man in the dark green robe, namely the Necromancer, getting off from the Messenger.
Even though he went through a series of harsh battles involving the Absolute Races, the Demon King, and GMs, he had a calm and expressionless face as usual.
Everyone warmly welcomed him fervently.
“As Earth’s savior and the most powerful player on Earth, the Necromancer has restored order and peace on this world that seemed to have been lost forever. Who can refute my statement?”
Then the video played the scenes of a large-scale party held in the World Tree camp. Various foods were on display, and people laughed, chatted, and danced happily. There were also some people taking pictures with the skeletons carrying food. It looked like a documentary video that was reminiscent of the distant past.
Another screen appeared.
“After the war and the party are over, our new lives have begun. We have progressed incredibly quickly.”
It showed the scenes of people rebuilding the destroyed city.
Heavy machinery and trucks passed through the city center of Suwon. The warriors carried construction materials, and the wizards demolished those buildings that they could not restore. The priests gave them the blessings of fatigue reliefs.
“We have kept developing like that.”
At that moment a group attacked the site.
They were a bunch of ogres. There were still some monster remnants all over the city.
“Well, there were often obstacles like this, but they weren’t a big problem.”
The scene of their raid ended with the ogre bodies piling up in a slaughterhouse.
“We hunted monsters, collected items, and rebuilt the lost world quickly. Under the leadership of the Necromancer and World Tree camp, everything went smoothly and very quickly. It seemed like we could restore our former glory at any moment.”
Then, the video capturing the World Tree camp in a distant view was fast-forwarded, showing the city center around the world tree developing at a tremendous speed.
Director Ahn’s image appeared among them, then he strode out over the city center.
Then he spread his arms left and right.
“Our world has gotten taller and wider every day.”
Whenever he moved, the skyscrapers rose, and large magic engineering factories mushroomed. Dozens or hundreds of airships flew over his head, then disappeared repeatedly. Behind his back, the trunk of the world tree grew steeply, extending its shadow. Finally, a huge city was born.
“This is Asadal, the center of the new world…”
The name of the city was ‘Asadal’. It was named after the capital city of Gojoseon, the old Korea, protected by the sacred tree ‘Sindansu’.
“It seemed that we would live in peace for hundreds of years, and I also really thought so. But something unexpected happened one day.”
The moment he stopped speaking, the screen stopped.
Director Ahn’s face was closed up, and he shook his head with a grim expression on his face.
“We realized that there was no peace in our glory…”
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
Explosions erupted from his left and right, and the buildings collapsed. Then when he turned his head to the left, those with fierce expressions ran out with weapons.
One of them shouted, “Burn the world tree!”
Someone was attacking the World Tree camp, but this time it was players, not monsters.
“They have begun terrorism…”
Explosions, flames, magic, shouts, and bloodstains appeared on the screen for a while.
“Yeah, this is what happened. When peace came, the wrong ideas of the past, such as Sinocentrism, Islamic extremism, white supremacy, nationalism, and regionalism began to grow again with peace as their nutrients. They joined forces to break free from the control of the World Tree camp, and thus a new war began.”
A red font appeared on the screen.
– O R I G I N A L S
“They call themselves ‘Originals’. It means that they will seize the power of the earth as ‘original human beings’ who have not been manipulated by the system.”
Originals.
Interpreted as they were, they were like fundamentalists.
This meant that they denied control based on the power of the system, and pursued humanity’s natural values such as religion and science, but in reality, they were also fighting by using the system.
“We have once again entered an era of violence. The Originals launched all kinds of attacks to overthrow the Necromancer and the World Tree camp.”
At that moment someone ran into the screen.
“Director Ahn…”
He was a staff member of the broadcasting station. He whispered into Director Ahn urgently.
It was a scene close to a broadcasting accident, which meant that the situation was urgent enough right now.
“…”
Ahn’s expression hardened.
“…”
He took his breath and looked back at the camera, slowly opening his mouth.
“I am sorry, viewers. I think I have to end the special broadcast here. From now on, I’m going to give you some breaking news.”
The title at the top of the screen changed in an instant.
-Breaking News: Originals conducted the 13th terrorist attack on Asadal. Tree guards are checking the situation right now!
“The Originals resumed their terrorist attacks again while the Necromancer was away. This is already the third terrorist attack they launched in the past week. This time…”
He stared at the camera and continued in a more low voice.
“It seems the situation is a bit serious. The commander of the Tree Guard, also known as the Guard Captain, has been allegedly kidnapped.”
One of the heroes of the World Tree camp has been kidnapped.

chapters.title: Chapter 488 - Age After Ending (2)
chapters.content:
Chapter 488: Age After Ending (2)
Yes, that was true. There is no Necromancer in Asadal right now.
It had been 23 days since he was away from it for some reason.
His absence was strictly confidential, but it leaked through unknown channels.
After that, the Originals began to launch outright terrorist attacks over the past several days because the World Tree camp was weaker than ever without the Necromancer.
“Yes, this is an opportunity we will never see again.”
A loud voice resounded through the abandoned factory.
Squeak-
A half-torn iron door opened, and somebody entered the factory illegally.
“Welcome, judge!”
Those waiting in the factory stepped aside to the left and right, and the one who came in with heavy steps, a Hispanic man wearing sunglasses, appeared. And a bald man greeted him and said, “Welcome, Judge. I’m sorry for greeting you at this shabby place like this…”
“Is that the guy you mentioned?”
The man called “judge” pointed to a prisoner tied to a pole by nodding.
The prisoner had his hands tied, and given the purple chain icon floating on the rope, it looked like he was bound with a magic item. By design, he could never be freed from it. So the judge approached the prisoner.
“Yes. He is the commander of the Tree Guard.”
The prisoner was none other than Hanho, the commander of the ‘Tree Guard’ that protected Asadal, the city where the World Tree was growing.
“…”
Hanho was on his knees, with his head down deeply. It didn’t look like he was hurt, but did he pass out?
However, the man in sunglasses didn’t care about it, approached him, and looked closely at the back of his head.
“You tied his hands well and retrieved all the items from him, right?”
“Of course.”
Even though Hanho was tied up, the man couldn’t let down his guard. He knew that after all, Hanho was the 3rd strongest player in the Korean server rankings. What’s more, he was one of the only 11 players equipped with ‘divine power’ that existed in the world. If he was allowed to run wildly after being freed, it would be impossible for them to have him under control by themselves.
So Adrian, the judge from the Spanish server, examined Hanho while holding his breath as much as possible.
‘Honestly, I can’t be his rival yet.’
Adrian was ranked 3rd in the Spanish server, and he was one of Europe’s best ice wizards. But he was well aware that he could not dare rival those on the Korean server.
What’s more, Hanho was the guy equipped with Hyunmoo, ranked as one of the best players on the Korean server.
‘But he is defenseless because they took his items and tied him down, so he can’t use any skills.’
So the judge double-checked that they tied Hanho’s arms tightly. He knew that
Hanho had six arms.
‘But he doesn’t have a cloak, so we’re fine.”
He could use six arms only by the power of the ‘Asura’s Cloak’ item, so it would not be possible for him to use his arms since they took all his items.
“Alright…”
After rolling his eyes quickly and thinking hard about various factors, Adrian, who had been tight-lipped, opened his mouth.
“Okay, I see one of the heroes of the World Tree camp finally tied in front of me like this!”
A member of the Originals brought an iron chair behind him.
He sat down on the chair, crossed his legs arrogantly, and looked down at Hanho.
“Alright, Turtle! My name is Adrian, one of the judges of the Originals.”
But Hanho couldn’t answer because he had a gag in his mouth.
Adrian shoved his hand into his pockets, then raised his head.
He continued, “We’re going to have plenty of time to talk between us because I’ve got a lot of questions for you. I’m very curious about where the Necromancer is right now, and what the heck he is doing. You know that, right? If you don’t have the Necromancer, we can…”
Crunch!
At that moment a strange noise was heard, followed by a brief silence.
Tilting his head, the judge looked back at the members of his organization.
They did not seem to understand what that noise was, so the judge continued as if nothing happened.
“Let me pick up where I said last. Everybody knows that without the Necromancer, you guys would collapse quickly. Today might be your last day for survival…”
Crunch!
“Ugh? Well, I already know that even Valkyrie went out to kill the raid boss monster born in Australia! That’s your limit. Instead of relying on your determination and conviction, you guys try to rely on the game system that came in from the outside…”
Crunch!
A strange noise kept ringing, so Adrian’s eyebrows twitched. He turned his head and looked at the gang member on standby.
“What the heck is that noise?”
The members of the Originals looked at each other.
“Ah, well…”
All of them were on alert when they heard a strange noise repeatedly.
Crunch!
The same strange noise was heard again. This time it was less jarring than before.
“Ugh?”
At that moment, Adrian and his men turned their heads toward the source of the sound.
It was Hanho, the prisoner tied to the pole.
“Hahaha! I’ve been caught!”
Hanho looked up at Adrian and smiled at him.
Crunch!
An unidentified hand coming out from inside Hanho’s jacket was secretly taking out the gag from his mouth, and another hand that passed over his shoulder was putting a fistful of popcorn in his mouth.
Crunch! Crunch!
Adrian and the Original members now began to understand why Hanho had been lowering his head. They frowned right away.
“What the heck is this?”
Tung!
Stunned, Adrian stepped back, knocking over the iron chair. He took off his sunglasses, looked at Hanho, and pointed a finger at him.
“Man, he’s got arms! You guys said you had taken all his items, right?”
Hanho’s real arms were tied with magic, so two more arms protruded from his behind.
“Ah? We have confiscated his cloak!”
One of the members protested, turning his head.
Several Hanho’s items were placed on the dusty old desk, and about a dozen members of the Originals were guarding them. The cloak was there.
“I’m sure!” he argued.
At that moment, Hanho opened his mouth with a grin.
“Brother Inho, can you hear that? I succeeded in eating that popcorn 4 times! Didn’t I win? As promised, you have to give me 2 high-definition photo books of succubus. Hahaha…”
Hanho seemed to be talking to someone. Then he looked at Adrian and smiled bitterly.
“Man, I felt as if I would have an upset stomach because I had to chew popcorn with my head down! Well, it was thrilling anyway. You guys had experience eating snacks sneakily at school when you’re children, right? Well, that reminds me of those young days!”
Suddenly, four arms crawled out from behind his back. And then they untied the ropes around his body! Since he was sort of a priest, it seemed that he could use the skill ‘Charm Dispel’.
“Ugh?”
Watching the prisoner rising after freeing the shackles by himself, all the members of the Originals in the abandoned factory were stunned.
“Uh, how could he….”
But Hanho stretched out leisurely. A black tattoo could be seen on the skin on the back of his T-shirt. It was in the shape of a palm.
“I find this a bit strange too. I didn’t know I could use this tattoo with a tattoo!”
Advanced ‘magic engineering’ made things beyond humans’ common sense possible. It developed by combining various technologies and disciplines, and ‘magical biology’ was one of them.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 - Age After Ending (3)
chapters.content:
Chapter 489: Age After Ending (3)
A striking example of magic engineering was ‘body enchant’, which could transfer item power into ‘tattoos’ engraved on one’s body. It was a bit risky, but it was used in such a clever way.
“I heard that GMs could decipher its technology because it was that of human beings in the future. After all, this is great technology!” Hanho shouted.
To be more specific, they could have some control over ‘nanotechnology’ by being able to modify the state of the nanobots in one’s body to a limited extent.
“But, it’s so hip that a native-born nerd like me feels a bit embarrassed to use it…”
Hanho could use some of the effects of the ‘Asura Cloak’ through the tattoo engraved on his back. He scratched the tattoo on his back as if he was embarrassed. It seemed that this had nothing to do with the so-called cycle of the zodiac.
“To put it simply, if you don’t know about it, you are counterattacked like this, you idiots!”
When Hanho took one step closer to them, they took three steps backward.
“Hehehe…”
Watching them terrified by him, Hanho had the delusion that he became a tiger.
“By the way, you must be the judge, right?”
“…” Adrian didn’t answer.
Hanho said, “Good for you! I was wondering if I had to chase you endlessly, but you’re here before me like this! I’ve got a windfall!”
As a key executive of The Originals, the judge probably knew lots of important secrets. Only then did Adrian realize that he was stabbed in the back by Hanho.
“Did you let yourself get caught to lure me from the beginning?” Adrian asked.
“Of course, but I didn’t know you came out to me voluntarily like this!”
Adrina was embarrassed to hear that. He immediately took out a small wand from his pocket and aimed it at Hanho. At the same time, dozens of Original members drew their weapons.
“Man, calm down, friends! Shall we talk over popcorn?”
Hanho’s fourth arm on the right held out a small bag of popcorn.
Given that the world tree was engraved on the bag, he must have bought it from a new theater in the eastern part of Asadal.
“Where did you hide the popcorn?”
One member who had been searching for Hanho’s body asked. He found it very strange that he could not find any popcorn.
“Well, it’s my secret. A top-secret.”
Hanho’s face blushed as if he was embarrassed.
“Shut up! Don’t move! No matter how strong you are, you can’t survive in this situation where your hands are bound!”
Then Hanho glanced around and scratched the back of his head with his third arm.
“Hey, folks! Think about it a little more. Do you think I didn’t prepare anything when I brought popcorn here secretly?”
Then his index finger on his second arm slowly lifted and pointed to his neck. There was a black birthmark there.
“Can you see this? This is not something like a blessed birthmark.”
Even that was ‘body enchantment’. In other words, it was a tattoo with the effect of location tracking disguised as a costume.
At that moment there was an explosion.
Bang!
An explosion was heard from the ceiling, and the concrete and rebar collapsed. A pure white light burst through the hole and lit Hanho. The members of the Originals who were standing around covered their faces with their hands, then hurriedly retreated.
Woooooooo-
All of a sudden, four airships were floating in the sky over the abandoned factory, illuminating the area with dozens of searchlights.
“Descend! Descend! Descend!”
With a roaring shout, players in black jumped off.
Thud! Thud! Thud! Thud!
They rolled on the ground, and took their postures, then using a short-distance Teleport, they quickly closed the distance and attacked the Originals members. Thirteen members nearby who were standing nearby were instantly subdued.
“Don’t move!”
But those who stood at a distance made the wrong choice.
“Damn it! Shoot!”
“Secure the way out!”
Pick! Pick! Pick! Pick! Pick! Pick!
As soon as they tried to resist my attack recklessly, I fired arrows at their eyes, necks, and hearts. All of a sudden, those armed with “repeating crossbows” were occupying the upper floors of the abandoned factory and monitoring the entire interior.
“If you don’t want to die, don’t move!”
“How dare you try to resist?”
They were the special forces of the World Tree camp, namely, the 213th Squadron.
Their predecessor was the Special Commando Unit, which was made up of all elite players of level 20 or higher. They were known as the 3rd strongest army in the World Tree camp, so they could subdue almost all servers with a single operation alone.
Crunch! Crunch!
While crunching popcorn, Hanho leisurely walked through the mess to retrieve his stolen items and wear them back.
“They are running away! Stop them!”
“Catch them! Capture them alive as much as you can!”
Meanwhile, the special forces’ crackdown continued everywhere inside the abandoned factory. They subdued those escaping from the abandoned factory by freezing the entrance with freezing magic, with the airship illuminating them with a searchlight.
“Damn it!”
Adrian tried to escape from this place in a hurry, but Hanho was blocking his way.
“Wait a moment. You told me you had a lot to talk about with me, right?”
“No, I’ve got nothing to talk about with you. Just go away!”
“Really? Come to think of it, you have made me upset!”
Adrian raised his wand to be on guard against him. Even though he could not beat Hanho, he thought he could run away successfully.
Crunch! Crunch!
Hanho crunched popcorn with an annoyed expression.
“By the way, why do you think we can’t survive without the Necromancer?”
That was Adrian’s big miscalculation. The World Tree camp that grew up with the Necromancer and developed under his protection was stronger than they thought.
“As for me, I’m a pretty mighty man! My level is a whopping 40, and I’m the 3rd strongest on the Korean server rankings! I’m not weak enough for you to look down on me! And my level gap with the Necromancer is only 19!”
Hanho raised his head and roared like a Pomeranian who never gave in even among large dogs. In other words, he vented his frustration like that because he finally obtained the title of a hero after he had been sandwiched between Sungwoo and Jisu for a long time.
At that moment somebody threw cold water over his eloquent speech.
“No, you are wrong.”
“Ugh?”
“I’m sorry, but your level gap is 20!” Inho cut in.
He suddenly appeared in the abandoned factory. While approaching Hanho, he shot something at Adrian.
Puck!
A net spread and covered Adrian, which spread an electric current to electrocute him.
“Argh…”
“Uh-huh….”
Hanho didn’t even look at him.
“Oh, brother Inho, when did you come? And what did you say?”
“Your level gap with Sungwoo is back to 20. Look!”
Shaking his head, he threw the phone at Hanho.
Hanho received it with his third left arm.
“Really?”
[KOR Server Ranking (Page 1)]
kor-157 (LV. 60)kor-339 (LV. 49)Hanho (LV. 40)Yeongdeungpo Prosecutor’s Office (LV. 39)Choi Yoon (LV. 31)
“What the heck!”
Sungwoo leveled up again before Hanho knew it. His level was 59 this morning, but he leveled up again in several hours!
Level 60 was unprecedented.
Given that there are no players above level 50 in the whole world except him, it’s even impossible to imagine how high level 60 is.
“Man, how has he reached level 60? He has gone into hiding to level up secretly? I wish he had taken me with him.”

chapters.title: Chapter 490 - Age After Ending (4)
chapters.content:
Chapter 490: Age After Ending (4)
The Necromancer’s rule began a year ago.
Then, who was the first to rebel against his rule? Most of them were once the losers who had been defeated by him. And those who had various dissident ideologies were united to establish the organization, ‘Originals’.
“The Necromancer has taken everything from us,” a gray-haired old man said, reflecting on his past. Then a young woman standing next to him with her hands folded politely nodded quietly.
“Yeah, he has taken everything I have achieved all my life…”
The woman nodded again. Given her unanimous consent, it seemed she was not just a companion to talk with.
“So now it’s time for us to get even on him, and as far as I know, it’s the way of the world.”
It was none other than Younghwan Lee, the so-called “bulldozer” chairman and the head of the Uijeongbu “Reconstruction Alliance,” who vented his frustration and rage.
He once aimed at taking hegemony over the Korean server, but he went into hiding after he was defeated by the Necromancer in Mt. Pukhan’s Imoogi Cave. But he eventually survived and established himself as a key member of the Originals.
But he was sitting on a bench, watching a magical phenomenon unfolding before his eyes.
Woooooooo-
“If we can succeed in that magic experiment, we can defeat the Necromancer.”
“Of course. I think you can realize whatever you do, Chairman.”
Hundreds of wizards were creating magic. They painstakingly cast a trickery spell over the whole mountain for the past several days not to get caught by the World Tree camp.
Woooooooooo-
The magical phenomenon, which flashed red, gave off strange yet eerie energy.
“Chairman, a guest has just arrived,” said the woman standing next to him.
The old man nodded, then turned his head to the left.
“…”
Given that he was overlooking the ‘Suwon World Cup Stadium’ at a distance, he was probably in a mountain temple at the foot of a mountain on the outskirts of Suwon.
“Damned world tree!”
He could see the world tree over the World Cup Stadium. The giant sacred tree was so huge that he felt as if it stood right before his eyes.
And under its shadow, or more precisely under the branches that glistened with a dazzling light, a magnificent city named Asadal was growing in prosperity day by day.
“I’m going to cut down that tree by all means…”
Wooooooooooooo-
As soon as he said that, a certain magical phenomenon that was taking place before his eyes came to an end. And a slightly stable light waved before him, then colored his face. Something was finally accomplished.
“Chairman Lee, have you been waiting for me for a long time?”
Somebody spoke to him in a deep voice.
“Ah, Z, you have come just in time.”
“I’m relieved to hear that.”
Rattle- Rattle-
Then he moved his heavy steps toward the chairman.
“Z, you’ve come to this place. Are you okay?”
“Well, I’m fine because I used the Hypergate, and you’re not going to have another day like today.”
The man named Z was an unusual figure. He appeared to be over two meters tall and wore a purple iron mask with purple scales of armor. And he was carrying an iron case as big as his size on his back.
Thud-
When he put down the iron case on the ground, sand and dust rose from it.
“Is this the ultimate magic?”
“Yes.”
“…”
“I’m going to blow up that world tree and that whole city.”
“Can you do it?”
When Z showed some skeptical reaction, Chairman Lee took a deep breath and opened his mouth.
“Hey, Z, let me assure you that even though the Necromancer has spent the last year achieving lots of things, I’ve spent the same amount of time solely preparing to break it down. He was in a better working environment than me, but wouldn’t it be easier to destroy anything than to build it? I never make mistakes when I deal with something easy. That’s the basics of business.”
Z nodded silently. Since he was wearing a strange mask, Chairman Lee couldn’t see his expression.
‘I just can’t figure out whether he agrees with me.’
Even though he tasted the sweets and bitterness of life, this veteran old man could not figure out what kind of expression this giant guy made inside that bizarre mask.
“It looks like Adrian has been caught. Do you see any possible disruption to our large-scale summoning operation?”
“Oh, no problem at all. As long as those idiots can draw their attention a bit, they will have fulfilled their duty faithfully.”
“I see. I think you have a different mindset as a businessman. It’s good that you have come to see me.”
“My pleasure. It’s good you accept me like this. Thanks for helping this old man proceed with my last business freely like this.”
Z nodded again, without saying a word.
“…”
At that moment the chairman agonized over what to say. It’s been a long time since he agonized over it. Since he was young, he had never seen anybody bossing him around.
Then his eyes rested on the black iron case on the floor.
“Is this box supposed to contain that sword?” he asked.
Z slowly turned his head and looked at him. He seemed to be a bit wary.
“Exactly.”
“This is that very X…Kali….”
Chairman Lee recited that word very carefully. He couldn’t even pronounce its last syllable. He acted with extreme humbleness as if he would be in big trouble if he mentioned it recklessly, thinking it was like a royal name. Then he checked out Z’s expressions.
“…”
But Z turned his head away without responding.
“With this sword and your divine power, don’t you think you can behead the Necromancer? I think you can without any difficulty, based on my actual observation of your capabilities.”
Z looked at Chairman Lee secretly and then looked straight ahead again.
A light breath was let out from inside his mask.
“I don’t know. There is no absolute thing in this world.”
Chairman Lee got nervous at his skeptical response. He was embarrassed and restless just like he felt as a young businessman when the politician in his constituency showed a cold reaction to his flattery.
Then Z said again, “But after blowing up that tree, I think I can build a kingdom on its ruins.”
Only then did Chairman Lee come to know the meaning of his reply. It was Z’s indirect request to him to carry out the task assigned to him perfectly. And that was a positive answer in his eyes.
“I will lay the foundation for your goal,” said the chairman.
“…”
“Z, you deserve it. Didn’t the owner of the voice that the Necromancer allegedly heard, or the helper, come to you first?”
Z laughed for the first time.
“That’s true. But I kicked her out.”
In the meantime, the 213th Task Force completely occupied the abandoned factory outside Suwon.
It was about 5km away from Asadal, the headquarters of the World Tree camp.
“If you move, you will be killed. If you move your hand or open your mouth, you will be killed, too. And if you lift your head, you will also be killed.”
The task force members lined up the captured members of the Originals.
They totaled 41.
“They are a lot. Did they have any festivals?”
“If we add up the guys inside, I think they will number more than 100.”
Given that they were not cracked down completely, they were unusually large.

chapters.title: Chapter 491 - Age After Ending (5)
chapters.content:
Chapter 491: Age After Ending (5)
The fact that an organization specializing in small-scale terrorism, not guerrilla warfare, moved its members massively was rather ominous.
“Man, I feel scared.”
The situation was unusual.
“If this is the case, the control room people must be pretty busy.”
“I guess they are going to shut down the wall completely.”
The ‘General Control Room’, headed by Kyungsoo, was in charge of controlling all the areas of Asadal, but after they heard the unusual situation, they upgraded their security alertness.
“Ah, damn it!”
At that moment Hanho and Inho ran out of the abandoned factory.
“Oh my God, Brother Inho, how come you missed him?”
It seemed they ran into trouble.
“Who are you blaming now? You were closer to him!”
“But you’re in charge there, and I was a prisoner!”
While the two let down their guards, judge Adrian succeeded in escaping there.
escaped.
He was bound by a special ‘electric’ net made by the Hearst Workshop, so they thought the net was enough to bind him tightly, but as it turned out, that was a big mistake.
“Damn it. Just hop in!”
Hanho and Inho hurriedly boarded a Hippogriff to soar into the sky, then boarded the airship ‘Udum’, which was floating nearby at the moment. They hurriedly entered the control deck of the airship.
“I don’t think he escaped far.”
Inho ordered the deck crew to search for Adrian, then took the captain’s chair. It was the airship admiral’s chair he sat down on. Inho was playing the role of the admiral of the World Tree Fleet.
“Because he had that item, we could not stop him from escaping.”
“What? You should have tied his hands as soon as you caught him!”
“…”
As one of the ‘judges’ who were the senior managers of Originals, Adrian seemed to have prepared a way out for his safety.
“I didn’t know he had it.”
“Stop trying to make excuses!”
Adrian used the so-called ‘random jumper’, which was a very valuable item that made it possible for its owner to randomly ‘teleport’ to within 500m in any situation.
Checking the situation board, Inho opened his mouth.
“Considering that the judge appeared here in person, it looks like he was here simply to rub us the wrong way.”
“Well, isn’t it strange that he tried to kidnap me from the beginning? He had a secret plan.”
After discovering that the Necromancer was absent, they increased their activities drastically. Since there was no guy who they feared most, it’s no wonder they began to go on a wild rampage.
‘They don’t want to miss this golden opportunity.’
Inho contacted the General Control Office of Asadal to upgrade the security alertness. Since the judge was around, there was a possibility that a large-scale terrorist attack would occur at any moment.
At that moment one of the deck crew said, “Admiral, the ‘White Wolf Forensics Team’ of the Strategic Intelligence Bureau has arrived at the scene.”
The White Wolf Forensics Team belonged to the ‘Strategic Intelligence Bureau’, an intelligence agency headed by Junghoon, where those who could detect trace detection or track down the opponent with capabilities like psychometry played a role in identifying and tracking the enemy that threatened security.
Major members of the team were human beasts such as ‘White Wolf’ and ‘Black Lion’, and the White Wolf, who had psychometric abilities, was in charge of the team’s forensic unit.
“Alright. Was the item that the judge dropped a wand? Tell him to check it out right away.”
If they arrived here, they would certainly find some clues to track down Adrian.
Woooooooooooo-
Those airships floating in the sky over the abandoned factory dispersed and laid out searchlights in all directions.
“Whew…it’s alright. Since we already identified him, catching him is a matter of time.”
But Inho didn’t hide his nervousness while saying so because he felt somewhat strange. Among other things, he was pretty much concerned that the Necromancer or Valkyrie was not here.
‘They think this is a unique opportunity to attack us and will try to mobilize almost all their resources. In other words, they must have prepared a more powerful attack than usual.”
Shortly afterward, his uneasiness became a reality.
“We’ve discovered a hypergate in front!”
Inho got up from his seat, shouting, “Damn it! Hypergate?”
He could see a large blue portal rising from the ruins of the city center at a distance. This meant that there would soon occur a large-scale spatial movement.
“Surround the Hypergate!”
Woooooooooooo-
Three airships dispersed in three directions and surrounded the Hypergate.
Then the special commando members came down from the airships, landed on the roof of the abandoned building, then got ready to sniper the enemy while some of them began to deploy small aerial weapons.
“The eastern settlement of Asadal is only five kilometers away! Whatever comes out of the Hypergate, you must never allow them to get out of this area!”
They moved around busily in Inho’s direction.
“Brother Inho, that must be something like a Beast Terrorism right?”
“Mabe…”
Beast Terrorism was a terrorist method in which they controlled a ‘boss monster’ to attack the players’ residential area. This was similar to the method with which the ‘Evolution Society’ had summoned the boss monster ‘Ogre Warriors’ in Yeongdeungpo and made them run wild in the early days of the game.
“Bastard! If they’re dissatisfied, they have to come out by themselves and confront us instead of sending monsters like this every time!”
According to what the Strategic Intelligence Bureau found out, the Originals were mass-producing ‘boss monsters’ by supplying prey for them, namely, EXP, while detaining the monsters. By summoning such a boss monster to the key areas of the World Tree camp, they carried out the worst terrorism against Sungwoo’s allies while they didn’t suffer any damage.
“Well, let’s see what other terrible things they have raised this time! Anyway it’s going to be a great opportunity for me to gain EXP,” said Hanho.
Hanho looked at the Hypergate, showing full confidence. Since he was at level 40 and possessed divine power, he could deal with any boss monster alone.
But something unexpected happened elsewhere.
“Admiral! We’ve got an emergency radio!”
That was bad news.
“The hypergate was also opened on the southern border of Asadal. And a giant toad-shaped boss monster appeared a moment ago!”
“Really?”
The Beast Terrorism finally started elsewhere.
“This time we have an emergency radio from the northern post! The hypergate is opening there, too!”
Their terrorist attacks started in three places at the same time.
“Man, these bastards are attacking us in an organized way!”
At that moment, Hanho hurriedly turned around and said, “Oh my God! Brother Inho, let me deal with them here. So block them in other areas! Don’t miss them again!”
Hanho went straight to the deck, then jumped out of the airship.
Then he summoned Hyunmoo.
– Caution! The ‘Activation of Incarnation (Hyunmoo)’ has begun in the area.
Soon, a dark green divine beast slowly stood up among the huge gray ruins.
Gooooooooooo-
His body, which was twice as large as it was a year ago, and a darker green aura over his body, seemed to prove Hanho’s power, who already reached level 40.
“Hypergate opens!”
At that moment, the Hypergate vibrated and started pouring out something.
“The boss monsters are popping out!”
Grrrrrrrrrr!

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - Age After Ending (6)
chapters.content:
Chapter 492: Age After Ending (6)
First came out a three-headed ogre ‘Triple Head Ogre.’ He was several times more powerful than a twin-headed ogre. As a ‘field monster,’ he would have been the ruler of a server in the pre-ending period.
Following him appeared the huge cow Minotaur that appeared to be over 20 meters long. As it was a monster appearing in a myth, it must have had more powerful strength than they thought. In addition, 3 boss monsters came out.
“Come on! Thank you for giving me EXP!”
Hanho welcomed them with great delight, but his Hyunmoo fired a storm of cold at them.
Pooooooooooh-
As soon as the boss monsters appeared, they were swept away by a pure white blizzard before getting frozen and turning into ice sculptures. They didn’t die yet, but they would be left defenseless for a while.
“Thanks for the food!”
Puck! Puck! Puck! Puck!
Hyunmu charged at them, then started trampling on the boss monsters with his massive body.
Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop! Pop!
When Hanho, who was now riding on Hyunmu, raised his six hands and fired huge cannons in a row, he saw one of the triple-headed ogre’s heads being torn away.
Watching the scenes, Inho let out a sigh of relief. Even though Hanho was clumsy in some respects, he was a really strong guy.
“Okay, he will deal with the monsters here. Let’s go to the Hypergate right away, which has already been opened to the south!”
But they couldn’t fight the monsters everywhere.
“Admiral, what about the Northern Hypergate? The 3rd National Guard troops departed for that area in a hurry, but they said they could not stop the boss monsters by themselves, and asked us to send a Hunter-class unit!”
The Hunter-class unit referred to a unit whose members comprised 10 or more players whose level was 20 or higher. And they were powerful enough to deal with any boss monster.
“By the way, don’t you think our troops here are not sufficient?”
One year has passed since the ending, but not everyone has become equally strong.
As they entered the stable period, there were very few players who leveled up by hunting monsters, and most of them were dispatched to foreign servers to make the world safer.
“Don’t worry. Red Dragon Isabella will go there to help them!”
Of course, the World Tree camp had a secret weapon ready for this kind of emergency.
It was none other than a dragon, the boss monster of all the boss monsters, which could easily subdue any boss monsters, no matter how strong they were.
But there was another problem.
“Admiral? That Red Dragon isn’t in Asadal at the moment!”
Inho wrapped his head with both hands to hear that. That’s something he completely forgot.
“Damn it! You’re right. Because of Mir’s hatchling, she left for Amazon’s Rare yesterday morning.”
Isabella was playing the role of a nanny for Mir, who was in the process of becoming a black dragon. And when the guy’s first hatchling time approached, she left for the Amazon early this morning, saying that he could receive buffs only when he had hatched in a special space called ‘Rare.’
“Man, I just don’t know how she left right at this moment when she was needed most….”
At that moment Inho felt something very strange. Was the enemy aware of this situation from the beginning?
“Well, I smell a rat!”
The Necromancer was away from this place for a long time, and it’s been three days since Valkyrie was dispatched to kill the field boss monster that appeared in Australia. To make matters worse, Isabella left for the Amazon today of all days.
Then how come the enemy chose this particular time to attack them?
‘Well, the reason they kidnapped Hanho who was defending Asadal was because they knew he was the last defense there, so they wanted to cause a complete vacuum in our defense of Asadal.’
Inho got up from his seat and walked over to the window. He saw the Hypergate opened to the south at a distance.
“I wonder if there is a spy in our camp…’
Sungwoo’s allies have been growing so rapidly for the past year that they could not afford to pay attention to the details of their organizations, so there were probably some loopholes in their security readiness.
Even though Junghoon’s Strategic Intelligence Bureau waged an information war behind the scenes, nobody was sure if any mole or spy was operating secretly within their camp.
“Man, it’s driving me nuts. I feel like I can’t handle this on my own. Where the hell is Sungwoo right now?”
***
Sungwoo stretched out his hand and grabbed something.
[Item information
– Name: Adam’s Rib (No. 3)
– Grade: Myth
– Classification: unknown
– Effect: unknown
“Okay, you finally have discovered the last bone, right?”
The King of the Great Mountains asked, and Sungwoo nodded.
They were now in the deepest place in a huge dungeon whose location was unknown.
“Once you get it, you are going to break away from your human form and become monsters like me, right?”
“I don’t know. But at least I don’t become a furry beast like you.”
The King of the Great Mountains raised his eyes and opened his mouth wide in disbelief.
“I’m surprised to hear that the ruler of the world can make such insensitive remarks! Just watch your mouth! No matter how hard I think about it, you deserve impeachment! I guess you’re going to be a scaly, not furry, beast!”
Sungwoo ignored his words and handed Adam’s rib to Orun.
Crackle! Crackle!
hard!
Orun opened his backpack and put the rib in it. There were about five or six items similar to it inside.
‘This is the end of the myth quest.’
About 11 months ago when the world tree reached its final stage of growth, he satisfied some of the conditions of the ‘myth quest’. But it didn’t mean that he became the ‘Dragon’ race right away.
‘The hatching of the dragon and the completion of the world tree was just the beginning. It was only the beginning of the next stage…’
He could notice it just by examining the details of the quest.
[Myth Quest]
– Name: Origin of the race (Dragon Race)
– Type: unknown
– Goal: Find the ‘clue to evolution’
– Reward: Evolving into a new race
*You have obtained two ‘absolute seeds’. One is the race itself that’s been growing powerful, and the other is a vessel of life that can hold transcendent power. If the two seeds are fused under fateful conditions, it will create a new myth.
* When an unidentified egg ‘hatches,’ and the world tree reaches the ‘complete’ stage, the ‘clue to evolution’ will be revealed. (If either of the two seeds is damaged, you will fail.)
According to this message, the ‘clue to evolution’ was revealed. To be reborn as a new race, Sungwoo received a quest that ordered him to collect all the ‘Adam’s ribs’ scattered around the world.
‘It was not an easy quest.’
And he has spent almost 4 months discovering Adam’s ribs, and finally, he collected them all.
The King of the Great Mountains said skeptically, “Man, it makes me crazy to think what’s going to happen in the future. All the 140,000 players belonging to the World Tree camp are going to turn into dragons all at once, right? Well, don’t you think you have built the house too small?”
Can it take place?
Even Sungwoo was not sure of it.
“Let’s go back for now.”
He had no choice but to go back and check it out for himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - Age After the Ending (7)
chapters.content:
Chapter 493: Age After the Ending (7)
Sungwoo and the King of the Great Mountains were now on an island in the Mediterranean Sea. The two walked out to the beach after passing through the trees and gray buildings here and there.
Splash- Splash-
Soon the cobalt-colored sea spread out along with the sound of the refreshing waves. It was spectacular to see the sky assimilated with the sky blue, with its cool color refreshing the world.
The King of the Great Mountains whistled.
“I feel sorry for that. I wanted to have a great time with you after the game was over, but you are too busy. How about having a fling together sometime in the future?”
“…”
“Umm…”
The King of the Great Mountains glanced at him.
“…”
Sungwoo blatantly remained silent, but the king was very much used to it, so he just began to yak by himself, as always.
“Um, never mind. I was just giving you. Honestly, I want to go back to Mt. Sorak quickly. The blue sea and blue sky make me miss Mt. Sorak so much! Since I’m a boss monster born on the Korean peninsula, I guess I must have been designed for that environment, right?”
Of course, they were not walking on a foreign beach for fun or vacation. It’s because the dungeon where they found ‘Adam’s Bones’ was right here.
” Well, I might not stay on Mt. Sorak for a long time. Let me see. Well, I think a little over 4 years.”
He finished chatting sadly as if he lamented his situation.
The operating period of the ‘nanorobots’ in action around the world is now over 5 years left. As a result, the King of the Great Mountains can maintain his current body for about 5 years.
Sungwoo said, “If you keep talking nonsense like that, the lifespan of the nanorobot embedded in your body can be shortened faster.”
The King of the Great Mountains giggled at his unexpected response.
Sungwoo asked with a frown, “By the way, don’t you feel that ‘reaction’ yet?”
The King of the Great Mountains shook his head at his question.
“Well, you don’t necessarily feel it at the moment when you want to feel it. Sorry that I can’t help you when you have taken me for that reason.”
