“Oh, never mind. If you feel the ‘reaction’, just focus on it properly. Don’t miss it like you did last time.”
“Don’t worry. Hold on tight and I’ll report you right away even if you feel a little bit.”
As for the ‘reaction’ that Sungwoo mentioned, it referred to a certain ‘voice’ that only the King of the Great Mountains could hear.
‘Who the hell would be next time?’
On the day when they met the ‘ending’ of the game, the King of the Great Mountains confessed that he heard another ‘voice’ other than the helper’s. He also said that it was none other than that ‘voice’, not the ‘helper,’ which helped him to get out of the control of the system.
‘He told me that it sounded much like a real God’s voice.’
The king’s argument had no substantial ground, but Sungwoo didn’t ignore it.
‘There must be something significant that I don’t know.’
Since the King of the Great Mountains served as an external medium, Sungwoo could not dismiss his testimony of another voice as a mere illusion or nonsense.
Soon he began to see that evidence.
‘System error…’
For some reason, the “system error” involving the King of the Great Mountains occurred.
It has happened four times so far. Because of that, the system in his location has malfunctioned, and every time that happened, the King of the Great Mountains said that he heard someone’s ‘voice’ that seemed to whisper into his ears.
Watching him nearby, Sungwoo instinctively felt something.
‘Certainly, there is something.’
Of course, since the system itself was created by humans, minor errors could occur.
But when he checked with the GMs from Zero Earth, who was in charge of system management, he confirmed that the system error was caused by ‘outside intervention’.
To put it simply, an unknown wave of unknown identity allegedly manipulated the ‘nanorobot’. The GMs said they could not figure out who was responsible for that, adding they could not prove who the hell stepped in, and where they did it.
Sungwoo even threatened the GMs to confess everything they might have hidden from him, but they said they didn’t know anything.
“It was the first time Walter complained to me so strongly that my threat was unfair.’
Since the wormhole was destroyed, the connection to the outside world was completely removed. Then, was it possible for outsiders to intervene?
Swearing on his honor, Walter emphasized that even the science and technology of ‘Zero Earth’, which created the system, would not be able to do it.
‘Then it should be the third party that even the GMs can’t identify…’
In other words, there was someone who handled the system better than the creator of the system. If that’s the case, are they friendly? Or are they just aggressors no different from those on Zero Earth?
‘Man, this is driving me nuts.”
Woooooooooooooo-
While Sungwoo was agonizing over it, a ‘magic drone’ flew from somewhere and started chasing him and the King of the Great Mountains.
Besides, dozens of drones were flying all over the island, monitoring everywhere.
“Man, they’re at it again.”
It seemed like a fairly large operation.
“They must have noticed you’ve come out of the dungeon. Seriously, it’s only natural for them to show this kind of protocol when somebody like you is coming!”
All of the drones belonged to the World Tree camp.
Sungwoo frowned, watching them.
“That’s not what I want.”
The purpose of those drones was to protect Sungwoo. Since he nominally served as the Chairman of the ‘Control Center’ and the World Tree camp, he had no choice but to be protected by the ‘Chairman’s Office’ at all times.
Nobody could dare to protect him, but it was a great help to him for them to give him an advance alert by checking out something unusual around him.
“Well, even if you don’t want it, you are in a position to get security protection, right? As the ruler of the world, it’s no wonder you have no privacy!”
“But this is overprotection! They’re going overboard…”
Soon two airships were seen at the edge of the beach facing the cliff in the distance.
And below them were about thirty players on standby. Sungwoo felt that the actual number of security and protocol personnel mobilized for him was at least fifty.
“It’s a pity they are wasting time protecting me here. They can be utilized for other purposes more efficiently.”
Sungwoo insisted that it was not necessary to mobilize such a large number of people, but the executive officers of the World Tree camp including Kyungsoo insisted he needed them for security reasons.
‘Yeah, it’s natural that they feel anxious if something unexpected happens to me.’
Without Sungwoo, it would be impossible for the ‘Control Center’ and even the World Tree camp to exist. They knew it, too, so protecting Sungwoo excessively was not for himself only, but for the whole world.
“Hmm, someone is running to us.”
At that moment someone was hurriedly running toward them along the beach.
It was a man.
“Oh! He’s that chief secretary!”
The ‘chief secretary’ referred to the man who served as both Sungwoo’s bodyguard and secretary. He was a 4-star priest at level 22, who was in charge of Sungwoo’s safety and health. He was a reliable person who Kyungsoo and Inho selected after vetting numerous candidates thoroughly.
He hurriedly came to Sungwoo and greeted him.
“Welcome back! Oh, you’re here, Sangoon! It’s been 11 days since I saw you last.”
‘Sangoon’ was the new name of the King of the Great Mountains. Since he could not use the same name that he had earned as the boss monster, he coined it for himself.
More precisely, his new name was Sangoon Kim.
The chief secretary brought bad news, saying, “Well, some big trouble occurred in Asadal, so I was wondering if I should enter the dungeon to convey the news to you. I’m so relieved to see you out here!”

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - Age After Ending (8)
chapters.content:
Chapter 494: Age After Ending (8)
“You mean something bad happened in Asadal? Terrorists attacked there?”
“Yep. It’s still going on.”
Sungwoo expected this kind of thing would happen, so he took some measures to cope with such a contingency while he was away. Even if Sungwoo was the most important pillar of the World Tree camp, it would not make any sense for a building to collapse just because one pillar was missing.
‘I think the security was pretty tight because they dispatched the 213th Task Force to defend Asadal and had Hanho on standby.’
Nonetheless, they were urgently asking for Sungwoo’s help.
‘The enemy mounted a premeditated attack.’
Sungwoo and Sangoon immediately boarded the Messenger.
One ‘Hypergate’ was installed on the gray cliff facing the Messenger.
They installed it and had it ready to use after being supplied with emergenc mana.
“Skip all inspection processes! Start immediately.”
As soon as the chief secretary ordered it, the Hypergate was ignited.
Woooooooooo-
But there was some problem.
“What the heck? The engine won’t start!”
There was a problem with the Hypergate. It suddenly stopped while mana was beingsuppliedd, but that wasn’t all.
“Emergency! All engines are out of order!”
“We can’t figure out the cause!”
Even the engine of the ‘Messenger’, which was preparing for flight, was turned off.
‘Oh my God…”
Sungwoo looked at the King of the Great Mountains, Sangoon.
“Maybe…”
The king was frowning at that moment. He made an unpleasant expressio then nodded by himself.
“Damn it, I’m sorry, but I just feel anxious. I’ve sensed the reaction…”
His eyes began to glow blue.
“Everything is alright, but why now?”
– ??%%%&@?!(%67#)
-????#1$%?$##%!!&*
Something terrible began.
***
“Move fast!”
On top of the gray wall surrounding Asadal, hundreds of troops moved in a formation.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
They felt their hearts beating rapidly when they heard the explosions in the distance.
“Damn it! They’re already getting close to us!”
The ‘Beast Terror’ directed at Asadal took place simultaneously in three places. As a result, Asadal’s defensive forces were divided into six units.
There were three teams in charge of going directly to the ‘Hypergate’ to hunt boss monsters and three other teams who were responsible for guarding the firewalls to prevent monsters from entering the city. They were moving in an organized way.
“How come they struck us in three places at the same time? What’s the matter?”
Sungwoo couldn’t help but be embarrassed by the unprecedented development.
The defenders of the northern wall mounted their weapons on the wall and watched the gray smoke rising in the distance.
At that moment, the defense captain shouted, “We are playing the role of firewalls! If our guys fail to put out the fire, we have to stop the monsters from coming over here by all means! So stay alert, everybody!”
Hanho was in charge of defending the abandoned factory area in the west, while the World Camp fleet led by Inho moved out to the south.
The problem was how to defend right here, namely, the northern area. There were no proper weapons deployed in the north.
“Our allied forces are on the defensive! The enemies are approaching us fast!”
When he received the report through the magic drone, the defense commander spat out a swear, “Damn it!”
If those in charge of fire extinguishment failed, there was no way for those responsible for the firewall protection to stop the monsters because most players who could confront boss monsters were dispatched to the fire control team.
At that moment someone just arrived here.
Rattle- Rattle-
“Defense Commander, what’s going on?”
A large man in white armor approached him with a huge sword around his waist.
It was Junghoon, the Crusader Commander and the Director of Strategic Intelligence Bureau. He mainly worked to gather intelligence behind the scenes rather than fighting at the forefront, but he could offer help anytime when something unexpected happened.
So the Defense Commander reported to him about the situation.
“Well, four boss monsters have appeared in the North Hypergate, and one of them is the ‘warlord’ level, so it seems that he has summoned a large number of subordinates. That’s why our allies right there are asking for our reinforcement…”
“Do you have any surplus troops here?”
“Right now, we don’t.”
Asadal was a pretty huge city. So they had to defend its outskirts by mobilizing troops, unlike the city center that was protected by the ‘Shadow of the Divine Tree’, or the invisible barrier of the world tree.
Since the rampart reached as long as 4.8 km, it inevitably required a considerable number of defending troops, so they could not afford to assign some of them to any other mission.
“Then try to mobilize the remaining troops defending the western wall. Hanho and Hyunmoo are defending there, so they won’t need a lot of defense forces.”
“Understood!”
Junghoon placed his hand on the rampart, staring at the smoke that was getting closer. The trail of explosions and smoke that started from far away was fast approaching them.
‘Three boss monsters and one warlord-level monster? Man, this is a tough army that is very hard to beat.”
Thump- Thump- Thump-
“Our defense line in the north is in jeopardy!”
Junghoon frowned at that.
“The hordes of monster rats are trampling on the defense line and coming here! I think they number more than a few thousands!”
Junghoon was just listening to that report.
“Um…”
He couldn’t fight like Sungwoo, Jisu, or Hanho because he did not yet attain divine power like them.
Divine power was difficult to obtain even before the ending, but it became much more difficult to obtain after the ending.
‘It’s unfair to me.’
According to the GMs taken as POWs, the “update” for this game has been stopped, so nobody was allowed to obtain the divine power or deity status.
So Junghoon was not as strong as the three heroes Sungwoo, Jisu, and Hanho. That’s why he was in charge of collecting the intelligence about the enemy, at which he was the best.
Nonetheless, Junghoon seemed relaxed in such a situation. He was not in a position to take any action.
“Did you contact our alliance through the hotline?”
When he asked, the Defense Commander said with a nod, “Yes, we did through a normal channel. And the chief secretary also contacted the Necromancer.”
“Really? Man, he must be very busy now…”
“I know, but the situation here is so urgent…”
While trying to dispute Junghoon’s words, he hesitated a bit because he realized that even though he made the rational judgment on his own, his judgment was not as good as the intelligence chief’s.
“Then tell everyone to stay alert. Everything will be fine,” Junghoon said.
Junghoon was the head of the Intelligence Bureau of the World Tree camp, so he knew the most about what’s going on anywhere as the “eyes and ears” of the world tree.
As far as he knew, this city was not about to collapse so easily.
“Did they commit the Beast Terror by opening three Hypergates? Well, it’s unprecedented. But soon…” he murmured, then turned his head to look inside the rampart where the world tree was standing tall.
“More Hypergates will open on our side.”
He even offered an optimistic assessment of the situation.
“Well, I think we can throw a big celebration party if everybody gathers on this occasion.”
The World Tree camp was no longer small enough to be shaken by terrorism.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - Age After Ending (9)
chapters.content:
Chapter 495: Age After Ending (9)
The huge steel structure ‘Jump Space,’ which was installed at Asadal’s ‘First Airfield,’ was one of the most secure places in the center of Asadal. Aside from the protection of the ‘Shadow of the Divine Tree’ that covered the world tree, this was an area that no one except the person concerned could access because of its shield in operation around the clock.
“10 seconds before mana supply!”
Everybody at this place was busy at the moment.
“No. 1, get all the gates ready for operation!”
The members of the ‘HG Management Center’, nicknamed ‘gatekeepers’, were busy moving around. They were in the thick of operating the Hypergates installed at regular intervals in the Jump Space.
There were a total of 16 hypergates installed there, which were then connected to all over the world. In other words, this was the hub of the world.
“No. 1, No. 2, No. 3 all working normally!”
“No. 3, No. 4, No. 5 all working normally!”
Woooooooo-
“Supplying mana 6 and 7 is okay!”
Each Hypergate consumed a lot of mana, so it could only be maintained when dozens of wizards had to work on it.
But the way the World Camp members operated them was different.
“Transferring mana on the Hypergate of No. 1 is okay!”
As many as 30 ‘mana batteries’ were connected to the Hypergates, so they could be kept fully charged at all times for the Hypergates to open within 10 minutes at any time.
The manager of the control tower, HG Management, lifted the radio item.
“Open all the Hypergates!”
As soon as he shouted, the seven Hypergates leading all over the world opened at the same time. Then the players or the heroes from various servers walked out.
***
On a dark moonlit night, the ground was vibrating with a big noise.
Adrian, the judge of the Originals, arrived near the Hypergate opened to the north after escaping from the surprise attack by the World Tree camp.
“Alright. Are you guys already in the party mood?”
He took a seat on the roof of the building with several members of the organization and watched the horrible scenes of the ‘Beast Terror’.
The city was completely ruined while it went through the game, but as the boss monsters pushed their way through it, even those debris that remained were crumbling.
Bang! Bang!
But most of the city was devastated by the indiscriminate shelling by the World Tree Fleet. The cannonballs fired from four airships destroyed the unoccupied city center, eradicating everything crawling in the crevices of the building.
Monster rats the size of a big dog screamed in pain after they were devoured by the flames.
“Are you crazy enough to think they can kill our special boss monsters with just shelling?”
“Hahaha! No way!”
They could push out the so-called ‘miscellaneous monsters’ that appeared along with the warlord monsters, but the ‘boss monsters’ would never collapse at such an attack.
Sheeeeeeeeng-
At that moment a tentacle soared from among the flames.
Bang!
An airship that was flying in the sky was tilted with an explosion, then crashed through the buildings. Then, three airships flying nearby raised their altitude by waving their searchlights in all directions. They were escaping from the scene.
“Wow, this is the third airship that crashed!”
“Really? Man, an airship isn’t a big deal, is it?”
Watching the airship crash helplessly, a product of magical engineering that the World Tree camp boasted about, the members of the Originals felt thrilled that they won the victory after a long time.
“It looks like we will be reaching the enemy’s rampart soon!”
As could be seen, the boss monsters they summoned this time were quite different from those before the ending. They were like living creatures born artificially, then strengthened repeatedly in a special way.
Thump- Thump- Thump-
It was bizarre and grand to see them striding through the gray smoke, then come across the black city center and move towards the rampart of Asadal.
“Oh my God…unless we have someone with divine power, I’m afraid we can’t stop them!”
There were only three players in the World Tree camp who had the divine power or deity status. And two of them were not here.
Adrian smiled, then nodded.
“Great. Considering that those conceited guys haven’t appeared yet, it seems that the black agents under my control are doing their job pretty well.”
“Black Agents? Do you mean…”
Black Agents are often referred to as spies.
Adrian has long planted some disguised Black Agents in the World Tree camp, so that they could cause disturbances in the rear, timed with his operation.
“Well, I still haven’t found out where the Necromancer is and what he’s doing, but I ordered three of them to shadow Valkyrie in Australia.”
One member of the Originals opened their eyes wide at his pretentious words.
He asked, swallowing in surprise, “Wait a moment. Did you order them to assassinate Valkyrie?”
“What the heck? Are you crazy?”
“Pardon?”
Adrian shook his head as if he was speechless.
“How can I assassinate the Valkyrie? That should be done by Sir Z himself.”
“Oh, I see…”
That guy paused for a moment. He didn’t know anything about the “Black Agent Operation” because he wasn’t Adrian’s direct subordinate.
So Adrian began to boast, “Well, as long as we can break the Hypergate that they must have prepared in Australia for her to exit, it will give us plenty of time to destroy the world tree. Don’t you think so?’
“Really? I see.”
As if he was proud of himself, Adrian giggled at himself, and those who listened to him chimed in as if to curry favor with him.
“Wow! How great you are, Judge!”
“You are really out of the box when it comes to strategic thinking!”
When things went smooth, they were quickly elated with joy and satisfaction, predicting their victory too early.
“Yeah, it wasn’t a bad operation.”
At that moment an unfamiliar voice was heard from somewhere.
“Ugh?”
A female voice, or more precisely, a female voice filled with cynicism, echoed over their heads. Even Adrian and the Originals members, who were getting very excited a little while ago, felt tense and nervous at the voice.
They slowly turned their heads.
“Oh my God! How come you…”
They opened their eyes wide, one by one, then took a deep breath.
Someone was standing upright on the tallest spire on the roof of the building.
“Is she Valkyrie?”
That was true. She was Jisu, or Valkyrie.
A woman in her dark red full body armor was looking down at them with her long black hair fluttering.
“…”
She threw something under their feet with them unable to react because they were so shocked.
Tap-
It was a severed hand. A small symbol was engraved on its wrist, soaked in blood. It looked like a triangle inside a square. It was a symbol that meant ‘Black Agent’ planted by Adrian in the World Tree camp.
The Black Agents that he had dispatched were caught and killed by Valkyrie.
Only then did Adrian seem to have grasped the situation, then stepped backward, putting his hands into his pockets.
But his weapon was not there.
“Ah…”
Come to think of it, he had it confiscated at the abandoned factory.
And he knew that even if he had that wand, he could get out of this place.
Jisu threw herself from the spire. However, her body did not fall under gravity, but floated in the air, defying gravity.
She said sarcastically, “It was not a bad operation. By the way, next time if you have a chance to attack me again, try to send your agent who doesn’t make a sound in front of me.”

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - Age After Ending (10)
chapters.content:
Chapter 496: Age After Ending (10)
At that moment, a pure white brilliance emanated from her body, pushing away the darkness of the black sky little by little. Then hundreds of thin rays of light spread out from behind her back in all directions. It was as if an angel spread hundreds of wings.
Hung- Hung- Hung- Hung-
Then each end of the ray of light swelled like a fruit, and it took the shape of a human in an instant. Exactly, it looked like a warrior. It was Einherier. A whopping 199 Einherjars appeared in the sky over Suwon.
It was as if a heavenly army descended there.
“What the heck!”
The 213th Squadron, which previously defeated Adrian and the Originals members, was called the third strongest unit in the World Tree camp.
If so, which was the second strongest unit?
“Wipe out everything!”
It was none other than Valkyrie or Jisu’s forces. They were a battle group of dead warriors composed of One Valkyrie and 199 Einherjars.
Now they were moving.
Sh-sh-sh-sh-sh-sh-
Rotating counterclockwise around Valkyrie, they flew in. It looked as if a giant light saw blade began to spin.
Ka-ga-ga-ga-ga-ga-ga!
The saw blade-like charge hit the roof where Adrian and the members of the Originals organization were standing, then crushed the entire upper part of the building in an instant.
Concrete debris poured everywhere like rain.
“I’m sorry, but we don’t have time to rest yet. We have to move again.”
The warriors of light charged at the boss monsters advancing towards Asadal’s rampart without fear.
***
Somebody was watching the spectacular scenes of as many as two hundred rays of light shooting towards the boss monsters and the Valkyrie troops advancing.
“…”
It was Z, the large man wearing thick scale armor and a purple iron mask.
Clank- Clank-
He stood tall like a warrior on the roof of a building and slowly moved his head to follow the advance of the Valkyrie troops. In the meantime, she was doing something with both hands in a relaxed manner.
Clank- Clank-
It was the sound of regular clanking, namely, loading the revolver.
Clank- Clank-
It had the ugly look of a large-caliber revolver using Magnum bullets, releasing eerie black waves from the barrel whenever a bullet was loaded into the cylinder.
Sheeeeeeeeee-
When he loaded a total of 8 rounds, she rotated the cylinder and inserted it into the holster of her waist.
Then, he quickly pulled it out and slowly aimed at the Valkyrie troops flying in the distance.
“…”
When he placed the index finger on the trigger of the revolver and pressed it, its chamber slowly retracted, turning the cylinder little by little.
But it stopped there.
He took back its muzzle and swung it over his head, spinning it once before putting it back into the holster. Then he lightly lifted the large iron case that he had laid down on the floor.
His figure disappeared from the roof in an instant.
***
The engine of the Messenger was turned off due to a sudden system error.
As a result, the Messenger lost its power and descended slowly, then gently landed on the sea.
“…”
The Messenger swayed softly along with the gentle waves.
“…”
The entire crew looked at the King of the Great Mountains, Sangoon, silently. They didn’t know exactly what was going on right now, but at least they sensed that Sangoon was showing an anomalous reaction.
Sungwoo was also looking at him.
“What happened?”
Soon he turned his head and looked at Sungwoo. His eyes gleamed blue unlike before. It seemed as if another soul entered his body.
‘Yeah, he’s become a different creature.’
At that moment, he smiled gently. What did it mean?
Sungwoo didn’t show any reaction. But he suddenly became nervous, wondering who was making such a smile.
‘The King of the Great Mountains said he was just like a god.’
Of course, it could be the king’s observation, but Sungwoo believed his judgment to some extent.
‘He is a rational being.’
Although he was a spirit that was reformed and reconstructed by the system, he was not the type who got easily carried away with his feelings in making judgments.
If he felt he was like a ‘god’ over and over again, there must be a reason for that.
‘What does he mean by God?’
If there was a system that transcended the system, and if the system existed somewhere, what was it?
Sungwoo felt a new sense of awe for this being that was incarnated through Sangoon’s body.
Soon that being opened his mouth.
“What?”
But no voice was heard. He opened his mouth and said something, but no one including Sungwoo heard it.
At that moment some letters appeared before Sungwoo’s eyes.
– %@&@$oh &!&small=$dong
– A wormhole will open soon.
That’s what that being said.
Wormhole?
Sungwoo suddenly felt as if he was suffocated by that word. Was it a warning that there would be another invasion on Zero Earth?
In fact, even Sungwoo knew that the wormhole was being restored. So he dispatched researchers at the GMs’ facility, an artificial island floating in the waters of the Bermuda Triangle, to monitor the wormhole at all times. Actually, he was learning their technology by threatening the captured GMs.
About four months ago Sungwoo received a briefing from his deputy that the wormhole was being restored. He did not know whether it was a natural recovery or somebody was restoring it, but it was certain that the passage was being opened.
‘I heard it would take them a long time to restore it.’
Considering the speed, it would take 36 years to completely restore it.
“I know about the wormhole restoration, but I hear it’s going to take a lot of time…”
But that being opened his mouth again.
– No, you are wrong. It will open sooner. You should have gotten there by then. There are only 12 hours 11 minutes 31 seconds left.
That was it.
“…”
That being closed his eyes quietly, then lowered his head. A certain being was now gone from Sangoon’s body.
– System under emergency recovery (59%)
And everything started to normalize.
Shortly afterward, Sangoon opened his eyes.
“Oh my God…”
Sangoon slowly raised his head and looked at Sungwoo.
Then he moved his pale blue lips and said, “Did you see that?”
He spoke as if Sungwoo might have noticed that being, who he should have never seen.
But Sungwoo asked the same question he had asked Sangoon many times before in a more sincere manner than usual.
“What the hell is that being?”
“I may sound crazy, but that’s…”
Sangoon shook his head in denial of his thoughts.
“He must be God.”
His judgment remained unchanged.
“God?”
But Sangoon couldn’t really explain why he was a god. But he said there was no better expression than the word God to describe that being.
In other words, he could not explain it properly, but in his judgment, that being was a god.
But Sungwoo couldn’t understand his explanation. But he had one wish.
“Well, if he is really a god, I hope he is an apathetic god.”
Nobody was supposed to ask God for justice and good because it was arrogant to think that a transcendent being had the same justice and goodness as humans had.
‘God’s best can be our worst.’
In Sungwoo’s opinion, the best option would be for that being to be indifferent and leave them alone.
‘Well, let me take action as best I can.’
Sungwoo turned his head and looked at his chief secretary.
“Chief Secretary, we’re all ready. Prepare to depart.”
The chief secretary got up from his seat.
“Okay. By the way, where should we go? Are you going straight to the wormhole lab?”
Actually, he asked it just in case because he also saw the message from that being called God that since the wormhole would open soon, Sungwoo should be there.
The opening of the wormhole was as serious a problem as the terrorism on Asadal.
“No, I’m going to Asadal,” Sungwoo replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - Age After Ending (11)
chapters.content:
Chapter 497: Age After Ending (11)
Lots of mysteries about the Bermuda Triangle have been partially confirmed.
There was a passageway to another world, the so-called ‘wormhole’, in the depths of the sea there. Of course, it didn’t exist anymore because the Necromancer passed through it and reached the world of GMs called ‘Zero Earth 0’, then closed it by exploding three hydrogen bombs.
It’s a very famous fact, which has been passed down to generations after generations as a founding myth throughout the world today.
Woooooooong-
A motorboat made through magical engineering appeared after quickly passing through the water. Four players on the boat were looking around with binoculars to detect mana.
“We’ve found nothing unusual in the northern sea!”
They looked around the area, then turned and headed somewhere.
“Okay, let’s go back!”
But something was strange.
Wooooooooong-
There was nothing around. There were no islands or a mothership for them to return to.
“Are you sure this is the right lane we should go to?”
“Yep! Go straight! This isn’t your first time sailing here, right?”
“I’m sorry, but I’m confused…”
What they saw was the open sea.
In other words, it was not a place where they could carry out any operation with such a small boat because it was certain that the boat would lose power and drift away after sailing on the sea endlessly.
But when they got to a certain point, the space was distorted. It seemed that they entered through a thin veil momentarily. Then something that they had never seen before appeared before their eyes. It was an island.
Whooooooooo-
Shortly afterward, a gust of wind roared over their heads, casting a dark shadow.
“Argh!”
One of the crew members raised his head.
The identity of the shadow was an airship. Three airships were cruising around the island while flying low.
One of them lifted the radio item and shouted, “This is the 3rd maritime search team! We’ve succeeded in entering the first-class security vessel! We will return to the headquarters.”
Then, a voice rang out from the airship.
– This is the Hard Guard. Thanks for coming here. We authorize your entry!
This was the secret facility of the World Tree camp hidden in the ‘mirage magic’.
This small island with a total area of 52 km2 was not on the map because it was an artificial island made by GMs when the game started.
Later it was called the Wormhole Observatory, whose purpose was to observe the collapsed wormhole and prepare for any unforeseen circumstances. It was also a space for scientists from the World Tree camp to research the future technology of Zero Earth. Researchers in robes were busy coming to and going out of the main research facility in the basement.
“Damn it! What the hell is going on?”
Red symbols and letters were popping up on the ‘main screen’ that filled one side of the facility. It was a bad signal.
“Check if there are any abnormal signs on the 4th graph right now!”
It seemed that something unusual, or something big, happened.
“The number in question is also abnormal!”
At that moment, the automatic door leading to the conference room opened, and the main executives of the institute came in droves. A giant with horn-rimmed glasses strode out of them and stared at the main screen. He was the head of the lab, Hendrix, who was in charge of the facility.
“Man, what a mess! We’re going to close the tunnel right away. And have security guards around the facility on standby to make sure nothing gets out of this facility, regardless of our guys or anybody else trying to come through that hole!”
Soon, five or six graphs appeared on the main screen, releasing complex information. It was something that ordinary people would not be able to recognize at all.
“What about the condition of the center of the tunnel?”
When Hendrix asked, the chief researcher sitting in the front got up and started reporting.
“We haven’t yet confirmed it, but it’s not normal. Currently, it is being restored about 120,000 times faster than before.”
He swallowed tensely, then shook his head with a serious expression. The fact that he had no choice but to mention such a terrible conclusion made him hopeless. But he opened his mouth, after all.
“The wormhole will open tomorrow morning.”
In other words, the wormhole was about to reopen soon.
“How come it’s possible? What are the GMs saying about it?”
“Well, even Walter says he has no idea…”
Hendrix clicked his tongue at his reply.
“Man, it looks like they don’t know much about what’s going on in their world! Damn it, call Asadal right away and ask them to pay more attention to us because the situation here is getting serious!”
While making a somewhat hasty remark, he began to give orders to the researchers, scanning the graph carefully.
But there was a man among them who behaved strangely in such a tense situation.
He was a guy with long hair tied behind his head. He stepped back and checked his colleagues’ expressions.
He said, “Hey Timmy, I’m sorry, but I want to go to the bathroom urgently…”
His colleague silently nodded, and the man quietly walked out into the hallway. Then he passed by the nearby toilet, turned a corner, and headed to the far-away toilet. He peeked inside, then locked the bathroom door inside.
Clank!
He stepped deep inside the bathroom.
Then he rolled up the sleeve on his left wrist, and gently rubbed the inside of his forearm. Then the hidden symbol on his skin began to glow.
– Preparing for voice transmission…
He cleared his throat and started whispering into the sign on his forearm.
“I contacted you because there was something unusual, which you expected. They are opening the wormhole. Sooner or later, the great men will likely take back the system.”
He swept back his hair, with his hands trembling.
Then he took a breath and opened his mouth again.
“Four hundred suicide squadron members are on standby in Philadelphia. They can occupy this facility at any time. We’re waiting for your order.”
The world was still in a state of confusion and complexity even one year after the ending.
Nobody could control everything, so something went wrong here and there.
***
Some red lights were flashing near a hill near the Suwon World Cup Stadium.
Wooooooooooooo-
They gradually grew in size, creating a bizarre sight as if a wildfire broke out.
Of course, outsiders couldn’t see this scene because they had cast a spell in advance to cheat people.
Wooooooooooooo-
A whopping 104 wizards at the center of the hill widely sat around in the form of a ring, blowing mana into the center. Mana flowed from them and got sucked into one place.
It was a single roll of parchment where they were supplying mana.
The parchment flapped, absorbing mana, and the symbols written on the inside glowed green.
Wooooooooooooo-
Chairman Lee, standing from a distance, was watching the scene.
He swallowed watching the scene with a slightly nervous expression.
But he made a smile on his wrinkled face soon.
“We’ve obtained two Scrolls of Ruin from the deepest part of the labyrinth, and their linked skills. We’re going to burn everything with them even if our enemy tries to block us by all means. Yeah, we’ll,” he said with a hearty laugh. “They have no idea that our Beast Terror is just a trick. How foolish! As always, those in power are supposed to collapse with one smashing attack by the wise people.”
Then he raised his head, revealing his teeth.
But at that moment the space behind Lee’s back began to distort into an elliptical shape.
Feeling strange, Chairman Lee slowly turned his head. His left eyebrow twitched a couple of times as if he found something strange. It was a portal.
“…”
Soon someone walked out of the portal.
“We’ve found him!”
Those who bolted out of the portal were the White Wolf, Black Lion, and a dozen players. After the ‘White Wolf Forensics Team’ belonging to the Strategic Intelligence Agency tracked him down, based on several clues, they finally came to detect Chairman Lee there.
His face was distorted instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - Age After Ending (12)
chapters.content:
Chapter 498: Age After Ending (12)
Soon the moon disappeared, and the sunset, coloring the grey city.
Z was standing on a broken and split four-lane road with his lonely and grand legacy shattered.
“…”
He stared into the air for a moment as if he was lost in thought. Considering that he slowly leaned his head to hear something, it seemed that he was listening for something.
“…”
Someone was whispering into his ear in an urgent voice.
How long did it last?
Thump- Thump- Thump-
He slowly lowered his head and looked straight ahead.
Thump- Thump- Thump-
The vibration was coming from that direction. It was the sound of somebody’s footsteps.
A boss monster the size of a house was moving behind the building on the left.
The cracked asphalt floor twisted whenever that giant creature moved. His gray fur could be seen through the broken windows.
Thump- Thump- Thump-
Of course, Z was not interested in the boss monster because he didn’t take the initiative on Beast Terror, nor was it the kind of operation that he liked.
But he accepted the operation of others, or more precisely, the “judges,” because he thought he could not cross the wall and step on the shadow of the World Tree alone.
“Disgusting!”
He didn’t like it, though.
But more disgusting scenes had yet to begin. Rats started pouring out from all over the cracks in buildings, alleys, and the road on the left. Each of them was as big as a big dog. They were rats that the warlord monsters took all over.
The rats were running somewhere, entangled with each other, and trampling on each other.
Z stared intently at the procession of the rats.
‘They’re running away with their mother.’
But the next moment an explosion occurred.
Bang!
One side of the building collapsed and a beam of light poured out from the inside.
About thirty beams of light moved quickly, chasing the procession of fleeing rats.
Then they ground them like a mixer.
When the beams of light, or Einherjar, passed here and there quickly, a swarm of thousands of mice were reduced to ashes in an instant. They crushed those rats hiding in overgrown street trees, cracked buildings, and rusty vehicles.
Grrrrrrrrr- Grrrrrrrrrr-
The boss monster that hasn’t appeared from the building, believed to take all these rats probably, screamed in shock. Even the ‘mother’ of the plague of rats was also being slaughtered.
Flop!
And the red blood that gushed out of that mother splattered and spilled all over the road.
Then his flesh was torn apart in chunks, and the cars parked on the side of the road were stained with blood like sticky red paint.
It didn’t take long for Einherjars to kill the mother rat.
Thud-
Soon, the rat’s head the size of a house slowly tilted and fell over the pool of his blood.
He stuck out his long tongue, with his eyes slowly overturned. He was dead
Shortly afterward, someone landed on its head. A woman in sword-red armor wiped the blood splattered on her face and shook off her blood-stained sword.
As she slowly lifted her head, the aura emitting her divine power shrouded her head in dark green. She was none other than a woman called Valkyrie, or Jisu.
She slowly turned her gaze and looked at Z, the purple giant standing at the end of the road.
“…”
The two looked at each other, but no one spoke first. Were both of them reticent?
Jisu had Einherjar lined up behind her back, and tried to identify the unidentified opponent standing before her.
‘This guy is far from ordinary.’
She could feel instinctively that he was quite different from the many players she had met.
‘And he’s not easy to deal with.
It was the first time she felt that way after she had met the assassin Vivona, who was one of the Demon King’s subordinates long ago.
She instantly found herself on edge.
She finally opened her mouth first.
“I think I know who you are.”
“…”
“You are the leader of the Originals, the guy who has been chosen by the ‘helper’ ahead of the Necromancer, right?”
The guy with that odd name Z wasn’t a mystic. But it was known that no one had seen him before.
‘But I’m sure this is that guy.’
She was convinced that given his terrific energy, he was that guy with such a good reputation.
“You know how to speak, right? You used to tell people you’re ‘the first chosen one,’ didn’t you?” she demanded.
He still didn’t answer. Instead, he dropped the huge iron case he was holding in his left hand. It fell freely.
Thud-
The moment it hit the asphalt, his right hand moved at great speed and touched his waist, and the next moment, he stretched out toward her faster than ever.
Her eyebrows twitched. She found a hole in the metal reflecting the early dawn sun. It was the muzzle of a gun, which was incredibly large.
Bang!
He was firing a black bullet with a large-caliber revolver.
The black bullet drew a straight line, and the space around it was instantly distorted like a liquid.
Puck!
The head of a giant rat fell on the floor, which was the head of an unknown warlord monster, was crushed by the waves of the bullet alone, splattering his broken brain in all directions.
But Jisu was not there when he fired.
“…”
Z raised his head slightly and looked to his left and right. He missed her movement.
“I think I understand why you have not been chosen.”
She was already behind his back. She raised her right hand, swung her sword in a curved line, then stabbed his heart in an instant.
Z avoided it, but he was a bit slow. When his left shoulder was touched by the sword, his scaly armor was scraped by the blade. The iron scales fell one by one
“…”
It wasn’t just the armor that was damaged. Dark red blood dripped from his shoulder and ran down his fingers.
She raised the tip of the sword that she had stabbed into his heart, then cut him again.
She aimed at his neck. But at that moment he raised the revolver.
Bang!
Her sword and his revolver collided, emitting sparks.
“Well, that’s why you have not been chosen. Why? Because you can never be the Necromancer’s rival!”
Jisu made provocative remarks like that, but she, not he, frowned at that moment because she felt an unexpected pain.
Something like black waves got stuck on her shoulder, inflicting the so-called ‘dot damage’ to her.
‘What the heck? Surely I avoided it’
It was a curse. She avoided the first bullet that Z fired, but just its mere brushing against her seemed to have the effect of causing curses all over the area.
As if it didn’t cause big damage to her, she took a step back and raised the sword.
‘As expected, he’s not easy to deal with.’
Then, for the first time, something like a sound came from the inside of that guy’s purple iron mask. It was a very small laugh. Z’s tone was low and thick. And it was kind of cold.
“Yeah, Valkyrie, you may be right to some extent. The Necromancer is a difficult opponent for me.”
He chuckled again and looked straight at her. A red-eye glow rose from the inside of that purple iron mask.
“But he might not know that you’re going to be killed by me.”
She let out a breath without showing any reaction. She was determined to confront him with all her might.
But at that moment a great vibration came from somewhere, and something like a huge wave passed under her feet. The asphalt cracked with deep dents here and there.
Because of the impact, the windows were shattered, sending off pieces of glass everywhere.
Jisu and Z had to tighten their legs so as not to fall at the tremendous impact.
“What the heck is this?”

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - Age After Ending (13)
chapters.content:
Chapter 499: Age After Ending (13)
Without letting down her guard, she turned her head slightly to observe what was happening at the epicenter of this vibration in the distance.
But she had no choice but to turn her head in no time.
“That doesn’t make any sense…”
The whole mountain was rising.
Watching it, Z laughed again and said, “By the way, I don’t have to kill the Necromancer by myself because I know many other ways to get rid of him. For example…”
He raised his right hand. Jisu lowered herself instantly, but his gun was pointed at her back, or more precisely, the world tree.
I’m going to blow away everything he has, so he can leave nothing behind.”
What appeared before her eyes was more shocking.
The mountain that soared has completely disappeared! In other words, it was warped.
‘What the heck?’
She could not help but be surprised. How could such a huge object disappear in an instant? Moreover, there wasn’t even a portal in sight. So he must have cast a massive spell. That mountain was moved into the sky in the distance before it began to fall as a gigantic shooting star.
“I am not as arrogant as you think. So I waited for today when he would be away.”
The world after the ending was always chaotic because someone made an all-out effort to create chaos.
***
The ‘Order Tower’, an administrative center built in the center of Asadal, was one of the tallest buildings under the shadow of the World Tree. The ‘President’s Office’ was on the 22nd floor,’ where Sungwoo usually stayed.
Tick- Tick-
Only the sound of the clock ticking was heard in the quiet office, which showed that Sungwoo had been away for quite some time. There was a thin layer of dust on the desk and bookshelf, and a bone that Mir appeared to have chewed through was scattered on the floor.
Tick- Tick-
It was a storm that broke that heavy silence.
Whooooo-
Something flew towards the Order Tower outside the windows, then barely turned and brushed against the outer wall before climbing up. It was a white object with huge wings.
Thud-
It landed on the roof of the Order Tower, shaking the building quite a bit.
The landing noise resonated throughout the area, and Kyungsoo, who was in the Asadal Command and Control Room on the 1st floor, hurriedly ran outside.
“What’s going on?”
Everyone looked up at the roof of the Order Tower.
With its head held high and its vast wings outstretched, the strange creature Bone Dragon was standing tall.
***
When fighting terrorism, it is important to keep in mind that the threat is not what appears only in front of your eyes because terrorists have a bad taste of hiding weapons before taking them out at unexpected moments.
That’s why ‘tracking’ terrorists and ‘crackdown’ on them are important.
And that’s why the specialist team called “White Wolf Forensics Team” belonging to the Strategic Intelligence Agency was summoned whenever a terrorist attack occurred
“They are hiding the second and third tactics. So we have to find out even their fourth tactic, and nip it in the bud.”
So they pursued the underlying plot of the Originals, based on their unique special tracking capability.
“We’ve detected an abnormal mana flow. Well, it’s like short-distance movement magic.”
As evidenced in things like this, they could easily detect the magic information that the enemy used a few hours ago.
“There were a total of 11 people here.”
When one of the crew members scanned the floor with his hands, the footprints were visible under fluorescent light, which was a skill among the ‘Pathfinder’ series skills that reproduced the footprints several hours ago.
In addition to this, when they were equipped with the ‘psychometric’ ability to read memories from objects, they could narrow the distance with the enemy quickly. Soon they could track down the cause of the bad smell quickly.
“We’ve found it!”
Whoooo-
The last place they discovered was a mountain with a cold wind blowing hard.
And there they encountered Chairman Lee.
“…”
His face hardened as if he was embarrassed. Did they succeed in tracking him down?
But he said, pretending to be calm, “Well, you guys seem to be pretty mature enough to stop playing house, but kids can’t beat seniors.”
Chairman Lee began to feel relaxed now. Even though he didn’t expect their sudden visit here, he was well prepared for some measure in this kind of situation, namely, Plan B.
“Miss Choi, close the lid.”
At his order the woman standing next to him nodded, then released mana, spreading her arms. She pressed a button.
Wooooooooong!
At that moment, a huge protective shield appeared on the dotted line like blue ink, which was drawn on the floor. It provided cover for Chairman Lee and hundreds of wizards.
“Damn it!”
The forensics team moved quickly, but it was too late. The enemies completely isolated themselves from their attack.
“Break the shield!”
“It takes time!”
But time was not on their side.
“How stupid! Do you think you can snatch the tail feathers of a flying crane like us because sparrows like you are chasing after us?” Chairman Lee said, sneering at them.
Then he walked further into the inside of the shield. Soon he operated the Hypergate that he had prepared there. He tried to escape from this place.
Meanwhile, the mysterious spell that hundreds of wizards were casting was finally completed.
“Let this fall on your cities as well as this mountain!”
Kugugugugugu…
– Caution! The forbidden magic ‘Scroll of Doom – Forced Warp’ has been cast in the area.
Along with that message, cracks began to appear throughout the ground and the whole mountain. Trees there collapsed everywhere.
The White Wolf turned and looked around. Certain energy began to engulf the hill.
“What the heck is that?”
And it lifted the mountain in no time.
“We’ve got to get out of here now!”
Something serious was happening.
The whole mountain began to be lifted from the ground. Then it was warped into a farther place in an instant.
After confirming it, the forensics team opened the portal at the last minute.
***
The sunrise dyed half of the world orange.
Thump- Thump-
Normally the still dawn would have felt like a peaceful landscape, but now with roaring sounds and explosions echoing everywhere, it looked crimson.
“Ugh?”
Around that time, an observer standing on guard duty at the huge watchtower towering in the center of the western part of Asadal discovered something.
“What is that?”
A black shadow appeared in the red sunlight.
“Ugh? What do you mean?”
His assistant standing next to him also raised his head, then frowned unwittingly.
“Isn’t it a dot?”
There was a black dot on top of the orange dye. And it was slowly growing.
The two could not identify the mysterious object at once, rubbed their eyes, and examined it again.
“No way…”
That was a meteorite.
Ku-oh-oh-oh-oh-
It certainly looked like a meteorite. A huge chunk of green stone was flying fast towards the city.
“No way! This can’t happen!”
They just stared blankly at it without responding at all. They even forgot their duty of reporting it to their supervisors.
Ku-oh-oh-oh-oh-
It flew so fast that they did not have time to report to their supervisors. While they lifted the walkie-talkie and explained the situation, the city would disappear.
Even if they had time to respond, how could they prevent such a formidable meteorite?
With a meteor of that size, it would break through even the invisible barrier of the World Tree camp, namely the Shadow of the Divine Tree, with the destructive power of its mass.
“…”
The two just watched the scene blankly. They were just speechless, so embarrassed rather than frustrated.
At that moment a gust of wind blew from somewhere.
Whooooooo!
“Argh!”

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - Age After Ending (14)
chapters.content:
Chapter 500: Age After Ending (14)
At first, they thought the gust was caused by the meteorite, but strangely, it blew from behind their backs.
“What the heck is this?”
They instinctively turned their heads. At that moment they had to adjust their posture so as not to fall.
A single ray of light passed through the watchtower at an incredibly fast speed. The watchtower, which had been built solidly, shook as if it were about to break down. When the air vibrated, a faint wave followed the movement of the beam of light.
They followed the movement of light with their eyes instinctively.
“What the hell is that?”
At first, it curved and soared into the sky, then at some point it raised its altitude and soared fiercely. It was a single arrow.
“…”
Its target was the unidentified meteorite.
***
A few minutes ago Z was going to kill Valkyrie in person. Even if he destroyed Asadal and the world tree, his greatest enemy, the Necromancer, was still there.
So it was clear that Valkyrie would be a significant stumbling block for him when one day he had to confront the Necromancer. That’s why he was intent to kill her when she was separated from the Necromancer.
Clang! Clang!
But she was much stronger than he thought.
After blocking the sword flying towards his vital point with the revolver’s barrel, he leaped backward. Then he soared more than ten meters at once and landed on the roof of a small shopping mall.
At that moment his revolver’s muzzle heated up, and black smoke was blown out of it. He fired all the bullets in a row. Since the bullets he shot were magic bullets, they spread curses and caused damage to the whole area, even if they didn’t hit her.
About thirty or so Einherjars were killed with a volley of bullets, but Valkyrie was still intact. Nonetheless, it was Valkyrie, namely, Jisu, who was more impatient.
“Oh my God…”
While she had no choice but to confront Z, she looked up at the sky in the south with an anxious look, where the ‘mountain’ was falling toward the World Tree camp.
She was worried that Asadal might disappear entirely quite soon.
“Valkyrie, there’s nothing you can do but deal with me.”
“…”
Z tucked the revolver into his waist, then opened his hands wide.
“Otherwise you may die in vain. I don’t want it, either.”
Woooooooooo-
At that moment, purple symbols appeared from both his hands and scattered all over his body. When he raised his arms, purple energy emitted and colored everything around him.
– Caution! An ‘extra-sensory space (ESP-Space)’ has opened in the area.
This was a skill that made it possible for its user to closely feel every movement nearby and move all objects very easily with ‘telekinesis’.
“It looks like you know how to play lots of cheap tricks, right?” Jisu quipped sarcastically before stepping back.
Then Z nodded readily, and replied, “Yes, I do!”
Z’s job fell into the category of ‘psychokinesis’ with a fairly wide use of the application, which was almost 5 stars among ‘super powers’, one of the most valuable job groups.
‘Shooting’, which he just used, was also one of the prime weapons that benefited from her capability. Besides, his job was a plus for anything that required a special ‘sense’ or ‘space’.
“Alright! Bring it on again!”
She charged at him quickly, backed up by one hundred Einherjars.
But Z jumped off the roof of the building and escaped from her close attack from all sides.
Tung! Tung! Tung!
With his telekinetic power, he lifted the abandoned vehicles, obscuring Einherjars’ vision, then quickly slipped into the gap. However, he could not escape her encirclement.
With dozens of blades stabbing him from everywhere, his body was torn apart here and there. At that moment he grabbed his necklace with one hand.
Woooooooong-
– ‘The Grace of the Saint’ protects your body.
At the same time that the message popped up, all the Einherjars who approached him were thrown away.
“Argh…”
Since they were souls, Einherjars groaned in pain unlike before. Besides, when they got disconnected from Jisu temporarily, their bodies flickered.
“Your access is denied.”
As long as he held the item around his neck, not only any beings in soul condition like Einherjars, but also other players could not approach within 1m of its wearer’s body.
This was one of the items that he had brought here to fight against the Necromancer and Valkyrie.
“Alright, it has a great effect!”
Having said that, Z retreated while blocking Valkyrie’s attacks. Then he pulled the heavy iron case that had been put down on the floor with his telekinesis and grabbed it.
Clank-
Jisoo slightly stepped back as if to be wary of the case. Since Z used all kinds of bizarre items and skills, she was not sure when she would be counterattacked by him again.
“…”
The two looked at each other.
At that moment the airflow changed.
Jisu and Z also felt it. And it was caused by something in a very distant place, the center of Asadal.
– Caution! The ‘fall of the sun’ has begun in the area.
With both of them not moving, a message created by a third party rang.
“What a relief…”
Confirming the message, she sighed in relief because it meant that the Necromancer, or Sungwoo, returned.
A ray of light roared towards a huge mountain falling towards the World Tree camp.
It was the ‘intangible arrow’ fired by Sungwoo using the Superheavy Bow.
The arrow hit the target.
Without making any sound, a yellow explosion colored the whole world faster than at light speed, scattering over the mountain. And its fragments rained down toward the World Tree camp like hails.
Tung! Tung! Tung!
Fortunately, such fragments alone could not penetrate the ‘Shadow of the Divine Tree’.
Of course, some of them were exceptionally large, so they looked a bit dangerous.
Bang!
A geyser-like stream rose from all over the center of Asadal, then began to push debris away. They were the water spirits. In other words, Lee Wei summoned them.
She was also there when the Hypergate opened, so she played a major role.
Jisu turned her head to Z and said, “You, I don’t think you were chosen again this time.”
Then she raised her sword in a more relaxed manner.
At that moment something like laughter came out from Z’s iron mask.
“Yeah, he is back, right?”
His voice was still calm and relaxed even when he realized that his plan fell flat because of the Necromancer.
He said, “Actually, I hoped he could.”
What did he mean?
Then, he raised his hand.
– Caution! The forbidden magic ‘Scroll of Doom – Forced Warp’ has begun in the area.
It was the same magic that lifted the whole mountain that had just been shattered and warped it into the distant air. He had two such magic ready to use.
Soon, something began to appear on Z’s hands.
That was a lump of crimson energy.
“No way!”
A nuclear fission-like explosion that was created by the ‘fall of the sun’ was ‘forcibly warped’ into this place.
“Argh!”
Since she could not stand the heat, she quickly backed away.
The asphalt where Z was standing was boiling with hot energy. All the metal within a few tens of meters began to melt.
That energy fluctuated wildly, but it gathered like a ball in Z’s hand.
“The scenes of the Necromancer crushing his city with his own hands? I didn’t plan it at all, but it’s going to be an attractive development!”
What the hell was he going to do with that?
‘He has divine power! If he can endure such intense energy, he must have divine power!’
As if to confirm her guesswork, Z’s divine power was the Sun God ‘Helios’.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - Age After Ending (15)
chapters.content:
Chapter 501: Age After Ending (15)
“My strength comes from the heat and light of the sun.”
However, the ‘fall of the sun’, the Necromancer’s skill using the Superheavy Bow, also used the same energy as the sun.
In other words, it was good news for Z.
“I didn’t know I ended up confronting him like this.”
He had been looking forward to this occasion for quite some time.
“If I can’t destroy the city, what if I kill all the people who live in it?”
As he raised his hand higher and higher, the sun began to swirl in the form of a ball.
It looked as if it was going to explode at any moment.
– Caution! A ‘Fire of Punishment’ will be activated in the area to wipe out all ‘living creatures’. (Remaining time: 00:02:59)
Z mobilized even weapons of mass destruction.
“What the heck?”
There were only three minutes left before all the Asadal residents would be annihilated.
“Argh! I have to stop him!”
But she could not get any closer to him.
– Caution! The ‘Fire of Punishment’ will be activated in the area to wipe out all ‘living creatures’. (Remaining time: 00:02:48)
Everyone in the striking range of the Fire of Punishment saw the message. And the whole Asadal was within its striking distance.
Even Sungwoo confirmed the message. And he watched the red ball falling in the south.
‘There is my sworn enemy!’
But he could not reach there in three minutes.
‘It looks like they deliberately made a precise attack!’
The situation was more serious than he expected.
He took a deep breath to stay focused. Then he tried to find out how to respond.
“Fire attack?’
Fire was an unrivaled natural enemy to all ‘living things’. All living things were made up of proteins, and heat easily destroyed them. However, there was an exception in this game.
‘I’m not going to die in that fire.’
If anybody can increase their immunity to fire like Sungwoo, they can survive.
And most of the fire resistance obtained by Sungwoo was related to a lot of ‘dragon-type’ items, such as ‘Dragon Hunter Synergy’ or ‘Drake’s Leather’.
This is because they are born with ‘fire resistance’.
“If that’s the case…”
He immediately flew towards the World Tree with the bag containing the ‘Adam’s Bones’ he had collected. It was time for him to finish the ‘Myth Quest’.
***
Chairman Lee watched various things taking place near Asadal from a distance.
“He’s a strong guy.”
Even though his operation “Mountain Meteor”, a fatal attack aimed at dropping a mountain into downtown Asadal, failed, Z was carrying out a more powerful attack than before.
A red sun was being lit in the distance. It was an AOE slaughter skill ‘Fire of Punishment’ that burned all living things within its striking area.
“Yeah, he deserves great respect!”
Chairman Lee began to mutter to himself with a thrilled expression as if he was a boy watching a hero’s brilliant action.
“His first impression was so striking from the beginning. He had a noble appearance. He even overwhelmed those leading thinkers from the world over. Yeah, he was really special…”
As the head of the ‘Originals’, Z held absolute power that even a dozen judges could not disobey.
“Well, I’m really curious about what that man in the mask is doing.”
But there were none of the Originals who knew his identity.
At that moment the woman standing next to him, or Chairman Lee’s secretary, Miss Choi, finally asked as she couldn’t hide her curiosity, “Even you don’t know him, Chairman?”
Even though she had served this senior boss for a long time without showing any curiosity, she dared to ask this time because she could not forget the image of the masked man that she saw first today. She had a fundamental curiosity about him: who the hell was he?
Chairman Lee replied, “Well, I don’t know him at all. Rumor has it that he’s a man in his 40s from a British server… Well, what does that matter? I know ordinary people are curious about the birth and growth of a hero, but that’s nothing, compared with the hero’s achievements.”
The chairman laughed happily and chuckled while saying that.
Then he continued, “How can an ordinary man figure out a hero’s aspirations? We are not even qualified to know about him.”
It was not even known why that guy was called the last letter of the alphabet, ‘Z’, or what it meant. He just introduced himself as Z.
Therefore, the nickname ‘Z’ was the only information about him, and his face was always covered with an iron mask, so even his usual expression was kept secret.
In other words, he was a total mystic.
However, those who worked a little more closely with him, such as the ‘judges’ who were the core executives of Originals, knew one more thing about him.
In other words, Z was the ‘first man chosen’ by the Helper.
Chairman Lee said, “He received the unknown touch ahead of the Necromancer. By the way, he didn’t like it because when he noticed that they were trying to take advantage of him, he declined their offer.”
GM, Zero Earth, the Helper, etc, were things in a different world that ordinary men could not know anything about. Of course, the Necromancer did not directly acknowledge their existence. Nonetheless, they were accepted as an open fact.
And the fact that he was related to such things made him look very ‘special’ in this world. It served as a kind of ‘justification’ because it meant that he faced the truth of the game that even ordinary people didn’t even know at all.
How could he be chosen by the Helper first ahead of the Necromancer?
It’s going to be a huge plus for Z.
Its effect was powerful enough to empower Z and the Originals, not the Necromancer, to rule this world.
“And today he might be able to add one more nickname to his existing one, namely, Necromancer Slayer…”
To seize the real power in the turbulent times, he needed some sort of ’cause,’ and today he was going to combine the two ’causes.’
***
Z looked at his world tree while feeling the rough waves of the ‘Fire of Punishment’ burning on his hand.
‘Is the Necromancer there?’
He hated the Necromancer. He’d never met him, but he began to hate him at some point. He reconfirmed his hatred of the Necromancer.
‘You don’t deserve that position. It was given to me in the first place, but you were lucky to have taken it from me by expedients.’
It was also true that Z was contacted by the Helper, and earlier than the Necromancer at that.
He experienced his first ‘system error’ when he got the title of ‘Guardian’ before anyone else as the No. 1 in the rankings of a certain server. The person who borrowed the voice of the boss monster ‘Giant Gargoyle,’ namely, the Helper, spoke to Z.
‘He promised to support me.’
But one thing was wrong. In other words, Z rejected the Helper’s effort to contact him. That was not true. Z trusted the Helper and waited for his contact.
Since then, the Helper has helped Z after contacting him twice. Backed by the Helper’s support, Z rolled on with great success.
He was trusted and admired by his capable colleagues.
‘I could have done well.’
But at some point, the Helper changed his attitude toward him.
‘All of a sudden, the Helper has asked me to help the Necromancer! I’ve been doing well alone!’
Z was pushed out, after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - Age After Ending (16)
chapters.content:
Chapter 502: Age After Ending (16)
Yes. It was not that Z avoided contacting the Helper. Z was pushed out by the Necromancer, then he was forced to play second fiddle to the Necromancer.
Just as Li Wei, who was ranked No. 1 in China’s 2nd server, came to the Necromancer at the request of the Helper, and played a decisive role in helping him out, Z was also asked to play a role similar to her’s.
So Z declined the Helper’s demands. Then the Helper threatened Z by giving him all kinds of penalties.
‘I felt it then.’
Z’s eyes inside the purple mask glowed.
‘The Helper, they are not gods, they make the wrong choice, and even more, they are stuck into a wrong way of thinking…’
– Caution! The ‘Fire of Punishment’ will be activated in the area to wipe out all ‘living creatures’. (Remaining time: 00:00:03)
“They are nothing but the voices of the devil.”
– Fire of Punishment has been completed.
“The empire built with the power of the devil must be duly destroyed.”
The red ball that had been swinging on his hand came to a stop slowly as if it stabilized. But its heat was stronger than ever.
Clang-
The ground on which Z was standing was split. Even though he produced the ball of fire, he could not hold it any longer.
Z aimed the ‘Fire of Punishment’ at Asadal. Then, as if it was tilting a huge bowl to pour out its contents at once, it melted from the top of the red ball and began to spread toward Asadal.
Even Valkyrie had no other choice but to back away from the heat of the Fire of Punishment, so no one could stop him.
The intense flames spread widely and poured in, filling the space more and more rapidly and wildly, like a tide reaching the ground by tidal force.
At that moment the world tree reacted.
Wooooooooooooo-
As it was confronting the rushing Fire of Punishment, the world tree began to radiate light.
“What the heck is that?”
Blue energy burst out of the world tree in a hemispherical shape. It was a tremendous power.
Slam!
Z was swept away by the energy, and thrown backward, crashing into the outer wall of the building before hitting the ground in darkness.
“…”
Z could not figure out the ongoing situation.
Just before he was engulfed by the fire, he saw a wave bursting out of the world tree.
Blue energy radiated out from it in a hemispherical shape with great speed, sweeping everywhere before being sucked into the body of every player in Asadal. And then it spread all over the world.
At that moment Sungwoo was standing at the roots of the world tree.
– You have successfully cleared the myth quest <Origin of Race (Dragon)>.
* You receive a reward. (You’re evolving into a new race)
‘Done.’
Finally, he cleared the lengthy mythic quest.
– Your body evolves into a different form.
* You may go through some pain.
“Ooops…”
Sungwoo groaned when he felt his whole body twist.
Like the message warned, he felt a lot of pain all over his body. He felt as if new bones and flesh were filled between his bones and skin, becoming hard and tough.
‘Actually, my body is changing like that.’
A total changeover was going on inside his body.
It was as if something unique to a dragon was layered on his body’s unique particle structure as a human being.
Fortunately, his changing process didn’t take long.
– You have been reborn as a ‘Dragon Race.’
* All stats will increase. (+10)
* Magic resistance increases. (+50%)
* Physical defense increases. (+50%)
* Fear resistance increases. (+100%)
* Fire immunity increases. (+150%)
* Body regeneration increases. (+100%)
* Health recovery increases. (+100%)
Finally, he has been reborn as a Dragon Race member.
It wasn’t just Sungwoo whose body was changed. About 300,000 players belonging to the World Tree camp went through the same change that Sungwoo did. And those players who would join the World Tree camp would have to go through the same process.
“I wonder if I will be alright.”
He still felt it uncomfortable to break away from being human to turn into something else. But he felt relieved that he was not much different from a human being on the surface. He was worried that he might be changed to something like a bizarre reptile, but it seemed that since the designers of the game were humans, they took some basic aesthetic factors of a human being into account.
But he felt his skin was much tougher than before, and his eyes also felt strange.
– According to your will, your ‘vision method’ is changed. (Current way: heat sensing)
It seemed that his eye structure itself changed.
‘Man, I think it will take some time for me to get used to it.’
Not only his vision but also his senses improved several times. He could even feel the humidity around him, but it was hard to describe the sense of humidity in a human language. In other words, he felt pretty strange about it.
So it was certain that his body changed.
But that’s not all.
– You can acquire a new ‘Race Skill’ if you improve ‘Race Resonance’.
[Skill Information]
– Name: Descendants of the Dragon
– Rank: Myth
– Category: Exclusive race skills
– Consumption: None
The ‘Dragon people’ who are born with dragon blood can express their ‘latent abilities,’ depending on the level of development of the whole race (Race Resonance). There is no skill that you can use because the current Race Resonance is low (level 0).
‘Gosh, there is one more thing I have to care about.’
Sungwoo had so many skills that he could hardly remember all of them.
Ku-gu-gu-gu-gu-gu-
At that moment his eyes, which were set to a heat sensor, noticed something.
Red heat was coming toward him from a distance. It looked like a sandstorm in Dubai.
“Oh, I see!”
It was the massacre skill ‘Fire of Punishment’ that was doomed to attack Asadal. Pushed back by the ‘wave of evolution’ emitted by the world tree, it started to come toward him belatedly.
Ku-gu-gu-gu-gu-gu-
But Sungwoo was not afraid of that heat at all. After he became a dragon race, his fire resistance increased by a whopping 150%. This value was equivalent to the point at which the ‘Salamander’s Aura’ was activated.
‘If it has been issued to everyone, it’s no problem at all.’
What was the effect of Salamander’s Aura?
– When ‘Fire Immunity’ exceeds a certain level (150%), ‘Salamander’s Aura’ is granted.
* ‘Burn’ effect is applied to all direct attacks.
* If you are hit by a ‘fire attack’, your health will be restored. (+1%)
This was the effect of feeling the enemy’s fire attack not as an attack, but rather as a buff.
Kugugugugugugu-
The Fire of Punishment reached its target.
But the people of the World Tree camp living in Asadal would simply take it as something like a hot wind, or something like a sauna that would wipe away their sweat, then refresh themselves.
“I don’t know who he is, but he must be pretty disappointed.”
As Sungwoo expected, the enemy’s fatal attack didn’t inflict any damage to Asadal at all because nothing happened.
The Fire of Punishment failed in vain.
But Z did not know the cause of that failure. But he instinctively felt the Necromancer must have played some dirty trick this time, too.
“After all, can’t I nullify his advantage that he has monopolized to make his brilliant achievements until now?”
Still, Z did not give up. He has failed many times so far.
“Whew…”
Instead of giving up, he preserved his energy and kept trying.
As a result, he came close to achieving his goal without any major setbacks.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - Age After Ending (17)
chapters.content:
Chapter 503: Age After Ending (17)
“Someday I will surely beat him.”
Actually, he was determined to win this time.
And he had another plan for his victory.
‘They said a wormhole was going to open. No matter how strong he is, he can’t beat the people who have designed this game.’
Z used a symbol engraved on his forearm to contact his subordinate who had infiltrated the wormhole lab.
– Preparing for voice transmission…
A little while ago, the mole he planted there sent him very important information.
According to him, the wormhole would soon open, and the GMs of the so-called Zero Earth, who some of the Originals praised as “great people”, were returning.
‘He’s finished.’
Z thought he couldn’t stop them. And he thought they would rule the earth again.
Originally he planned to curry favor with them by killing the Necromancer before they came back, but it would not matter.
‘Anyway, they will kill the Necromancer. And they will surely want somebody to fill the vacuum left by the Necromancer.’
He wanted to believe so.
“Jason, this is Z. I look forward to your update.”
After sending his mole a brief message, Z hid in an alley. Valkyrie was nearby.
So the situation was a bit different from before. He would be in big trouble if he got caught by her.
A little later Jason responded to him. He said he was waiting for Z’s order. So Z ordered him to move the ‘death squad’ on standby in the US server in Philadelphia.
“We’re going to take control of the wormhole lab. And we will welcome the game designers.”
At this moment, someone was opening the wormhole. But nobody knew who they might be. But Z naturally assumed that they were the human race of Zero Earth. So he prepared to meet them.
***
“Hey, it’s so hard.”
Some whining was heard amid the fierce wind somewhere in the air under the deep blue sky.
“Don’t complain! You have only flown for a few hours!”
Somebody scolded the one whining in a harsh voice.
“I’m serious! I’m going to fall at any moment…”
At that moment, the black dragon bounced out of the clouds and fell quickly.
Then, he gained strength again and soared high, but he was staggering in the air as if it was hard. The red-haired woman riding on the back of the black dragon screamed.
“I’ll kill you if you don’t listen to me!”
Huffing and puffing, she grabbed the horn on the black dragon’s back and shook it violently.
“Hey! Don’t you think I’ve already sized you up? I’ve flown around the world much more than you, right?”
“Well, I have only learned to fly recently, but you’re so mean if you insist I should fly several hundreds of kilometers when I had a tough training only last night!”
“It’s your father who has wanted me to train you hard! I can’t do anything! Your father is the captain, and I’m your guardian! So I’m going to scold you dearly if you keep whining!”
“But if you open the portal, I don’t have to struggle to fly like this…”
Wheeeeeeeng-
Startled by the sound of something burning, the black dragon stretched his long neck down. Suddenly smoke was coming out of the woman’s mouth.
“Hey, kid. You are annoying to me because I am in charge of you like this. I’m not spoon-feeding you, right? I have to teach you how to feed with a spoon. In that respect, I think I’m doing well. So I just hope you can do well like me.”
“…”
“We’re going to finish this soon, so let’s have a quiet drive, okay?”
“Sure…”
The woman lay on the back of the dragon’s wide back.
But she began to hear it again.
Rattle! Rattle!
She has been hearing some strange noise for a while now, but she heard it when she stopped talking.
“Ugh? What the heck is this noise?”
The woman raised herself. Then she stuck her head out of the dragon’s back and looked around. Then the dragon somehow awkwardly twisted his body.
“Hey! Put them back in!”
Rattle! Rattle!
Five or six bird-shaped skeletons were flying while supporting the dragon’s stomach.
“You have a good ear!”
“I’m going to kill you if you make fun of me!”
A teacher and a student were crossing the continents and oceans toward a small island.
***
The dust finally settled.
The ‘Fire of Punishment’ that struck Asadal did not inflict any damage, and the ‘Beast Terror’ attack from three directions was also controlled, turning into a small amount of EXP. After all, Asadal suffered little damage.
Soon, Kyungsoo came to Sungwoo and reported about the situation.
“We are currently maintaining Level-1 alertness, and are searching all places within 50 km of Asadal.”
They still had to be alert against additional terrorist attacks, and at the same time, they needed to take follow-up measures to recover the damage.
“And we have captured 238 Originals members, but we’ve much more than them. We’re counting the exact figure of their casualties. By the way, do you remember Chairman Younghwan Lee, who once led the Reconstruction Alliance? We’ve also captured him. Man, he was one of the judges of the Originals!”
The ‘White Wolf Forensics Team’ followed Chairman Lee and his clique to the end and eventually captured them alive. It was the result of their persistent chase.
“If we make good use of this old man, I think we can track down the members of the Originals currently hiding in the Korean server. Let me leave this job to the chief of the Intelligence Department.”
“Sure, go ahead.”
It seemed that they undermined the enemy greatly by effectively blocking all their attacks.
However, Z disappeared.
According to Jisu, the only one who witnessed him, when he failed in the attack using the Fire of Punishment, he chose to escape. So she chased him as best as she could, but he disappeared all of a sudden. o rushed to pursue him, but he disappeared. He seemed to have used the portal he had prepared in advance.
“Z was quite capable. And he seemed to have some more hidden cards. So he will surely come back, carrying a more powerful weapon. So we have to track him down first and kill him to prevent any further damage.”
She expressed concern. As long as he was alive, it was certain that one day he would bring more catastrophe.
Hearing that, however, Sungwoo calmly nodded and said, “Maybe we will see him soon.”
Sungwoo knew that he was faced with a more important problem right now.
