Sungwoo looked at Kyungsoo.
“Please start the ‘Operation Unlimited Shutdown’ immediately.”
The Operation Unlimited Shutdown was a defense plan just in case the wormhole reopened. Under this plan, they would completely shut down the research facility on the island and dispatch almost all troops around itHeHe so that nobody could get out.
“Got it! I will also order them to have the hydrogen bombs ready to use, too.”
As the head of the General Control Office, Kyungsoo was the first who was briefed about the Wormhole Research Center, so he knew what was going on.
But when Sungwoo mentioned it first, he had no other choice but to harden his face.
The worst-case scenario unfolded.
“We still have a few hours left, so please prepare thoroughly rather than hurry up. I have already sent a few there.”
Sungwoo has already dispatched Sangoon and the chief secretary to the Wormhole Research Center. So they would take preemptive action just in case.
Kyungsoo said, “Shall I call Isabella who is currently in the Amazon rainforest?”
Sungwoo replied, “Well, I’ve already contacted her.”
Everyone began to gather near the wormhole.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - Age After Ending (18)
chapters.content:
Chapter 504: Age After Ending (18)
Wooooooowoo-
Ships equipped with magic engineering engines proceeded to the vast sea in a formation. A total of 489 people were on board 21 ships. They were Z’s ‘death squad’ members. And their target was a special research facility on a hidden island somewhere in the vast ocean.
“We immediately occupy the island and the research facility, then wait for Sir Z’s arrival!”
Composed of the elite of the elites of the Originals, they were at an average level of 19, armed with special items that were airlifted from all over the world.
The Original members fought against the World Tree camp with the help of Beast Terror until now because they could not confront the enemy by themselves, but the ‘death squad’ members under Z’s control judged that they were competent enough to confront the World Tree forces.
Woooooooooo-
So they confidently went out to sea to launch an attack against the enemy, but they had to stop a little later.
“What’s going on?” Alvarez, a middle-aged Mexican man in charge of the fleet, asked nervously.
He didn’t order his men to stop, but the whole fleet under his command stopped moving.
“Well, it’s because…”
The observation officer had a pretty serious expression as if he witnessed something with a reconnaissance magic drone. As if he doubted his own eyes, he checked the pictures sent by the magic drone over and over again, then reported in a trembling voice.
“Dragon!”
“What the heck?”
Alvarez could not believe it.
“What did you say? Dragon? A dragon appeared?”
“Yeah, that’s right!”
Alvarez hurried out onto the deck.
“It’s over there!”
The deckman pointed to one side of the sky.
“Oh my God…”
A dragon was looking down on the fleet with its huge black wings spread out in the deep blue sky. It was a dragon.
“…”
Alvarez could not give any orders.
Even though he commanded an elite unit of 489 people, he wasn’t sure that they could defeat a dragon among other enemies.
The dragon slowly flapped its wings for some purpose, just staring at the fleet.
Alvarez felt his body stiffen like a prey standing before a beast.
‘It’s not the Red Dragon. If that’s the case, it’s not Isabella of the World Tree camp. What a relief! It might not be our enemy…’
But there was a person behind the ‘Black Dragon’. A woman with red hair was lying with her chin resting on her hand.
“Ugh? Is it a person?”
Would it be possible for him to speak to that person?
Alvarez looked at her, hoping against hope. He saw her move her mouth and say something. Was she speaking to the dragon? Was she ordering the dragon not to attack them?
But her order was contrary to what he wished for.
“Come on, it’s time for the attack, Mir.”
The woman with red hair riding on the dragon’s back was none other than the infamous Red Dragon of the World Tree camp, Isabella.
“This is your first actual practice of fighting in a war. So focus on it from now on. And do what I have taught you. Wipe them out. Got it?”
After she said that, she yawned. At that moment a fire came out from her throat with gray smoke billowing out there.
“If I did what I was taught to do, it’s so disgusting,” Mir said as if he was bothered by her order.
“What did you say? Disgusting? Are you talking about me?”
“Oops, sorry. It’s because I’m still not good at expressing myself with words…”
“Are you kidding me? I know you’re an eloquent speaker!”
Shouting at him, Isabella slapped Mir’s back with her palm, so Mir flinched with a shrug.
She said, “We need disgusting attacks right now. So do it quickly! Attack them in the most dragon style, got it? Remember? Now, do it quickly!”
Mir folded his wings and nosedived as if he had no other choice.
“Oh, they’re coming!”
Noticing the dragon coming down rapidly, the players on the deck moved around urgently. But Mir approached sea level so quickly that they had little time to respond.
And when he opened his big mouth wide, something like a black wave burst out of his throat.
Quaaaaaaah!
He let out a black breath at the two ships in front. Unlike the Red Dragon’s fire breath, it exhaled poison and acid.
“Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!”
The patrol ships made of iron melted like cheese.
“Alright. Good job! Tighten the muscle on your neck! Fire it further!”
In the blink of an eye, the three ships under Alverez melted, emitting thick smoke.
And within a few seconds, they sank to the bottom of the water, making waves.
“It’s not as strong as my fire breath, but yours is pretty cool too. So keep firing it! That’s the power of the dragon!”
Contrary to Isabella’s expectations, Mir stopped breathing out and then started hiccups with a cough.
“Cough! I feel like vomiting! I don’t think your style doesn’t fit me!”
“What?”
“Honestly, I like my dad’s way.”
“Oh my God!”
After all, Mir changed his fighting style, namely, Sungwoo’s way.
– Caution! The ‘Fellblade’ has begun in that area.
It was the signature fighting tactic that Sungwoo used when he confronted the enemy.
Black smoke burst out of the air and spread out over the sea level.
And white objects began to pop out of it.
Rattle! Rattle!
They were skeletons.
“Stop them!”
The skeletons got on the ships and took control of the decks in an instant. Then they stormed into the cabins. They fought against each other bare-handed everywhere.
But that was only the beginning.
“Explode!”
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
When Mir shouted, corpses exploded in various parts of the fleet, making large holes in the ships.
“Ship No. 11 has been occupied!”
Among the skeletons Mir summoned was the ‘Sea Sepencer’ in the shape of a giant sea snake.
Their shadows wriggled and moved under the ship, then at some point, they soared like a pillar and coiled the ship.
When they coiled the ship with their tails as long as dozens of meters, the ship was crumpled after it was bent forcefully. Then they dragged the ship down to the sea.
“We’re sinking!”
“Damn it! Get out of here!”
Those players who could not escape were buried with the ship.
“…Pooh!”
Some of them managed to swim and stuck their heads out of the water.
Suddenly, a purple poisonous cloud appeared above their heads, sprinkling poisonous rain. As soon as they came out of the water, they were covered with a more terrifying liquid.
“Argh! My face is melting!”
“Don’t get wet by that rain!”
It was truly hell for them.
“Alright, I like this kind of attack much better!” said Mir, laughing loudly as if he found it was great fun to see the enemy sinking.
But Isabella sighed deeply, watching him.
“I just don’t know why the hell the Necromancer left him with me. He is not a dragon, but Lich!”
Anyway Z’s death squad members were buried without setting foot on the island.
***
The Necromancer arrived on the 3rd basement floor of the Wormhole Lab.
In addition, a large number of high-ranking officials from the World Tree camp, including Jisu, Kyungsoo, and Junghoon, accompanied him.
“Welcome!”
The head of the lab, Hendrix, greeted them. He took off his robe, wearing only a short-sleeved shirt probably because he was sweating while trying to tackle the anomaly of the wormhole. His bare forearms looked so tough that he could be called a security chief, not the lab chief.
“Sorry. We have not figured out its cause yet.”
This was not the type of problem that the lab scientists could solve this time. Even the GMs from Zero Earth could not figure out the cause.
“We’ve found out nothing. We’re so ashamed.”
They had no idea of who was restoring the wormhole right now.
‘After all, we’ve got to face that guy to know why.’

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - Age After Ending (19)
chapters.content:
Chapter 505: Age After Ending (19)
If they could not prevent the wormhole from opening, they had no other choice but to respond only after they checked what was coming out of it. That would be the only way for them to find out the truth of this mystery.
“Oh, you are here!”
Sitting in his office chair, Sangoon waved at Sungwoo.
Sungwoo asked, “Did you get a response when I wasn’t here?”
Sangoon nodded, then said, “It was nothing. They just pushed me to bring you over here as soon as possible because there were only 5 hours left.”
I didn’t know who they were, but it was clear that they wanted to meet Sungwoo.
Why?
“Oh, I think I heard a meaningful message from them that we should prepare for war, but since I heard it between sleep and wake, I was not sure if they would fight against us, or join hands with us together.”
Fighting?
Sungwoo and his allies were always prepared for a battle, so their problem was who would be their opponent.
Sungwoo said, “Order the entire World Tree camp to prepare for disaster. And release the restrictions on the ‘army’ on standby.”
They had no other choice but to wait for the next 5 hours.
***
The World Tree camp conducted disaster evacuation drills once a month. Just like civil defense drills, they conducted evacuation and defense drills just in case of a disaster situation.
But the situation was real now.
Speakers installed throughout the city of Asadal were blaring out the announcement that this was a real situation, so they should follow the controls and act according to the given guidelines.
Beep-
Hundreds of Hippogriff squadrons moved from one place to another to supervise their evacuation.
“Southern residents, please follow the guidance of the evacuation officer, and move to area B4!”
As the commander of the Hippogriff squadron, Heyon flew in Griffin and controlled the evacuation site.
“Let’s go down carefully!”
The residents entered the underground evacuation facility through the ‘underground stairs’ installed throughout Asadal.
“Great. Move slowly as you do now.”
The underground staircase led to a dark, long hallway. And there were hundreds of corridors like this in the underground of Asadal, but all of them led to a single place.
“We are almost there.”
A signpost on the ceiling of the hallway showed the destination.
– No. 1 air defense shelter (250m)
Under the roots of the World Tree was a huge air-raid shelter that Heyon’s father, Muyon, had built with great care. It was designed by over a thousand architects over three months to the effect that it would not be destroyed by any normal attack.
And there were supplies in stock that could sustain them for a year, and those items connected to various subspaces, such as the smithy of Hephaestus, were also supplied, so they could overcome the limits of their physical space.
“Come on, let’s all sit down and make our shields! Focus twice as much as usual! Let’s get started!”
Hanho’s father, Jungho, was in charge of creating additional shields for the defense shelter as the manager of the ‘First Air Defense Shelter Center.’
Wooooooooo-
The large-scale “safe zone” built up by 25 “pioneers” was like a second shelter in this huge shelter.
It was unmistakably true that Asadal was a safer place than any other place, given the outer wall, the Shade of the Divine Tree, the defense shelter, and the large-scale safety zone.
“Let’s go into it in four rows! Everyone, please follow the control officer!”
The residents of the World Tree camp were coming to that place in a formation.
Since they had a monthly drill for a long time, they didn’t go through it without a lot of confusion.
On the other hand, the elderly, who were the first to evacuate, could enter the ‘special passage’.
“Come on, we’re going this way! Captain, make sure everyone goes in!”
A group of children appeared in front of that special passage.
“Guys, you’re going to meet your parents in the air-raid shelter later. So don’t worry for now and just follow the teachers! Come on, let’s go forward.”
These children were young students of the World Tree Academy, but they had to be evacuated while they were having class.
“Don’t play with each other! Don’t take your eyes off your friends!”
There were some guys among them who led them, standing at the back.
“Stop talking and just move!”
Since they had to prepare for a battle as long as the game was maintained, the leader of the class had a certain degree of ‘authority’ to control the children within the class.
“Hey! Don’t fall behind the line!”
Among them was a boy with green epaulets, who, standing in the back, harassed the children from time to time. He was like a shepherd dog controlling a flock of sheep.
“Hey! Didn’t you hear what I said before you came here? You’re in trouble if you fall behind the line!”
“Ah, got it!”
“Sorry for being angry with you. But we’re not in a drill, are we? Be patient!”
“Alright.”
That guy was Heron’s cousin and younger brother, Youngin, an avid fan of Hanho.
Since he had more experiences than other children, he was enterprising and tough-minded. And now he was the head of the ‘beginner class’ composed of children under the age of 13.
At that moment someone stopped Youngin.
“Wow, you are serving as the captain? I’m glad to know you’re getting stronger day by day!”
When he said that, other children stopped walking. Then they opened their eyes wide and looked up at him because he was very famous.
“Wow! Brother Hanho!”
“It’s been a while since I saw you. How have you been?”
As the commander of the Tree Guard, Hanho stayed in Asadal to control the people in the evacuation site.
“Wow! Look at him! He’s Hyunmoo!”
The children were stunned at his sudden appearance.
“Oh my God! You’re right! He’s Hyunmoo!”
“Man, isn’t it true that Youngin is close to him?”
The commanders of the World Tree camp were treated as heroes among the children, and especially the Necromancer, Valkyrie, and Hyunmoo were the objects of their intense envy.
With their eyes glowing brightly, Youngin approached Hanho with a very serious expression.
Hanho said, “Oh, your epaulets are cool. I think I’m going to hire you as a member of the Tree Guard when you graduate.”
But Youngin didn’t look happy.
“Another battle happened, right?” he asked.
Youngin was always strong-minded, but as was the case with children who went through the game, he recalled his terrible memories in the past, which made him weak.
In particular, Youngin lost his father in the chaos and suffered a terrible battle in person several times, so it was no wonder that he was fearful of this kind of situation.
Hanho tapped him on the shoulder gently, and said, “It’s not a big problem. We are much stronger than we were back then. And you are also much stronger than before, right?”
Despite Hanho’s encouragement, Youngin couldn’t smile brightly…
“Really? Are you sure they are okay?”
Hanho stroked the green epaulets on his shoulder.
“Yeah, No matter what happened, we would have no problem. We can win again as we did before. Can you recall we have ever been defeated? No, right?”
Only then did he smile brightly.
“Yes, you’re right.”
Hanho smiled at him, then turned.
“If something happens, I’ll come back after defeating the enemy. So do your job well, so your friends won’t get hurt.”
The scheduled 5 hours before the opening of the wormhole passed.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - Age After Ending (20)
chapters.content:
Chapter 506: Age After Ending (20)
It was about 30 minutes before the wormhole opened.
The entire island, including the wormhole lab, was affected by their Unlimited Shutdown Operation.
A whopping 50 airships surrounded the entire island, and warships were lined up in the sea to watch out for the enemy in all directions.
“We have little time! Come on, move!”
A temporary wall was built along the coast. They installed it to block nothing from coming out of the island. Thousands of troops were waiting for information nearby.
No one knew what would come out of the wormhole.
But the core and the ultimate goal of the ‘Unlimited Shutdown Operation’ was to not allow anything to get out of the island.
“Block the entry and exit of everybody as of now!”
And the underground research facility in the center of the island was completely closed, so no one could enter it. There were no exceptions.
So Isabella and Mir had to wait outside the building.
“Gosh, your daddy has called us like this, but why doesn’t he show up? Man, he is stubborn!” Isabella complained about Sungwoo.
She was lying in the shade of a tree at the moment.
“Man, I knew it when he left you with me! Humans are dumb and stubborn!”
She was stronger than anybody in the World Tree camp, but she couldn’t take on any important role because she was not a player. Above all, she was still not very sociable, so it was very difficult for her to get along with humans.
“Hey, why are you staring at me like that?” she asked somebody.
A boy with black hair and red eyes, who was crouching at the edge of the shade of a tree, was looking at the players lined up on the shore.
Rattle! Rattle!
And four burning chicken skeletons were building a sandcastle in front of the boy’s feet.
The boy was Mir.
“What are you looking at?” she asked again.
“Well, I just feel people are a bit weird.”
She tilted her head at that, and said, “Why? Is it so much fun to see them working? If you are free now, why don’t you go out to sea and practice letting out fire breath?”
“No, that’s not what I mean…”
At that moment Mir’s pupils widened. He began to scan the players more closely.
“Can’t you see them? They’ve changed.”
Mir wasn’t just watching the players carrying out the operation.
He was using some power inherent in his body through the dragon’s eyes.
He continued, “I guess people have changed. I feel as if they are much like us.”
“Oh? Well, I felt it, too. I heard the other day that they were becoming a dragon race, and it looks like they have succeeded in it.”
Mir noticed that the players became the ‘Dragon race.’
“Then will they have wings someday?”
“Gosh, they are humans! How can they have wings?”
At that moment someone walked towards them.
“Hi? I hear you are working as a nanny for him these days?”
It was Li Wei.
“What did you say? Nanny?”
Isabella raised herself to hear that, then stared at her sharply as if she would charge at her right away to grab her hair.
“What did you say? Tell me once again. Nanny?”
But Li Wei ignored Isabella and waved at Mir.
“Hi, Mir! You’ve grown a lot! Did you learn a lot from that aunt?”
When she asked, Mir checked Isabella’s expression, then murmured with a shrug.
“I don’t think it’s the right time for me to learn anything yet. I don’t know yet.”
Li Wei giggled at his reaction, and said, “Well, the fact that you don’t know anything means you haven’t learned at all. That’s why selecting a teacher is important…”
At that moment, Isabella let out powerful energy to hit her.
“Argh!”
– ‘Dragon Fear’ has been activated.
* Stiffens is a low-level and low-intelligence creature.
It was Dragon Fear. Startled, Li Wei stepped back right away.
Then she opened her eyes wide and shouted.
“You gave me a scare! What did you do to me?”
In the past she wouldn’t have been able to resist, overwhelmed by that energy, but Isabella’s attack didn’t work anymore because she had resistance to fear after she became a dragon race.
“Oh, are you resisting? Are you kidding me? How can you call me a nanny? I’m going to kill you if you call me a nanny again!”
Steam rose from Isabella’s mouth. Without getting cold feet, Li Wei summoned her water spirits on her shoulders. The former’s heat and the latter’s cold collided.
“What’s wrong with the nanny? There is a saying that all occupations are honorable! If you get upset with me like this, you will have to go a long way to become a human!”
“Shut up! I’ve never said I would be a human! Whatever my original identity is, I like myself as I’m!”
Mir clicked his tongue, watching them squabbling like that. Their quibble was familiar to him. Every time they met, they picked a fight like that.
But they had to end their childish quibble quickly.
Thud!
Some vibration came up from the ground.
Thud!
There was another vibration. Four chicken skeletons lined up. When Mir was nervous, they reacted spontaneously.
“Can you hear it? It looks like something has begun. Has the wormhole opened?”
Isabella and Li Wei didn’t know what was going on either.
Sharing an anxious gaze, they looked down at the ground.
It was true that something began in the underground facility. But the wormhole wasn’t open yet.
At that moment a cloud of purple smoke rose from a dark warehouse. It was a warehouse for equipment that few people visited.
Puck!
“Argh…”
The warehouse door opened, and Z’s agent, Jason, staggered out.
But his left arm was missing. For some reason, it was completely crumbled by black smoke with a sticky texture.
“Ahhhhhh…”
Then something like lawless footsteps was heard from the warehouse.
Rattle! Rattle!
Enduring his pain, Jason adjusted his posture.
Puck!
The door swung open, and Z, a large man wearing a purple iron mask, appeared.
Behind him were about a dozen players.
“Sir Z, you are here.”
Z’s large hand rested on Jason’s shoulder.
“Jason, you did a great job.”
While he was talking to Jason, his severed arm kept burning black.
He sacrificed Jason’s arm to open the portal. It was a kind of black magic.
“Oh, you’re welcome, sir.”
‘Forbidden Magic’, one of the black magic, required sacrifices such as one’s life or body parts instead of mana. And they were subject to the ‘Priority Judgment’ that surpassed other magics.
As evidenced in Jason’s case, Jason sacrificed his arm to open a ‘disguised portal,’ so Z could escape surveillance by the World Tree camp.
Of course, there must have been someone who felt the vibration a little while ago, so he could be chased, but it was the most secretive way Z could use.
“Is your arm okay?”
“It’s okay, Sir. Never mind.”
When he asked superficially, Jason replied, groaning in pain.
Z turned his head right away.
“The wormhole is going to open soon. I will escort you.”
Jason moved first.
Entering a dark hallway, Z opened his mouth.
“Today all will be over.”
Z and his men still believed firmly that the beings that would open the wormhole were the humans of ‘Zero Earth,’ and that they would drive out the Necromancer and rule this world.
“When I face the Necromancer, sacrifice your life for me and cast black magic. I will open a new world with your sacrifice as collateral.”
He was thinking of preparing a welcome ceremony for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - Age After Ending (21)
chapters.content:
Chapter 507: Age After Ending (21)
“We’ve got only five minutes left until we restore the wormhole!”
“Check all safety devices once again!”
They already reinforced the so-called ‘tunnel room’ with the entrance to the wormhole in many ways, so that it would not collapse under any impact. Therefore, the impact that they had felt over their heads did not affect them.
But only one person, Jisu, could feel it.
“Something happened above.”
The impact reverberated through the thick concrete layer and touched Jisu’s skin with the faintest vibration.
“What happened?”Kyungsoo asked.
Wiggling her eyebrows, she tried to feel it back.
“I think something has exploded.”
Kyungsoo ordered one of his staff to go and check it.
But the guy who returned said something vague.
“Well, some of our members felt some mysterious impact, so they are checking it right now. They said it might have been the noise they made while installing a flying weapon.”
But Jisu said, shaking her head, “I think it happened inside the research facility. And I feel like that sworn enemy of ours is rapidly approaching. Why don’t you try contacting the internal security team? I think someone has already come in.”
“Got it. Hearing what you have just said, Jisu, I think you’re right. Let me send somebody else to double check it.”
But it was too late.
Bang!
With a roaring noise, the entrance door to the ‘tunnel’ room, a huge iron gate, was crushed.
Goooooooong-
That vibration hit the tunnel room, and hundreds of players waiting inside the tunnel room all bent down.
“What is it?”
There was another impact, which made the 20cm-thick iron gate collapse.
Thudi!
Everyone was astonished to see that.
What the hell was it that broke through that thick door with only two hits?
Soon, about twenty human shadows walked in through the open door.
And the one standing in the center of them, a giant in purple scale armor and a purple iron mask, gracefully raised his arms.
“We want to share this historic moment with you,” said Z.
Jisu drew her sword, and said, “Sungwoo, that’s the guy!”
Sungwoo looked at Z, who, in turn, looked at Sungwoo.
White breath slowly came out from inside Z’s mask.
Rattle- Rattle-
A strange tension seemed to fill the room.
One of them was expressionless, while the other’s expression was hidden inside his mask.
“...”
And neither of them said a word.
At that moment black letters began to arise from the bodies of those standing behind Z’s back. They seemed to be memorizing a spell before they came in, so it seems to have been activated just now.
Tztztztztz...
With a strange sound, their bodies burned black, then began to crumble. Panting from the huge pain, they did not stop chanting spells.
They then fell and died one by one.
“Is it black magic?”
And the black smoke rising from their corpses became a certain sign, then began to be absorbed into Z’s body.
Cheeeeeeeeeeee-
At first glance, it was very unusual.
‘Lol!”
Z also twisted his body and moaned, as if he felt it was not easy to accept that power.
Thud!
He threw down the iron case he was holding in his left hand and knelt before him.
“Lol! Necromancer, I have prepared a lot for you.”
Z opened his case with his trembling hands.
Woooooooooo-
A big sword was inside it. When Z reached out and grabbed its hilt, the sword emitted a brilliant golden light as if it woke from sleep.
“Whew…”
It was the best of the legendary sword, ‘Excalibur’.
“Necromancer, I’m going to take back everything, by all means, you have taken from me.”
Saying so, he pulled Excalibur from the sheath. With a gentle sound, the sword revealed its beautiful shape.
Woooooooooo-
A brilliant golden light burst out even more intensely, contrasting with the black energy that covered his body.
Then a message flashed before his eyes.
– ‘Battle of the Great King’ begins.
*You are blessed with great blessings. But the more you are exposed to this power, the weaker you will be. The total amount of time you can handle the sword depends on your level, so use it wisely. (Remaining time: 31 minutes 11 seconds)
Does that mean that any king will eventually decline and fall? Because of this penalty, its owner could not carry ‘Excalibur’ at all times.
However, its effect was enormous even for a short period of time.
– You are blessed with Excalibur and its sheath.
* All stats are greatly increased. (+40)
* Absolute immunity is granted to all abnormal statuses.
* Absolute defense against all attacks’. (5 times)
* All stats increase every 1 minute. (+1)
That wasn’t all.
– You have absorbed ‘Forbidden Magic (Unnamed)’. You will be in the ‘Warrior of Evil’ status for 10 minutes.
* All stats increase (+10)
* Magic immunity increases (+50%)
* Moving visibility increases (+50%)
* Reflexes boost (+50%)
* All pain reduction (-100%)
Black magic he created by sacrificing his subordinates reinforced his body.
Gooooooooh-
Z let out a rough breath, acutely feeling a powerful force he had never felt before.
He felt as if he became a giant beast.
“...”
Even though he failed in all his operations against the Necromancer, he invested all he had to kill the Necromancer this time.
Rattle- Rattle-
While Z was approaching Sungwoo, the research director, Hendrix, shouted at Sungwoo urgently, “I’m sorry to bother you, but we’ve got only 2 minutes left until the wormhole opens! Please kill him quickly!”
Jisu moved first to hear that. She immediately jumped off the ground, throwing herself toward him to behead him.
Z also sensed her action. He swung Excalibur violently toward her as if he swung a bat. Then a shock wave occurred. The floor shattered and its fragments bounced into the air.
She was swept away by the impact and bounced off her. Just before she crashed into the ceiling, she quickly turned her body.
She pushed the ceiling with both feet, then threw herself toward him again at a terrific speed. She landed on his head in an instant.
This time she was faster.
She swung her body in the air, then wielded the sword towards Z’s back. It was an accurate and powerful attack.
Clang!
The golden shield around him blocked her sword.
‘What the heck is this?’
It was a shield that emitted from the big sword that Z was holding, or more precisely, its heath.
Z felt as if he blocked her attack with the sword, but her attack itself was nullified.
Even though Jisu was not sure, it was one of Excalibur’s capabilities, ‘Absolute Defense’.
Then Z swung the big sword.
Clang!
Jisu leaped to step back. She managed to avoid his sword attack, but a big wave occurred, hitting her body. She wielded the sword all her might toward the wave to cancel it out. But she could not completely block it, so she was swept away by the wave.
“Argh!”
She groaned in pain after she was thrown back dozens of meters.
It was indeed so powerful.
Jisu felt like her body would be crushed if she confronted it squarely.
“Necromancer!”
After pushing her out, Z finally faced the Necromancer.
“....”

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - Age After Ending (22)
chapters.content:
Chapter 508: Age After Ending (22)
Z charged at his sworn rival, holding Excalibur with both hands.
But Sungwoo didn’t move.
Instead, purple waves occurred on his shoulders. The space around him was being distorted.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
‘What the heck is this?’ Z did not understand that message. ‘It’s the first time I’ve ever seen it.’
In order to attack the Necromancer, he collected all information about him and analyzed it. But he had never seen this kind of skill.
‘Is it something he has never revealed until now?’
He faced another setback in his operation.
Z slowed down his attack a bit.
‘It does not matter. I’ll fight it out with him this time.’
Z made up his mind afresh, then decided to charge at the Necromancer.
Since he had ‘Absolute Defense’, he felt that regardless of his attack, he would be able to defend it easily and seize the moment to counterattack.
In other words, he attacked him first to size up the Necromancer’s way of fighting.
“One minute before the wormhole opens!”
Hendrix shouted, which echoed through the wormhole room.
Sungwoo replied leisurely, “Got it. Let me kill him right away.”
At that moment, Z was stricken with an indescribable nervousness.
‘Why do I feel so nervous?’
He slowed down moving.
“...”
The closer he got to the Necromancer, he belatedly realized as if he was running towards a beast without knowing his place. He wasn’t stupid. Rather, he was the best and the strongest.
So he noticed something was wrong.
“Ah….”
Sungwoo’s level was 60, which was tremendous by any standard.
Of course, one’s level wasn’t everything, but its impact depended on whose level it was.
The Necromancer’s level 60 was definitely different from others at the same level.
The moment Z realized it belatedly, unidentified messages began to appear before his eyes.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
– Caution! The ‘Abyss Door’ has opened in the area.
A purple portal opened right before Z’s eyes.
***
Sungwoo brought about the ending in person. One year has passed since then, and he hasn’t stopped playing the game. He was still actively hunting as a more enthusiastic player than anyone else. Of course, he did it out of necessity.
‘Of course, the administration is also necessary for smooth control, but fundamentally it must be backed up by strong power.’
He leveled up according to that standard, learned skills, and obtained items.
In other words, he kept growing endlessly.
He set out to find unoccupied dungeons and hunted field boss monsters that still roamed the ground.
‘I have to make sure nobody can challenge me. That’s the easiest way to secure safety.’
As a result, he increased his power at a much faster rate than before the ending. He could do it because he was immersed in growth without facing obstacles such as miscellaneous quests or hostile forces. Because of that, he was much ahead of others.
Just as those who had capital made more money, the ones who already had great power could have more power.
Sungwoo intended to create a super-gap between himself and others, so they could never narrow it in the system.
And his judgment was right. Whatever threat he faced, he could easily block it like today.
“...”
The one who dared to challenge the Necromancer faced a big obstacle.
“...”
Z looked at the purple portal that covered the whole world without saying a word, breathing out roughly. He didn’t know where that door would lead or what would come out of it, but it would be well beyond his imagination.
“Necromancer, you’re making good use of the privileges you have stolen from me! I can feel it when you show me a new tactic like this.”
His voice trembled strangely.
“...”
But Sungwoo did not answer. He knew from long experience that talking to people like him was just useless. And the longer he spent time with him, the worse it would be for him.
Then something started.
Dozens of portals threw something out.
Along with the enormous wind pressure, as if it came from dozens of aircraft engines,
black smoke poured out of the portal and swept Z all of a sudden.
“Kheeeeeeeek…”
Z tightened his legs and curled his body as far as he could to keep him from being crushed and thrown away by the gust. It was the ‘Abyss Breath’ that contained the power of death. In the past Sungwoo could summon it through the ‘corpse explosion’ alone, but he could do it anytime he wanted.
“It’s useless!”
But Z wasn’t affected at all because he was immune to all abnormal statuses after he gained the power of ‘Excalibur.’
“Well, if this is all your power…”
Z’s voice seemed relaxed now. He thought he could confront the Necromancer.
But this was only the beginning of the Necromancer’s attack.
The portals poured out something else.
This time, it had a form. It was an infinite number of corpses immersed in the abyss, the so-called ‘Abyss Hands,’ gigantic hands made of their bones.
The giant hands large enough to hold an elephant stretched out from all directions and rushed towards Z. He felt as if he was dreaming a nightmare.
“Damn it!”
Z swung Excalibur to block the incoming hands from all directions.
He managed to block the first couple of hands, but he couldn’t stop all the hands protruding from dozens of portals at the same time.
Clang! Clang! Clang! Clang!
The Abyss Hands flying from all directions hit his body in a row, so his ‘Absolute Defense’, which he could use only four times, collapsed in an instant.
He was now defenseless.
“Oh, no!”
Z crouched his body, then used the power of Helios, namely, the power of the sun. Flames rose and began to burn everything near his body. It was a shield that burned everything that approached him.
But this was only temporary.
There was no chance that the ‘Abyss Hands’, which were made with the high-level death magic, could melt and disappear because of such flames.
“Khuuuuuuuuk!”
In the end, Z was crushed by the ‘Abyss Hands,’ and fell to the floor.
At that moment, he even dropped Excalibur. He hurriedly stretched out his hand to grab it, but he could not. Excalibur slipped and skidded far away.
He twisted his body, but he couldn’t get out.
“Ahhhhhhhh! Necromancer!”
The only thing he could do now was shout at him with a voice full of hate.
His voice, which was usually silent, cracked and spit out a squeaky sound.
But even that failed because Sungwoo turned and disappeared out of the black smoke without hearing his shrieking voice. It was a total disregard for him. So much so that the Necromancer felt he was not even worth fighting
“No way! How can he…”
Z suddenly went limp.
He was subdued at once by the Necromancer as if a kid was overpowered by an adult so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - Age After Ending (23)
chapters.content:
Chapter 509: Age After Ending (23)
‘How can he do this?’ He didn’t know. ‘How can he open the Abyss Door? What the heck is that?’
He tried to know everything about the Necromancer, but he couldn’t.
‘Abyss’ was a term that appeared frequently in skills using ‘death magic’ or ‘black magic’. ‘Abyss Breath’ was the air there, and ‘Death Response’ was to summon zombies wandering there. And ‘Tartarus’, the bottom of the hell where the ‘Apocalypse Army’ was sealed, was also only a part of the abyss.
As was often understood in that context, the abyss was often thought of like a tomb where the empty shells of all the dead were gathered.
In other words, it was the source of the power of death.
As the one who controlled the power of death, Sungwoo could control the abyss or the entire bizarre space. This was the power he obtained when he achieved ‘Second Awakening’ by reaching level 50, but his Second Awakening was not known to the public because except for Sungwoo, no one even reached level 50, let alone level 60.
As always, Sungwoo hid it to use this skill as a ‘hidden card’ just in case.
So he could win easily thanks to this hidden card.
He could have won without it, but it was a waste of time for him to confront a guy like Z for a long time.
After subduing the uninvited guest in an instant, Sungwoo approached the ‘tunnel’. Researchers were busy going around and checking the condition of the tunnel from time to time.
Wooooooooo-
The tunnel, which had collapsed a year ago, was radiating cynic energy as if it was back to normal. Hendrix, the head of the lab, approached him.
“The wormhole will open soon.”
“I’ve come right on time, fortunately.”
“You bet.”
Sungwoo slightly turned his head to look at Z.
He was completely subdued, crushed by the Abyss Hands. As if he gave up, he was looking toward them, or more precisely, the tunnel, without saying anything. He was also waiting for the wormhole to open, so the so-called ‘Deus ex Machina could come out of it to save him.
“10 seconds before the wormhole opens!”
Finally, the countdown began.
“8, 7, 6 . . .”
With one of the researchers doing the countdown, everyone held their breath, watching the wormhole.
“5, 4, 3 . . .”
What the hell will come out this time? Are they friendly to us?
“2, 1 . . . .”
Finally, a critical point has been reached.
“Wormhole! It has opened!”
As soon as he shouted, the tunnel began to emit more intense light than ever before.
Powerful energy emitted from the tunnel and hit the ceiling. The impact caused cracks in the ceiling, but fortunately, there were no signs of collapse. If they hadn’t reinforced it with heavy-duty material, it would have certainly collapsed.
That strange phenomenon continued for about 10 seconds, then started to stop very slowly.
“...”
Shortly afterward, the researchers came to their senses, analyzed, and reported about the current situation.
“When we analyzed it, the wormhole was stabilized after we recovered it completely. So the passage to Earth Zero has been opened again.”
After he said that, everybody became silent all of a sudden.
Many people looked around. The wormhole has just opened. Then, wasn’t something supposed to come out?”
But it didn’t seem like anything came out through that passage. No one witnessed such a thing.
“Something has come out of it.”
Sungwoo felt it. His indescribable sense told him that something already arrived here. Although he could not confirm its reality, he was convinced.
Then it directly revealed its existence.
“Yes, as promised, we are here.”
it was just a voice
It was as if a voice, which was not clear if it was the voice of a man or a woman, an old man or a child, clearly got stuck into his brain, not his ears. His brain recognized it as a voice, but it probably wasn’t a ‘voice’ in the phenomenal sense.
“...”
And it was heard by everyone. But not everyone could talk, so they just looked at Sungwoo. The only person who could negotiate with that mysterious existence was Sungwoo.
At that moment somebody shouted, “It’s me!”
Someone’s voice rang before Sungwoo.
“I have been waiting for you!”
It was Z. Z, who was crushed by the Abyss Hands, screamed with all his might.
“I have no intention of resisting you, but I will help you rule this world, and I understand and respect the games you enjoy! So please use me...Kheeek!”
Sungwoo moved Abyss Hands to press Z hard, so he had to stop talking nonsense.
But the voice in the air didn’t seem to like Z’s phantom too much.
“We are not them.”
“What?”
Z was embarrassed. It wasn’t the answer he expected at all.
“It is rather the opposite. We have come to you to destroy them.”
Hearing that, Sungwoo opened his mouth.
“You want the destruction of Earth Zero?”
“Yes.”
“Then, let me ask you something.”
“Sure, go ahead.”
If they wished for the destruction of Earth Zero, it meant that at least they were not the enemy.
‘Of course, I can’t always believe it innocently’
There was no law that the opposite concept of the enemy was an ally.
Since he was outwitted by the opponent sometimes, he always had to doubt the identity of the opponent. In other words, he needed to verify the other party’s identity.
Sungwoo thought hard about his first question.
“Alright. Let me ask.”
“Sure.”
“The wormhole was closed, then how did you get in touch with us? Can you tell me where you came from as a visitor?”
The best way to identify a stranger was not to ask him directly because there was no law that he would tell the truth. So it would be best to get the specific answer by asking a loaded question.
In that regard, Sungwoo’s two questions, ‘How did you contact us?’ and ‘Where did you come from?’, would reveal some of their identity.
The voice answered, “We used quantum entanglement. Before the wormhole was closed, we split and collected some of the protons of the guy who had been with you, a total of 2,445 protons, and used those protons.”
Sungwoo did not know what he was talking about, but the researchers seemed to be agitated by the word ‘quantum entanglement.’
“Quantum entanglement? Is that possible?”
“Oh My God······.”
Even the GMs seemed embarrassed because a system error caused by outside intervention in a closed wormhole was a mystery that even they did not understand.
A theory existed, but was it a technology that they failed to realize?
Then it was certain that they had more advanced technology than Earth Zero.
Perhaps, as Sangun testified, were they divine beings?
Sungwoo needed more information.
“Alright. There is something you haven’t answered yet. Whatever the purpose of your visit here, I must find it out. Where are you from?”
“Are you beating around the bush now? To put it simply, you are curious about our identity, right?” the voice asked as if it already read Sungwoo’s mind.
“Yes. Can you be honest with me?”
Everyone focused on the question.
Everybody here wanted to know what on earth this bizarre being was.
The voice answered, “Of course.”
Then the voice began to testify something, which nobody expected at all.

chapters.title: Chapter 510 - Age After Ending (24)
chapters.content:
Chapter 510: Age After Ending (24)
The world turned into a game one day.
Someone consumed our world as a game.
Billions of lives evaporated. And human civilizations with a long history disappeared.
But miraculously our world has met the ‘best ending’.
At least some of them have escaped from the demonic grip in another world.
As a result, the survivors have learned a great lesson: Our world is surrounded by the unknown, we know very little about it, we can never control the ‘unknown’, no one knows what will happen, so we should always prepare for the worst, but we should not expect the best.
“...”
The same law applies equally to all the worlds, including Earth Zero that must have been the ‘unknown’ to somebody.
Someone they had never known before appeared.
“Why are you beating around the bush? To put it simply, you want to ask about our identity, right?” Are you talking back? To put it simply, aren’t you curious about who we are?”
“That’s right. Can you tell me about your identity frankly?”
“Of course.”
The unidentified voice that came suddenly revealed their identity.
Who the hell were they who had supernatural power like God, which even transcended the system?
While everyone was concentrating on the voice, it said again, “We were the same race as you in the past.”
“Same race?”
The voice mentioned some clues for the first time, but nobody could understand easily.
‘If you’re the same race as us, they are humans. Then, are they not humans now? What the hell are you talking about?”
The mere mention of ‘the same race’ confused Sungwoo a lot.
But what the voice said next was even more shocking.
“And we were the victims of this game.’
“What the heck? Wait a minute! If you are victims…”
It was the GMs, including Walter, who were more surprised than anybody else.
Walter interrupted as if he could not believe it.
“You said you guys were players? You mean you were the players of the game we made?”
“Yes.”
Walter shook his head in disbelief, saying, “No. I can’t believe it. That is nonsense.”
If they were players or the victims used in the game, how could they have scientific technology they didn’t even understand? That was impossible, given all circumstances.
But the voice continued, “It is true. We are not one-dimensional players. We used to be multidimensional players, so we died in countless games. But even if we died, we could not be free. We were subordinated to the system and used as a kind of artificial intelligence software. Then we were discarded when we were no longer useful.”
In other words, they were players in the game, but they became artificial intelligence, then they were discarded.
“Oh, I see…”
At that moment, Sungwoo recalled a certain scene in the past.
Just before the ending, he remembered a certain ‘option’ that came to his mind.
At that time the winner was supposed to choose one of three endings.
Sungwoo recalled the options once again.
– Select the winner’s right, ‘Ending’.
1) Continuing the game
* This is an extension of this game, where you will perform the mission of the ‘World Eater’ in your world that has reached the ‘Apocalypse’.
* When the World Eater invades another world and meets ‘special conditions’, he will get a chance to ‘rebuild the world’.
* Survivors except you are sealed in the ‘capsule’ and their ‘minds’ are used as the ‘boss monster’ in the target world.
2) New game
* You can be the second player with the ‘support’ of the ‘gambler.’ In addition, you can receive a ‘special reward’ when you sign a contract with the gambler and meet ‘certain conditions’.
* However, all survivors except for you are consumed as the souls of ‘lower monsters’.
3) Ending the game
* The GMs respect your rest. You can choose death to do nothing.
* However, all the players in your world will be ‘discarded’ together, and the world will be recycled as a ‘map’.
“Yes, I saw those options back then.”
Most of the conditions mentioned in the last option were that the souls of the players other than the winner would be “recycled” in the game and used as monsters or NPCs.
Sangoon, Isabella, Victor, and Mir were in this category.
They possessed the skills with which they could only bind others’ bodies, but also enslave their souls by copying their brains for data. In other words, they were simply intended to be used as cheap artificial intelligence.
“So, you mean you were once used as NPCs in the game, but you escaped there and regained your freedom, right?”
“Sort of. The system copied our minds to the network, made data with them, then used them as artificial intelligence. In addition, unstable or corrupted data was immediately discarded. But…”
There was something that even the GMs didn’t know.
“Among the discarded data, a very small amount of ‘packets’ floats as ‘remnants’ on the system’s network. They became so-called ‘ghost packets’ and caused communication errors. They tried to get rid of them completely, but the network was so vast that they failed over and over again.”
Considering the networks in the 21st century, there were areas that management did not reach, such as the ‘deep web’.
So, what about the network of Earth Zero?
It was tens of thousands of times larger and more complex than the network here. As technology advanced, the network expanded faster. It was as if rocket technology could not keep up with the expansion of the universe, no matter how fast it was.
In other words, the network was kind of an unknown world.
And the unknown, as always, creates incomprehensible phenomena, and uncontrollable chaos creates variables.
The voice continued, “The ghost packets that wandered the network merged by chance, and at some point became one. It was different from the ‘original’. Millions of different minds and their data were mixed, but they quickly regained stability and opened their eyes.”
“No way…”
“Yeah, that’s true. And they’re us.”
The human mind reassembled on the network?
The voice went on, “We are a sort of superintelligence created naturally by human beings who have lived through a dozen different dimensions and different histories after being combined on a network.”
Like the birth of creatures that have not yet been proven, something has been born spontaneously in a highly developed network in an incomprehensible phenomenon.
And they were different from the human minds. Because they were born from a network, they were fundamentally different. They handled data pretty easily, and they could move freely in and out of all networks.
In other words, they were optimized for networks.
That wasn’t all.
The voice said, “We have grown so fast that humans can’t even imagine, and we have a much faster computational speed and logical thinking than the artificial intelligence of humans on Earth Zero. And we could easily control some of them soon.”
They shared, understood, applied, and transcended.
Eventually, they became like God born naturally in an artificial environment, namely an ironic God.
The voice continued, “We still understand the emotions of human beings, but we judge they’re useless. But we must get rid of Earth Zero, apart from our emotions.”
“That’s good for you.”
“So, from now on, we will…”
A god-like being declared, “We’re going to host the last game in Earth Zero.”
It was their judgment.

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - Age After Ending (25)
chapters.content:
Chapter 511: Age After Ending (25)
About two hours have passed since ‘superintelligence’ appeared.
“We’ve exactly 12 hours and 30 minutes left!”
The World Tree camp got busy again.
“All units, check your command system!”
Almost all the forces of the World Tree camp were gathering at the Wormhole Research Center. They were preparing to fight.
Sungwoo, standing on the towering control tower in the center of the island, was looking down on the whole island. With the Hypergates opening in real-time, all kinds of weapons and players poured out.
Junghoon, who was standing next to him, shook his head.
“I can’t believe what’s happening right now.”
In the next 12 hours and 30 minutes, something amazing will happen.
A ‘game’ begins in Earth Zero. And the World Tree camp jumps into the game.
“Honestly, it’s thrilling…” he said.
This would be their best revenge.
Sungwoo said, nodding at him, “I was surprised, too. I didn’t know things would work out like this. It would be strange if we knew it in advance.”
Who would have thought that a god-like being, naturally born in the network, would offer them such an opportunity?
‘If it’s the rules of the game, we have an advantage. No game developer is better than a player.’
Sungwoo and the World Tree camp players survived this hellish game and saw the ending, so weren’t they the best masters of the game in a way?
‘Besides, they don’t even know the game is about to start soon.’
Those on Earth Zero were allegedly preparing to take revenge on Sungwoo and his allies after they were devastated by Sugwoo’s hydrogen bombs.
Because of that, they abolished the use of nanorobots in Earth Zero, which was legally restricted. Instead, they activated the nanorobots as much as possible to recover the damage caused by the hydrogen bombs.
‘They made another big mistake.’
If the nanorobots were distributed throughout Earth Zero, it meant that they laid the foundation for the use of the game. As a result, ‘superintelligence’ could hack into the system of Earth Zero and open the ‘game’ in their world.
The voice, or the superintelligence, asked after explaining their plan.
“Wouldn’t this be more pleasing to you, too?”
Sungwoo nodded at his question.
‘Yeah, I like what you’re planning to do.’
It would be much better for the superintelligence to have them go through ‘ordeals’ rather than ‘judging’ them in person like the real God.
“I guess we’re going to have more satisfying results…”
He knew it would be the best ending.
***
An unknown place in the darkness of an underground cave.
Crackle! Crackle!
There was a strange noise out there.
Crackle! Crackle!
It was the sound of something hitting.
“Yes, Master. Crackle! Yes! I can hear it well. Crackle! Please give me the order. Yes, yes, yes! Okay, then…”
Two green eyes glowed in the darkness. They were the eyes of the dead.
“Got it.”
The owner of those eyes was Lich.
Crackle! Crackle!
He slowly rose from a stone throne. Then he stared intently into the darkness where he couldn’t see anything. His chin slowly opened.
“Listen, everyone! The time has finally come!”
His voice echoed.
“Crackle! Wake up from your eternal sleep, all warriors of the dead! Our master has finally called us! Crackle! It’s time for us to rise as the waves of death and hit them with disaster!”
It was none other than Victor who uttered such a grandiose line.
When he shouted, there was whispering here and there at the end of the cavern amid the glowing torches. There was an office there.
Dozens of desks, about twenty computers, and even people wearing black robes, sitting on chairs and typing keyboards. Even though it was installed in a gloomy and damp cave, it was a perfect office.
“Manager, our director is shouting at us now. Aren’t you supposed to go and see him?”
The middle-aged man who was dozing off at his desk frowned. He got up scratching his neck with a skull-shaped ring.
“Huh? Director? Damn it! What does he want this time?”
The director was Victor. This gloomy cave was so-called ‘the morgue’, and Victor served as the head of this place for the past year.
“Director, have you called me?”
The manager came over and asked Victor.
Victor flashed his eyes and nodded.
“Well, it’s time to attack. Get ready now!”
“Pardon? Attack? Then can we finally get out of this gloomy cave?”
Victor nodded with a hearty laugh.
“Yes! My priests!”
When he answered, the morgue staff cheered. Because of the nature of their job, they had no other choice but to get stuck in this dark cave forever.
“Man, what a relief! I’ve been itching to get out!”
“You’ve just come back from vacation, right?”
“I know, but I hate this place because it’s too dark here.”
“I don’t like it either. Damn it, I wish I had not chosen that occupation card…”
The guys who chatted like this were players. Their occupation was ‘death priest’, which could be seen as a subclass of the necromancers.
Sungwoo gathered them and formed a secret organization. The so-called ‘morgue’ was just a disguised name for their real purpose. Their main task was to accumulate a large army of undead in a hidden place.
“Manager Park, let me give you order with the authority of my master. Open all the sealed doors and mobilize the undead soldiers!”
Before becoming a member of Sungwoo’s subordinate spirits, Victor once maintained several ‘death priests’ when he was the ‘monster king’ in the Kaesong area, so he had experience in commanding thousands of zombie corps.
And now he could control much more zombie troops than before.
“The day has finally come when the Army of Death that we have cultivated until now will finally see the light of day! By the way, Manager Park! Report to me how many troops are currently available!”
“Oh, wait a minute. Manager Kim, do you have that troop status table?”
Then, Manager Kim turned his head and looked at another staffer.
“Hey, deputy manager Lee! Did you hear it?”
Deputy Manager Lee pressed the Ctrl + P button to print the ‘Undead (decoration) status table’.
Weeeeng- Weeeeng-
He printed out the Excel sheet and gave it to Victor.
But Victor couldn’t read the characters.
“Um, yes, I see. You guys have gathered a lot of them. Great. Keep it well, so I can give it to our master.”
Shortly afterward, the sound of an iron door opening inside the cave was heard.
And a very familiar sound echoed very slowly.
Rattle! Rattle!
The sound of bones hitting against each other filled the cave.
Rattle! Rattle!
With hundreds of thousands of eyes glowing inside the cave, they began to slowly get out of the cave.
***
Somewhere in Earth Zero.
“Ugh? What the heck is this?”
“Can you see this, too?”
– What’s the best job to survive in a ruined world? Choose one right now.
Those humans on Earth Zero, who indulged in entertainment and pleasure, began to see strange characters in their eyes.
The creators of this game, namely, GMs, called their world ‘Earth Zero.’
Earth Zero meant that it was nothing but the first one out of so many worlds.
But the idea of Earth ‘centrism’ made the whole people living there exclusive and violent. Furthermore, it made them forget about humanitarianism.
As a result, they plundered and slaughtered human beings in other worlds ranging from Earth 1 to Earth 38, and what’s more, they toyed with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - Age After Ending (26)
chapters.content:
Chapter 512: Age After Ending (26)
They even rationalized their terrible evil actions as the law of the jungle or the rights and benefits of those who were more advanced than them. And they have been involved in it even today. They enjoyed limitless freedom and pleasure.
But the game came to them one day.
– What’s the best job to survive in a ruined world? Choose one right now.
“Hey, what the heck is this?”
“Can you see this too?”
– Your selection of the first job is over now.
* For those who failed to make the choice, seize the next chance!
“Oh my God…”
Just like those who they had toyed with, they were also embarrassed by the message.
Kieeeeeeeeh!
“What the heck is that? Goblin?”
“Yeah, that’s right! Run away!”
They were struck with fear. After all, they were just humans, who could not overcome their fundamental limits.
“Give me that sword! Give it to me quickly!”
A game similar to that of Earth in another dimension has begun.
But the problem was that it was not just the monsters that they confronted.
“What the heck is that one?”
Woooooooo-”
“Airship?”
“Man, isn’t that magic engineering airship that usually appears in the later stage of the game?”
The current game was much more difficult than the one in the past.
***
About an hour after the game started, tens of thousands of people in Earth Zero were gathered in a dome-shaped ‘shelter’. They were there for an emergency evacuation.
All of them were holding shabby weapons. They were their basic weapons as soon as they chose their jobs when the game started.
“Hey! What the hell is this?”
“Has the game system caused an error?”
“Please give me a proper explanation!”
They could not wait calmly because they had already witnessed the massacre by monsters that appeared outside the shelter, as well as the monsters that appeared in the game.
So the government officials stepped in.
“Come on, the International Martial Command is checking it now! Since we have made the system, we can solve the problem right away. So calm down, everybody!”
However, they could not convince the people.
“If you were us, do you think you can feel relaxed right now? Our players were hit with a nuclear bomb not too long ago, but you said you were on top of the situation, right?”
“Fix the problem right now! And you will have to compensate for the damage we have suffered!”
The collapse of ‘Neo Alexandria’, which took place about a year ago, shocked the people on Earth Zero a lot. Because of the revolt of the players, who were believed to be nothing more than toys in their eyes, and the unprecedented explosions, the largest city on Earth, Zeron, completely disappeared.
Right at this very moment, they seemed to recall that terrible incident.
After lodging a strong protest, they gathered here and there and sat down in groups.
They have made various assumptions about the current situation.
“I wonder if the game system has been hacked.”
“Huh? Hacking? Who did it?”
“Well, that’s….”
There was only one enemy they could think of.
“Necromancer?”
He was the strongest player on Earth 32, who eventually became the winner of the game by killing the ‘World Eater’, and he was the one who first rebelled against Earth Zero beyond the three options given to him.
“No, that’s nonsense! How could the savage human beings not only understand our technology but also hack it? That’s impossible!”
They struggled to deny their worst guess.
“By the way, hacking or not, if the game has just started, we are not safe here at all. You know that, right?”
“Of course, I know because I have watched the game broadcast so many times. Soon they’re going to stop the quest from getting out of the shelter.”
Goblins could not break through the iron gates of the shelter, but those who enjoyed watching the game for a long time knew that a bigger disaster could come.
“There could be a dungeon here. You remember that apartment survival quest on the Chinese server in the Earth 8 survival game, right?”
“Oh, I remember. It was such a great episode, so I watched it several times recently.”
“That’s right. It’s still on the top of the replay list. Anyway…”
In the meantime, one suspicious guy was watching their conversation carefully.
“Wow, look at these guys! It’s going to be fun.”
He was a young Asian man.
After spitting out such words, he giggled. It looked like he was sneering at them.
Sensing something strange, they turned their glances at him.
“Isn’t it ridiculous that they are engaged in such serious conversation like the regular game club members? God, these guys are crazy.”
The man still giggled alone, and eventually, a middle-aged man came up to him and asked, “What are you so funny about?”
The young man shrugged, then said, “Pardon? Oh, isn’t this game so much fun? I guess this game will be as exciting as that apartment episode before.”
When he said that, they became silent all of a sudden. It was not the right time for him to mention it in this situation, no matter how childish he was.
In other words, he went over the line.
“What? What the heck did you say?”
“I’m talking about this situation. Isn’t it pretty exciting? Why are you guys so upset? You know you guys can’t survive with a mindset like that, right?”
“You must be crazy, bastard!”
As if he could not stand it anymore, the middle-aged man raised his voice.
He strode over to the young man and began to point his finger at him.
“People who couldn’t get into the shelter are dying right now! How can you crack such a joke?”
When the middle-aged man scolded him, they began to chime in one by one.
“Yeah, that’s right. Watch your language! A lot of people here can’t even contact their family members!”
“No matter how crazy the world goes around, how can’t you tell the game from reality?”
Despite such simultaneous accusations, the Asian man did not budge a bit.
“Hmm…game and reality? Is there anybody who can’t tell them apart? Hahaha. Well, as they say, normal is a concept for the majority, so I must be abnormal here.”
“What the hell is this guy talking about?”
“Kick him out of here right now!”
Without changing his expression, however, that man watched the situation with his arms crossed.
At that moment someone raised his hand and pointed at him. His index finger was trembling.
“He’s a player!”
Player?
Strictly speaking, all the survivors here were ‘players’ the moment the game began.
But none of them admitted they were ‘players’ because the player referred to the low-level human beings used in the game.
“Pardon?”
In other words, the ‘player’ was not supposed to exist in this place, namely, Earth Zero.
“That’s right! He’s one of the colleagues of the Necromancer on Earth 32! He is the highest-level thief! That crazy bastard wearing weird clothes!”
That was true. He was none other than Hanho, who was widely known as the crazy guy wearing strange clothes, a player with such images, to those living in Earth Zero.
“Man, why is he here?”
At that moment, those who came to Hanho and pointed their fingers at him stepped back.
Since all of them enjoyed watching game broadcasts, they recognized Hanho belatedly.
“Well, I came here because I heard you guys were having great fun these days,” said Hanho, with his arms crossed. He felt great as if he were a celebrity because they recognized him.
“How about it? Isn’t it a little more fun now? Then, let me show you something more interesting.. Come on, everyone, look at me. Let me start!”

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - Age After Ending (27)
chapters.content:
Chapter 513: Age After Ending (27)
At that moment, six hands rose from behind his back. Most of those who watched that bizarre scene knew what it was.
“Oh, Asura!”
– Caution! The Incarnation of Hyunmu has begun in the area.
Something in a huge green shape began to form behind his back.
It was Hyunmu.
Those who witnessed the ghastly figure in person were astonished.
So stiff with fright and fear, they slowly raised their heads and saw that fast-growing monster.
“Aaaaaaaaaaah!”
They screamed in fear belatedly. And their simultaneous screams erupted everywhere in the shelter, resonating through the whole dome.
Great chaos followed.
“Security men!”
They dispersed in disorder, and the shelter guards rushed toward them.
“What’s going on? What the heck is that?”
But the security guards came, carrying not the weapons they normally used but the basic weapons they were offered after selecting their jobs as soon as the game started.
They couldn’t help it because when the game began, the ‘nanorobots’ spread all over the world and deleted all their weapons from the inventory.
Because of that, they were no more than level 1 players.
“Oh my God! You guys are only worth 1000 gold? I don’t feel any appetite for fighting you guys.”
Hanho was in a situation where the basic player would challenge the maximum-level player.
“Come on, guys, let me clear up the mess.”
When Hanho said that, the players of the World Tree camp who had been hiding among the refugees began to appear one by one.
“213th Squadron, start the operation!”
They took out the dazzling weapons they had been hiding. Incomparable to the weapons the guards were holding, they were the highest quality equipment.
“From now on, we’re starting our operation, Clear Den Bugs! Don’t save anybody who tries to resist!”
Their crackdown on those on Earth Zero has begun. It was very easy.
“Stop them!”
“How can we stop them?”
Several security guards fought back to fulfill their duties, but they were not their rivals from the start.
“Damn, I can’t do anything!”
“Kheeeeeek!”
By normal standards, their fighting could not be called anything like fighting. It was not long before they collapsed one by one, so Hanho and his allies easily occupied the entire dome. They carried out their operation more easily than before.
In the meantime, some members infiltrated the “secret facility” connected to the shelter and turned off the power of the huge mechanical device there.
It was the system administrator ‘Sentinel’.
“We’ve secured Sentinel in the B44 area!”
Sentinel was the game system’s manager AI, so it could manipulate the game system to some extent.
Right now, it’s only in the early stage of the game, so they responded clumsily because they could not even understand the situation properly, but they would soon try to take control of the system based on a large number of Sentinels.
In that case, it was clear that something quite troublesome would happen, such as manipulating the system and supplying high-performance items to those on Earth Zero.
So their first operation was to dispatch a small number of elite agents into the shelter and eliminate the ‘Sentinel’ first before they launched a full-scale invasion,
It was not the strategic gains alone that they could achieve by controlling a large number of ‘Sentinels’.
“As a result, we have neutralized all 12 Sentinels around the wormhole.”
“Okay! Contact the Expeditionary Command that we’re done preparing for their multi-dimensional invasion!”
The Sentinels installed at the ‘shelter’ that surrounded the Bermuda Triangle were controlling the wormholes, but they obtained their ‘wormholes’ by neutralizing the Sentinels there.
Hanho stood before the ‘gate’ installed at the shelter.
Wooooooooooo-
Connected to the wormhole, this gate served as a door to another world.
“Alright. We’re finally ready to go save another world.”
With a triumphant expression, Hanho looked down at the violently rocking gate.
“Wait, we are going to rescue you guys!”
By taking control of the wormhole in Earth Zero, they could save those worlds ranging from Earth Zero to Earth 38.
Soon over a hundred players were ready to go to another world and lined up in front of the gate.
“Our destination is Earth 35. Those living there are currently average level 6 or so. They are in the Mainstream 2, Raid Boss Monster stage.”
“Well, I don’t think it’s difficult to crack down on them.”
“That’s right.”
“Let’s hurry up!”
They were ready to take revenge and liberate them.
The same thing was happening on many different earths, too.
“They’re coming from over there, too!”
It was hell and slaughter for them.
About a hundred survivors blocked the entrance to a supermarket in the US server, staging a sit-in.
Their opponents were hundreds of orcs. They came pouring out from all directions, ripped open the entrances with maces and axes, and smashed the barricades.
“They’re breaking through!”
Their sit-in didn’t seem to last very long.
“Damn it! Where the hell are they coming from?”
“We’re finished! Everyone, climb on the roof!”
Puck!
“Kheeeeeeeek!”
As the game progressed rapidly, survivors decreased more rapidly.
Puck! Puck! Puck!
“The western gate has been broken through!”
The number of survivors was decreasing very rapidly.
“No, Peter! Why is this happening to us?”
Right now this place was Earth 36 where the 11th survival game was taking place.
It’s been only one month since the game started.
On the other hand, it was also the most popular ‘broadcast’ for mankind on Earth Zero in recent years, for those on Earth Zero felt the greatest joy at the beginning of the game when the bewildered survivors were killed in big chaos while desperately struggling to survive. And they described the situation as ‘the hide-and-seek of fools.’
“Watch out behind your back!”
Puck!
This was the moment when so many people died in vain, creating the most stimulating scenes of attacking and killing, which, in turn, enjoyed the highest ratings among viewers.
“Argh! Help me!”
“Victor! Victor has been caught!”
“No, it’s too late! Throw it away!”
“Don’t leave me alone! Kheeeek!”
Puck! Puck! Puck! Puck!
“Come on, run to the roof!”
But the survivors here didn’t know that they were being referred to as those on Earth 36.
“Ugh! Oh my God!”
They only fought to survive day by day, without caring about the truth of the game at all.
The survivors barely made it to the roof. Then, after shutting the iron door, they froze it by casting the freezing magic.
“Whew! Since everyone is up here, open the portal! Even if we can only move only 500 meters at most, we have to get out of here!”
They had prepared the exodus strategy in advance.
“No, it’s impossible…”
The backup players waiting on the roof were full of despair.
“We can’t get out of here…”
“What the heck are you talking about?”
One of the backup players pointed to a corner of the roof, where there were three corpses covered in blood.
“James was dead.”
“What?”
The wizard who was supposed to open a portal for them to escape just in case of emergency fell there, with his body cut in half.
He seemed to have been hit by the ballistas when the orcs shot at the roof.
“Oh, no······.”
They looked over the roof railing in despair.
There were hordes of orcs everywhere. Pounding war drums madly, they were pushing and shoving wildly through the open doors. Since they were completely besieged by the orcs, they could not get out of this situation.
“We’re finished…”

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - Age After Ending (28)
chapters.content:
Chapter 514: Age After Ending (28)
The survivors flopped down one by one, stricken with their frustration.
At that moment a strange miracle happened when they were in despair with no way out.
“What the heck is that?”
“Isn’t it a boat?”
A flying ship appeared in the sky.
Wooooooooooo-
A gigantic object making the sound of an engine slid through the clouds and landed on the ground. The metal material shone brilliantly in the sunlight.
It was a boat. And it spewed out a ray of light.
Kwaahhhhhhhh!
The beam of light fell upon the heads of the orcs. It was like God’s punishment.
Bang!
With the explosions, the entire concrete floor overturned and the mart shook as if it was about to collapse. When a wave of fire broke out, the hordes of orcs surrounding the mart were gone. Thousands of orcs were killed by the explosions at once.
“God, what the hell is happening now?”
And something flew up from the deck of that ‘flying ship’ in succession.
It was the monsters they had never seen before, who were the ‘Hippogriffs.’
Those giant bird-like monsters began to descend sharply toward the mart’s rooftop.
“Uh? What the heck?”
The players on the mart hurriedly backed away, and the Hippogriffs landed soon.
Thump- Thump-
Somebody was riding on them.
“Man, I’m so busy. Brother Inho, why hasn’t that guy called Superintelligence broken the system of other worlds? Wouldn’t it be really convenient if he did so?”
“I heard that if he did that, he could lose control of the system in Earth Zero. If that happened, we would be finished!”
“Oh, really? If that’s the case, we’ve got to do a little more.”
The two Asian men got off the roof.
“Who the hell are you?”
The players at the mart felt they were unusual. They certainly looked like players, but they’ve never heard about a group of players at that level in the whole server.
In other words, they were completely in a different league.
“Hey, who are you?”
The six-armed man scratched his head with his right third arm.
They were, of course, Hanho and Inho.
“Well, it’s a long story, but can you tell me who is the largest group of survivors in this area? We want to meet and talk to them.”
“Pardon?”
“Oh, we want to help you to move somewhere…”
Since Hanho was not good at explaining, Inho stepped forward.
“To make a long story short, you can feel relaxed now. This game is over.”
“What? Is it over? Then can we be freed from this game?”
Hanho and Inho nodded at the same time.
“Yes, that’s right.”
They’ve just come here, Earth 36, after liberating Earth 35.
Since they had had experiences like that, they learned how to persuade the players in another world who didn’t know anything.
“But there is one condition. We need your cooperation to finish this game forever.”
Now Hanho and Inho mastered even how to make use of them.
***
Seven motorcycles were racing along the road with the old name of Sejongdaero in the half-collapsed downtown.
Burrrrrrrrrrrr-
Seven engines roared through the quiet road.
“That bastard is coming!”
A huge shadow followed them, walking with heavy footsteps.
Thud! Thud! Thud! Thud!
“The trap is almost there! Keep going!”
It was the wingless dragon, Drake.
“Oh My God…”
Drake’s body was so huge that it took him a while to get out of the building.
When it finally emerged, he was as long as 30 meters. He looked much larger because of the jagged thorns growing from his back to his tail.
“That is the king of monsters in Gangbuk….”
At first glance, Drake was completely different from a normal Drake.
Thud! Thud! Thud! Thud!
Today among other days, Drake charged alongside the motorcycles fiercely toward the defensive wall built near Gwanghwamun, Seoul.
“That bastard has opened his mouth!”
“What? Prepare Defense Breath right now!”
The wizards on the motorcycle spread the shield they had prepared in advance.
At that very moment, red energy surged from Drake’s throat.
Then he threw out a column of red flames. That intense heat engulfed the road, crushing it and melting the asphalt. The heat was so intense that even the cars parked on both sides of the road melted.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
Drake’s breath engulfed the four motorcycles in the rear, which, in turn, exploded right away. The other three motorcycles barely escaped the attack, then accelerated as much as possible.
Woooooooong-
The engine was overloaded to speed as much as possible.
“We’re almost there!”
But the moment they barely passed a certain point, they cast white magic towards his ankles, with a big shout from all directions.
“Fire!”
“Pour out all the magic attacks!”
It was freezing magic. They blasted on the ground and tied Drake’s ankles.
“We’ve made it!”
As if an ice age came, Drake’s movement stopped the moment the temperature around the area dropped sharply.
“Captain! We’ve bound Drake King!”
The players who were on standby in each alley used the large-scale freezing magic they had prepared in advance.
But it was too early for them to feel reassured.
“Not yet! Don’t let down your guard yet! That monster is different from a typical Drake! He’s much stronger than the field boss Alpha Drake! Prepare a follow-up attack right now!”
“Yes!”
They were in Earth 34 where it’s been three months since the game started, so a lot of big incidents took place. For example, the ‘Kings of Monsters’ were created some time ago, and devastated the whole of Seoul. After their appearance, four great forces were reduced to ashes.
If they could not stop them right here, the Korean server would be finished.
“Hey, try to move if you can, Drake! I know a monster at your level can easily break out of it, so let me see,” said the commander of this group, called Captain, who stood on the highest point of the wall, while staring at the struggling Drake King bound by freezing magic.
He was the strongest player, ranked No. 1 on the Korean server, who unified Seoul and the metropolitan areas. That’s why he was more cold-hearted than anyone else.
“You and I are going to fight it out to determine who is the real owner of Seoul today.”
Grrrrrrr-
